title: PFS2 3-13 Guardians Covenant
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Ian McHugh The PCs visit Port Valen and perform a series of deeds to earn the approval of the forest guardian. For Character Levels 3-6,
description_full: This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Pathfinder Organised Play Character. But Pre-generated Character Sheets are also available. After assisting the people of Port Valen and protecting the town from rampaging trolls, the Society earned the approval of the settlement's leaders to establish a new Pathfinder lodge in the former feasting hall of the legendary warrior Sveinn Blood-Eagle. After enduring several months of dangerous ocean voyages to supply the new lodge and assist the town, venture-captains Bjersig Torrsen and Calisro Bennary requested permission for the Society to connect their new lodge in Port Valen to the Maze of the Open Road. By using the mystical extraplanar hedge maze, the venture-captains hope to strengthen the Society's presence in Arcadia. Rather than establish such a connection on their own, the venture-captains consulted Port Valen's leaders to determine the most responsible means of opening the portal. Their careful research brought them to a fey guardian in the Forest of Trials. The guardian readily agreed to the Society's proposal, on one condition. To keep the portal opened, the Society must regularly send heroes to perform heroic…

title: SFS 1-06: Magic in the Mist

description_full: A mysterious spire shrouded in purple mist has been seen in the jungles of Ukulam, a continent spanning nature preserve on the planet Castrovel. These sightings are periodic but persistent, yet scientists, explorers, and tourists have all been unable to reach the site or pinpoint its exact location. Intrigued by reports of the vanishing spire, Venture-Captain Arvin has secured permission to dispatch a team of Starfinders to Ukulam to locate and explore the mysterious structure. A Starfinder Society Scenario designed for 1st- through 2nd-level characters, playable in 2-3 hours.

title: PFS2 6-06 Rotten Apples
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Steven Blease When a small forest community goes silent, it’s up to the Pathfinders to figure out why and come to the rescue. For character levels 3-6.
description_full: Deep in the Fangwood Forest in war-torn Nirmathas, sits an isolated leshy village called Compost Watch, surrounded by a sacred leshy graveyard: the Compost Forest. Working in tandem with the Ashfall Lodge, Compost Watch has kept up their vigil and maintenance of the primal space for generations, however after a recent distress signal from the trees of the Fangwood, no one's heard from the little town. It's up to the PCs to enter into the Compost Forest and see what's upsetting the balance of life, death, and nature!  This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Pathfinder Organised Play Character, but Pregenerated Character Sheets are also available.  GM: Steve Blease

title: Starfleet Academy 2270 - Milk Run
subtitle: The Code of the Spacelanes GM: Simon Burley Forget the 32nd Century. We always wanted a Star Fleet Academy series set in 23rd Century. Well here it is. Set immediately after The Original Series.
description_full: You’ll play a group of Cadets on a simple training mission, piloting a shuttle around the Solar System under the watchful eye of your trainer, Lieutenant-Commander Galloway. It’s a milk run. What could possibly go wrong? You’ll Experience: Role-play forward, player driven 2d6 shenanigans, with an easy-to learn system that generates an unforgettable experience.   You’ll use pre-generated characters from The Original Series in a short, fun, prologue adventure before making your own bespoke unforgettable Star Trek the Original Series cadets. Player Requirements: No previous experience or knowledge necessary. But there’ll be enough easter eggs to keep the Trekkies happy. (Did you spot the Galloway deep dive?) GM Style: Narrative-first and cinematic. Player-focused, collaborative emphasising story, improvisation, and memorable character moments.

description_full: Tales of the All-Father is a Megagame about Vikings, which has a wide variety of flexible roles, so you can focus on playing mechanical roles, which are like a board game, or debating and scheming with other players. Megagames are a cross between board games and role-playing games, usually played by more than 20 players. These games often involve strategy, planning and negotiation. If you like role-playing games, card games or the TV show The Traitors, you will enjoy some aspect of Megagames. Players are members of Viking clans in a strange new world and will be competing with other clans for glory, gold and above all, the Gods' blessing. Decide whether you want to lead your clan as a Jarl, explore and raid new lands for treasure as a Raider, build great halls and host feasts as a Hearthkeeper or collect and tell epic sagas and engage in Flyte battles as a Skald. title: Play Beyond the Rules: Exploring Neurodiversity Through Game Design
subtitle: An interactive workshop inviting participants to explore neurodiversity through play.
description_full: This interactive workshop invites participants to explore neurodiversity through play by adapting familiar board games into tools for reflection, dialogue, and understanding. Using a guided “game hack” approach, we will take popular titles such as Dixit and Forbidden Jungle and modify their mechanics to better understand the lived experiences of neurodivergent individuals. Participants will work collaboratively to redesign elements of gameplay—such as communication, uncertainty, rules, and perspective-taking—using these as metaphors for different neurodivergent conditions. Through structured play and facilitated discussion, the workshop will highlight how games can make complex experiences more tangible, supporting empathy and awareness among a wide range of stakeholders. The session is designed for educators, designers, clinicians, and community organisers, and requires no prior experience. By the end of the workshop, participants will leave with practical techniques for adapting games, as well as new ways of thinking about how play can be used to explore identity, difference, and inclusion.   Entry to this event is included with your UKGE entry ticket. title: Dracula's influence on roleplaying games
subtitle: A discussion about Dracula's influence on roleplaying games
description_full: Dracula has influenced modern entertainment, but none more so than in the medium of tabletop roleplaying games.  The novel reimagined how a monster could be presented, and the charismatic deviant was interpreted into modern roleplaying games.  Examples vary, between Count Strahd von Zarovich in Dungeon & Dragon ’s Ravenloft setting, to Dracula himself appearing in the Dracula Dossier for Night’s Black Agents . Many roleplaying games include an archetype of the genteel monster, where the elegant exterior disguises their machinations.  A seemingly cultured opponent, who has their own wants and desires, offers far more roleplaying opportunities than just another monster that wants to eat people. Vampires, as we know them in fiction, owe much of their predatory elegance to Dracula. The story undoubtedly influenced Anne Rice ’s The Vampire Chronicles, which in turn influenced The Lost Boys , Near Dark and many others.  These, in turn, influenced the portrayal of the modern vampire as an outsider in the roleplaying game Vampire: The Masquerade .  This game would go onto influence many other roleplaying games like Kult: Divinity Lost and Urban Shadows , as well as films such as Blade and…

title: Faraway Tournament
subtitle: Join us for a friendly Faraway tournament for a chance to win Hachette BGUK Store Credit!
description_full: Welcome to Alula, a mysterious continent with ever-changing geography, shaped after the rhythm of the seasons. Beyond the Sea of Mists lies the mysterious continent of Alula. Roam across the land in search of its secrets, meet its inhabitants and list its wonders to gain more fame than your opponents. Throughout a game of Faraway , you will play a row of 8 cards in front of you, from left to right. These cards represent the regions you will come across while exploring the lands. Characters on these cards will grant you victory points if you later fulfil the conditions they demand. At the end of the game, you walk back the same way, scoring cards in the opposite order you played them. There lies the heart of the gameplay. Throughout the game, the cards you play will serve both to set new objectives, and to meet the ones you played previously. Each turn, you play a card from a hand of 3. Then you pick a new card from a face-up river. As play is simultaneous in Faraway , you must take into account a clever priority system in all of your choices – being last to pick a card leaves you with fewer options and often less profitable choices for the next turns. title: Guy Sclanders!
subtitle: Come say hello to Guy!
description_full: Drop by the Meet & Greet stand in Hall 1 for this casual meet & greet session.    Say hello, grab a photo, or perhaps ask Guy to sign something.    Queues may be managed if busy.

title: Warcry Narrative/Casual Event - WorldCryUK
subtitle: WorldcryUK Presents the Warcry Narrative event of the year!
description_full: The first and biggest Warcry Weekender in the United Kingdom by your wonderful folks from WorldCryUK and Animosity Campaigns at UK Games Expo. You can expect top tier trophies for the winners, goodies for participants, the iconic photobooth for your wonderful warband’s closeups and as always, your favourite TOs and judges! Beneath the emerald canopy of Thyria, life and decay wage an endless war, and your warband stands at the breaking point. In this three-game narrative event for Warcry, choose your path: Contaminators who seed creeping corruption, or Remediators sworn to burn out the rot and restore balance. Forge your warband’s legend amid choking vines and verdant ruin. An excellent first step into Warcry events, Unfallen follows a light narrative pack, where wins and losses contribute to the story but after-action admin is kept to a minimum. Listbuilding is kept simple to keep complexity down and the main goal is clean, fun games. Proxies and kitbashes are encouraged! Tournament Pack is out and can be found here! (Link) Wartally Registration here: Link   You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event.

title: Dominion
subtitle: Join MSO for a lively, non‑elimination Dominion tournament open to all players.
description_full: Think you can build the most efficient kingdom in the land? Join the MSO team for a fast‑paced, friendly Dominion tournament where every decision counts. Our non‑elimination format keeps everyone in the action, pairing you with opponents of similar ability throughout the event. After five rounds of kingdom‑building, the player with the highest tournament score will rise above the rest and claim the title. Tournament format •  3 players per table •  5 rounds •  Base game only (Second Edition) Full tournament rules and format details are already available on the MSO website: https://mindsportsolympiad.com/uk-games-expo/ For any queries, please contact Mike at mikedixonmso@gmail.com

title: Quoridor Simul
subtitle: Take part in a simul and play an expert at Quoridor!
description_full: Simultaneous Exhibitions (aka ‘Simul’) are a well known concept from Chess. A strong player, typically a Grandmaster, plays multiple games at the same time against different opponents. In this event, you can book your ticket to take part in a Quoridor Simul against Stephen Cairns. Stephen has won three in-person Mind Sports Olympiad tournaments in Quoridor as well as winning multiple medals for online play. The Simul event is open to players of all levels, and will be run by the team behind the Mind Sports Olympiad and PlayStrategy on their stand in Hall 1. You can come and learn the game at the stand before the event. Any player who can win against Stephen Cairns will receive free entry to the Mind Sports Olympiad Quoridor tournament in London in August (precise date TBA). All of the ticket sales, less VAT, will be donated to the 2026 UKGE Charities . You will need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event.

title: KeyForge Sealed Tournament (Single Deck)
subtitle: Play some friendly games of KeyForge. Keep your deck. Win prizes!
description_full: Come along and join in a Keyforge tournament - perfect for new players and old hands! You'll be given a brand new deck to play with (set TBC). This deck is completely unique, yours to keep, and included in the cost. We'll be using a Swiss format to ensure everyone gets as many games as possible. This is a chance for us to celebrate a much loved game at UKGE What is Keyforge? KEYFORGE IS THE INNOVATIVE CARD GAME where every deck you purchase is a completely unique combination of cards! No other player will ever wield the same KeyForge deck. Wielding a unique 36-card deck, assuming the role of a powerful Archon, players seeks to maneuver creatures and artifacts from three allied houses to accumulate enough Æmber to forge the vital Vault Keys. The player to first forge three keys wins! Will it be you?   You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event.

title: 20 Years of UKGE
subtitle: How did a minister and a GP create the UK's biggest tabletop gaming convention?
description_full: Join UKGE Directors, Richard Denning and Tony Hyams, to hear how they went from "having a bit of an idea" to industry leaders, and all the detours on the way.    Joined by some special guests, come for a walk down memory lane and a celebration of the UK Games Expo.   Entry to this event is included with your UKGE entry ticket. Please have yours with you when you attend, or you will be refused entry.  There are no reserved seating for this event, please arrive early and enjoy the wonderful British tradition of queuing to avoid disappointment.

title: IP and Contracts 101
subtitle: A practical overview of the key IP rights and contractual essentials that every tabletop business needs to know.
description_full: Join specialist games lawyer Anna Poulter-Jones for a practical seminar that will run through the intellectual property and contractual fundamentals that every tabletop games business needs to understand, whether you are starting up or scaling up. This session will cover the key IP rights and quirks that underpin tabletop games (from copyright, to trade marks, to design rights, and why you can't protect game mechanics), how to protect your brand and game assets, and common pitfalls in ownership and licensing. We will also walk through some contractual essentials that structure any deal in the industry, large or small, highlighting with real examples the clauses that matter most and the risks to watch out for.  The value of tabletop games businesses resides in their IP and how they wield it, so being aware of your IP rights, how best to protect them and how to navigate the world of contractual negotiations is crucial to the growth and success of businesses in this industry. Entry to this event is included with your UKGE entry ticket. Please have yours with you when you attend, or you will be refused entry.  There are no reserved seating for this event, please arrive early and enjoy…

title: Discworld: All That is Gold is Not Butter
subtitle: Join a cast of UK tabletop names as they play a brand-new adventure from the upcoming starter set for the Discworld TTRPG.
description_full: Join a cast of UK tabletop names as they play a brand-new adventure from the upcoming starter set for the Discworld TTRPG.   Follow UKGE and Modiphius on social media for further cast announcements   Guy Sclanders as the Games Master Award-winning, internationally renowned Dungeon Master for Wizards of the Coast Twitch Live streams, Returning DM at D&D in a Castle, returning Game Master for Modiphius, host of the hugely popular Youtube channel How to be a Great GM, repeat UK Games Expo seminar giver and GM, and all around mega-geek, Guy has run RPGs for decades. His style is Lord of the Rings meets Monty Python meets Michael Bay. The collective narrative is the most important element of the game, in his opinion, and he loves discovering epic adventures no matter the system or setting. Find out more about his numerous books on how to become a better GM and on private bookings at  www.greatgamemaster.com Live Entertainment tickets will go on sale Monday 19th January   You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event

title: Games on Demand
subtitle: Come join us for another wild and incredible experience at the Games on Demand Tables.
description_full: Come join us for another wild and incredible experience at the Games on Demand Tables.    Want to try some new roleplaying games?   Or have never roleplayed before?   We welcome people of all levels of experience and interest. Just pick a time slot, take a seat at a table, and our Games Masters will present you with fantastic worlds to explore, enhance, and even if you're feeling up to it, exploit.   We run two hour long games… On the Hour! Every Hour!   Expect games of (but not limited to): Atma , Mouseritter, Feather and bone, Decaying orbit, Lead & Gold, The Score, Killshot, Fist and Nimble, SLA Industries, Dragonbane, Imperium Maledictum, White Star, Black Hack, Root, PTBA, FATE, Black Code, and many more!   If you've never GM'd before and want to try, Games on Demand is a great place to start, and the Games on Demand team can help with feedback on your session too. If you would like to take part in this event as a Games Master please email rpgs@ukgamesexpo.co.uk More information about running RPGs at UKGE, including support packages, see this page https://www.ukgamesexpo.co.uk/events/running-event/running-an-rpg/    You will need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this…

title: Pathfinder #7-14 Brastlewark at War Part 2
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Ted Lee Help the Pathfinder society rescue gnomes in a warzone! A Pathfinder Society Scenario for levels 3 and 4.
description_full: A group of gnomes fleeing harsher restrictions in Brastlewark, one of the largest gnome settlements as well as one nominally ruled by a Thrune sympathizer, has brought terrible news--the self-proclaimed ruler of Brastlewark, King Drum Thornfiddle has been using Hellknight enforcers to crack down on the gnome citizens, as well as forcing many to use their primals magics to mix with diabolical ones in the creation of weapons of war, such as the Jaws of Hell, which saw use in the Battle of Hellknight Hill. The Andoran Army has pushed far enough into Cheliax that destruction of these facilities and liberation of the gnomes is now possilbe, but they can't do both. It's up to you and your fellow Pathfinders to see that the gnomes are safe, and that they can know true freedom, away from the tyranny of Cheliax and House Thrune.   This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Pathfinder Organized Play Character. But Pregenerated Character Sheets are also available. GM: Ted Lee

title: PFS2 #7–12: TCW, Part 2: The Battle of Logas
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Nicola Barnes A Pathfinder & Goblin army sets off to stop the hostile undead of Logas, only to find a new undead Hellknight order there. For Characters levels 5-6.
description_full: A 2e Pathfinder Society Scenario designed for 5th-6th level characters. With the success of the Chitterwood Talks, the goblin tribes are ready to march on Logas and put a stop to the undead attacks, with support from the Pathfinder Society. As forces approach the city, rumors start to circle of a strange plague only affecting Hellknights, leaving the undead Hellknights covered in bizarre, circular scars and bearing the mark of an unknown order. Within Logas, a Hellknight necromancer has declared herself the head of a new Hellknight order and is using the city as her chance to prove its worth. Can the Pathfinders stand up to The Order of the Open Tomb? This is a repeatable adventure in the ongoing Battle's Spark metaplot.

title: SFS2 1-10 Rites of Rekindling
subtitle: Starfinder 2e GM: Jay Boylan Strange occurrences and a missing relic are overshadowing the celebrations of a star's rebirth. Is the Rekindling cursed? For characters of levels 1-2
description_full: Deep in the Vast, the dying star Sota has miraculously rekindled, bathing the frozen planet Lajok in glorious light and blessing thousands of the planet’s inhabitants with a solar spark. As scientists and skeptics ponder this inexplicable twist of fate, vlakas the galaxy over undertake the sojourn home to witness this miracle for themselves and celebrate Sota’s revival. Thanks to a coincidental meeting, the Starfinder Society has been invited to participate in one such celebration: the Rekindling Festival in Sour Spring. When strange occurrences and a missing relic cast a shadow over the celebrations, it’s up to the Starfinders to investigate. Is someone to blame for Sour Spring’s misfortunes, or is Rekindling cursed? This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Starfinder Organised Play character, but pregenerated character sheets are also available. GM: Jay Boylan (they/them)

title: PFS2 7-06 Brastlework of War Part 1
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Ian McHugh War is coming can the Pathfinders get their charges across the Andoran border safely. A Pathfinder Society Scenario for character levels 1-4
description_full: This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Pathfinder Organised Play Character. But Pregenerated Character Sheets are also available. With war breaking out, the gnomes of Brastlewark in Cheliax can no longer cling to their carefree ways. Self-proclaimed King Drum Thornfiddle is eager to ingratiate himself to Queen Abrogail, and so conscripts the city's magical and creative resources towards the war effort. A few gnomes have broken free, and they have brought evidence of the various works being created in Brastlewark. They're no fighters, though. It'll be up to the Pathfinders to get them safely across the border to Andoran and freedom. GM Ian McHugh

title: "Moon-eyes and Fire Flies"
subtitle: Dungeon Crawl Classics RPG GM: Judge Wendlbert Age Restrictions: 15+ Dungeon Crawl Classics RPG adventure set in the Shudder Mountains for level 1 PCs.
description_full: On your return from a camping journey to the mountain tops to watch the yearly meteor showers fly overhead, your party witnesses a swarm of fireflies set fire to a home and are drawn into a feud between the current occupants and those who lay claim to the land. A Dungeon Crawl Classics RGP game from the “Chained Coffin” compilation which is set in the Shudder Mountains. This game is for level 1 PCs.  Everything supplied to play the game, dice, pencils and pre-made level 1 PCs to choose from - just turn up!

title: PFS2 #7-09 The Chitterwood Walks, Part 1
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Andrew Wilson The PCs are tasked with guarding an important assembly of goblins in the Chitterwood Forest
description_full: #7-09 The Chitterwood Walks, Part 1: Scrambling the Tribes The PCs are tasked with guarding an important assembly of goblins in the Chitterwood  Forest within Isger. They must engage in goblin diplomacy and fend off an attack by  undead Chelaxian soldiers or jeopardize a valuable alliance in the brewing war between  Cheliax and Andoran. GM: Andrew Wilson

title: The Moon Witch Script Listening Party (A Blood on the Clocktower Album)
subtitle: You have been summoned to Ravenswood Bluff for a listening party! Expect secrets behind the music and exclusive demos, as well as all of the tracks from the album.
description_full: Your storyteller has been killed, oh no! It’s a good thing she left behind 12 songs for us to listen to!    Join Holly as she hosts the first ever listening party for The Moon Witch Script, the brand new Blood on the Clocktower album. 12 characters will be joining you and you’ll hear their stories told, but in addition, you’ll be able to get some sweet goss about how they came to be, the inspiration behind each of the songs and the process for writing them. Holly is also bringing a series of unreleased materials from the process of writing the album to share with the UKGE crowd and present how these tracks developed over time.   Ever wondered if the Huntsman found their Damsel, or why the Witch plays in 3/4? Bring your questions and your cauldrons and come listen to the full album with the Moon Witch herself.   You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event. Please have yours with with you when you arrive.

title: Milk
subtitle: Old School Essentials GM: Mark Palmer A delve into a mountain containing a lake of pure milk, in order to discover why the production of exquisite chocolates has ceased.
description_full: In the cavernous depths of a mountain lies a lake of pure milk, inhabited by a tribe of peaceful merfolk. Their king and queen, aided by dwarf servants, use the milk to manufacture the most exquisite chocolate truffles in existence. The truffles are said to be so delicious as to soften even the most hardened of hearts. People from all over the world visit the lake to buy these irresistible creations. Recently, truffle production has mysteriously ceased, the dwarves have disappeared, and in nearby cities, scores of disreputable merchants have begun hawking inferior products said to be created in the mountain. Can our heroes uncover the truth about what is going on under the mountain? You will also need a valid UKGE Entry ticket to attend this event.  RPG Event Tickets will go on sale from Monday 2nd February 2026.  More information about running RPGs at UKGE, including support packages, see this page https://www.ukgamesexpo.co.uk/events/running-event/running-an-rpg/

title: Buried in the Bahamas
subtitle: Pirate Borg GM: Martin Wheeler Undead Pirates of the Dark Caribbean
description_full: Pirates! Parrots! Treasure Maps! Sabres! Gold! Magic! Curses! Seagulls with Knives! Harryhausen Skeletons! A bit with a monkey! All of these, and more, are present in this introductory island hopping adventure where you gain possession of a treasure map that promises vast treasure if you can overcome the many challenges that lie in your way. Pirate Borg is a rules-lite game about grog-swilling pirates, undead galleons, arcane treasures found in ancient temples, and high sea adventures. Pregenerated characters, and sweets, provided. Warning : Buckles may be swashed.

title: PFS2 7-06 Brastlewark at War Part 1
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Andrew Bourne The gnomes of Brastlewark in Cheliax can no longer cling to their carefree ways, they need the Pathfinder Society to help! For Characters Lvls 1-4
description_full: With war breaking out, the gnomes of Brastlewark in Cheliax can no longer cling to their carefree ways. Self-proclaimed King Drum Thornfiddle is eager to ingratiate himself to Queen Abrogail, and so conscripts the city's magical and creative resources towards the war effort. A few gnomes have broken free, and they have brought evidence of the various works being created in Brastlewark. They're no fighters, though. title: SFS2 #1-00: Collision's Wake
subtitle: Starfinder GM: Terence Thambipillai A mysterious alien starship crashes into Akiton, pulling you into its dangerous secrets.
description_full: Emerging suddenly from deep space, a massive alien starship has crashed into the surface of the planet Akiton, in an isolated region known as the Sloughscar Hills. Although the starship was traveling at speeds that should have cracked the planet in half, Akiton endured and the fallout was minimal. Within hours, salvagers and explorers the world over race to the wreck, determined to salvage what valuables and technology they can from the mysterious vessel. Believing the starship has a connection to the mysterious First Ones, an advanced civilization from antiquity that the Starfinder Society believes aims to invade the Pact Worlds, the Starfinders hire the nearest team of mercenaries to enter and explore the wreck—you! Overcome dangerous creatures, malfunctioning technology, volatile magic, and opportunistic salvagers in your quest to be the first to explore the Wreck of the Returned! This game is open to all, using 3rd level pre-generated characters, provided by the GM.  GM: Terry T

title: PFS2 7-08 The Haunted Corridor
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Ian McHugh A search of an old Society Lodge, conducting pest control - what could possibly go wrong. A Pathfinder Society Scenario for Character levels 1-4
description_full: This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Pathfinder Organised Play Character. But Pregenerated Character Sheets are also available. As the Pathfinders slowly regain their footing within the elven nation of Kyonin, Venture-Captain Viore Ciobanu has set his sights on cleaning up what remains of Talhindir Lodge. As such, he's requested a small group of Pathfinders to come and assist him with some minor pest control in the basement library and archives within the lodge, and is happy to reassure them that there's no danger greater than a stubborn rat or hungry centipede. However, when the doors shut behind the agents, it quickly becomes all too clear that sometimes empty lodges aren't always as empty as they seem... This scenario contains themes of involuntary imprisonment, blood, and experiencing death. Before we begin will discuss player consent to ensure all are comfortable and enjoy the game. GM - Ian McHugh

title: PFS2 6-05 Silver Bark, Golden Blades
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Thomas Baird When a strange fog cuts off access to a trading village it is up to the Pathfinders to investigate. A PF2e Scenario for characters level 1-4
description_full: Silvertree Village is a small settlement within the Forest of Spirits, not far off the Spirit Road, the trade route tracing the southern coast of the forest. It's a smaller river crossing, but often used when the larger Ohira's inns are full, and some travelers even prefer using it. Or they did, until the found access to it cut off by a mysterious fog. Word has reached the Pathfinder Society of this strange phenomenon, and they have resolved to investigate and resolve the issue, as the Society has also had cause to use Silvertree when transporting relics between Hongal and Minkai. The PCs are tasked with finding out the cause, and before they'll done they'll face challenges put for by a kami themselves, and must learn what has upset this being, and in so doing uncover something much more dangerous. This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Pathfinder Organised Play Character. But Pregenerated Character Sheets are also available. GM: Thomas Baird

subtitle: Battle against all-comers to find the ultimate ruler of Arrakis

title: Crokinole UK - The Great British Flick Off
subtitle: The Crokinole Tournament has become a regular fixture at UK Games Expo and is open to all skill levels!
description_full: Think you’ve got what it takes to win the Great British Flick Off? Step up to the board and prove it at the UK Games Expo’s premier Crokinole showdown! Whether you’re a brand new player or an experienced flicker, this tournament is your chance to test your skills against players from across the country. Crokinole is easy to learn but endlessly addictive — part precision, part strategy, and all about nerves of steel under pressure. title: Rolling for Knowledge With LEGEND
subtitle: Rolling for Knowledge: What Tabletop Games Can Teach Us About Learning Itself
description_full: Games teach us how to play them. Complex rules, layered systems, ethical choices and strategic mastery are learned not through lectures or manuals, but through experimentation, failure, feedback and collaboration. This seminar explores how those same principles are now being deliberately used to support learning far beyond the gaming table. Hosted by the LEGEND (Legal Educational Games: Evaluation, Network, Dissemination) network, this seminar showcases how educators are borrowing the tools of tabletop gaming, role-play and immersive design to teach complex real-world subjects including law, ethics, finance and professional decision-making in ways that are engaging, meaningful, and memorable. Rather than treating games as a novelty or add-on, the session focuses on how game mechanics themselves drive learning. Topics include motivation and player agency, learning through failure, narrative and immersion and the role of choice and consequence. Drawing on examples from escape rooms, role-playing simulations and tabletop-inspired classroom games, speakers will demonstrate how play can transform how people understand systems, rules and responsibility. The session is designed to be…

title: From Play to Practice: Games as Tools for Understanding Neurodiversity and Wellbeing
subtitle: This talk explores how play can be used to understand cognition, identity, and wellbeing.
description_full: This talk presents the games-based research programme developed by Dr Gray Atherton and Dr Liam Cross, which explores how play can be used to understand cognition, identity, and wellbeing, particularly within neurodivergent communities. Bringing together work across experimental psychology, education, and applied design, the talk highlights how games offer unique environments for studying and supporting social and cognitive processes. The session will draw on multiple strands of research, including studies examining the overlap between autism and board gaming, which suggest that structured and rule-based play can offer meaningful spaces for engagement, problem solving, and community. It will also introduce work using Dixit within the PSHE curriculum, demonstrating how games can support communication, perspective taking, and discussion of complex social topics in educational settings. Expanding into applied research, the talk will present the development of the Rolling Well conference as a platform for exploring tabletop role playing games as tools for wellbeing, bringing together researchers, clinicians, educators, and industry collaborators. title: Going Solo: Tabletop Games for One
subtitle: This seminar presents early insights from a batch of semi-structured interviews exploring player experience and practice of solo tabletop gaming
description_full: Solo tabletop gaming has seen a marked rise in popularity since 2020, driven by the broader availability of solo-friendly designs and a vibrant and growing online community that shares playthroughs and recommendations. However, to date, game studies research hasn’t shown much attention to solo play. To try and address this gap Dr Matt Coward-Gibbs (York St John University) and Dr Ryan Scoats (Birmingham City University) have embarked on a project to rectify this! This seminar presents early insights and analysis from semi-structured interviews with solo gamers, focusing on the experiences and practices of playing alone. Alongside sharing some preliminary findings, we hope to create a broader discussion around the value and impact of solo play. Entry to this event is included with your UKGE entry ticket. title: Hive Simul
subtitle: Take part in a simul and play an expert at Hive!
description_full: Simultaneous Exhibitions (aka ‘Simul’) are a well known concept from Chess. A strong player, typically a Grandmaster, plays multiple games at the same time against different opponents. In this event, you can book your ticket to take part in a Hive Simul against Francesco Salerno. Francesco has won three Mind Sports Olympiad tournaments in Hive. He works closely with the publisher to promote Hive all around the world and organised the last two International Hive meetups. The Simul event is open to players of all levels, and will be run by the team behind the Mind Sports Olympiad and PlayStrategy on their stand in Hall 1. Players will be able to choose between playing the base game or with the PLM expansions, and will be able to refer to piece movement sheets throughout the Simul. You can come and learn the game at the stand before the event. You can also try your hand at winning the UKGE Hive tournament by booking your ticket here . Any player who can win against Francesco Salerno will receive free entry to the Mind Sports Olympiad Hive tournament in London in August (precise date TBA). All of the ticket sales, less VAT, will be donated to the 2026 UKGE Charities . You will need a…

title: AH LCG Machinations Through Time
subtitle: Arkham Horror LCG Epic Multiplayer game of Machinations through Time
description_full: Epic Multiplayer game of the extended side scenario Machinations Though Time.  Up to twelve people play in each multiplayer scenario across three intertwined tables. As Arkham Horror LCG goes into Chapter 2 this year take the opportunity to play in a free for all Epic Multiplayer game of Chapter One. Build your deck using Legacy, Taboo or current.  The choice is yours, we do not enforce any restrictions.  Use standalone deck guidance on weaknesses and experience to build the deck that you want to play. We will bring some resources but in order for this to run as effectively as possible it helps us if people can bring (in order of importance) One investigator deck to play  (We'll bring a couple for those who forget, but this is only for extreme cases) An extra investigator deck of two to avoid too much doubling up A copy of the scenario (we will have about three or four of these, so if some people don't bring their own we will have issues) Chaos bag, tokens and resources for your table.  Again, we will have some spares. We hope to offer 3 hours of intense Arkham play for any that it interests.  Can't wait to see you there!

title: 7 Wonders
subtitle: Join MSO for a friendly, non‑elimination 7 Wonders tournament with classic 5‑player gameplay.
description_full: Ready to guide your civilisation to greatness? Join the MSO team for a fast‑paced, welcoming 7 Wonders tournament where every card you draft shapes your military, science, commerce, and wonders. Our non‑elimination format keeps everyone playing throughout the event, matched with opponents of similar ability as you draft cards, develop your city, and adapt to the changing table. After five rounds of competitive civilisation‑building, the player with the highest tournament score will be crowned our champion. Tournament format • 5 players per table • 5 rounds • Base game (no expansions) Full tournament rules and format details are already available on the MSO website: https://mindsportsolympiad.com/uk-games-expo/ For any queries, please contact Mike at mikedixonmso@gmail.com

subtitle: Who Lives? Who Dies? You Decide!
description_full: Who Lives? Who Dies? You Decide! Enter a 12th Century Throne Room, where you decide the fates of two guest performers trying to rule your kingdom. Be peasants, warlords, dragons, or just sit back and cheer for their demise! An interactive comedy game show that merges video games and TTRPG into 100% ridiculous improvized chaos! Hosted by your Royal Advisor Sam See (Comedy Central), and operated by your Jester Boy, Joe Mayo (QI). With devilish new puzzles, terrifying new monsters and as always, a talking wall. Dare you face the perils of Knightmare?   Sidestep left into adventure as dungeon master Treguard invites you to join the award-winning, live action, fantasy gameshow where you finally might get the chance to wear the iconic Helmet of Justice and take on Lord Fear’s army of goblins, spinning blades and tricky word puzzles. (do book ahead, the UKGE shows always sell out!) ★★★★★ "Spellcasting A-W-E-S-O-M-E" INDEPENDENT   ★★★★★ TIME OUT “A nostalgic dream come true!”   Live Entertainment tickets will go on sale Monday 19th January   You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event.

Ben and Lynne will showcase how to design mysteries, and the audience will provide their ideas to make it happen! Entry to this event is included with your UKGE entry ticket. title: BattleTech - Aces: Scouring Sands
subtitle: Can you “beat the bot”, and save Apolakkia from the card deck controlled Jade Falcon remnants in the Hinterlands of 3152?
description_full: Scouring Sands The Jade Falcon push to Terra for the IlClan Trial tore through many of the worlds of the Inner Sphere region known as the Hinterlands. Left behind and abandoned due to his clan's frantic dash, a remnant Jade Falcon Star Captain stands in the way of the nearby Alyina Mercantile League. The AML cannot abide this, and has sent out the call for enterprising mercenaries. This is a BattleTech Aces: Scouring Sands game using the Alpha Strike quick play ruleset, alongside CGL's new pilot ability Edge cards. The player group controls a small mercenary force against the card deck controlled remnant of Mongol Doctrine following Jade Falcons on the world of Apolakkia, before they can commit vicious reprisals against the civilians living under their cruel talons. Use this as an opportunity to see CGL's new Edge Abilities to dictate the flow of battle and “beat the Bot” as Aces: Scouring Sands hits UK stores! Please note whilst UK BattleTech events are suitable in content for  younger players, children must be accompanied by a guardian whilst playing.   You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event.

title: War With A Mate
subtitle: War With A Mate Podcast's first live show - Join Andy & James as they discuss playing the infamous SPI's Campaign For North Africa board game.
description_full: Do YOU want to spend the next 50 years of your life trying to finish a single board game? Of course not, that’s ridiculous - which is why we’re doing it for you! Come one, come all to War With A Mate, where Andy and James decided 10 years of friendship is just cause to try and finish the infamous and gargantuan “SPI’s The Campaign For North Africa”, a board game with no recorded completions. Armed with whimsy, tangents, historical context on the war and their (one day) patented “Common Ground” segment, these two STILL don’t have a snowball’s chance in hell. Enter their first live show, as they discuss the perils of playing such a game, their misadventures along the way, and the cracking of their voices as they hold back tears at the thought of their wasted future. Entry to this event is included with your UKGE entry ticket. Please have yours with you when you attend, or you will be refused entry.  There are no reserved seating for this event, please arrive early and enjoy the wonderful British tradition of queuing to avoid disappointment.

title: Running inclusive community events and groups
subtitle: Meet other community and event organisers and share knowledge
description_full: Meet other board game community and event leaders to share problems, ideas and discuss best practices on running inclusive and accessible events. This is a workshop, a chance to chat and share ideas rather than a presentation.  Hosted by Herefordshire Board Gamers / Here for Games and this is our  fifth year running this event and our feedback has been excellent with amazing ideas being shared and problems solved. https://herefor.games is a not for profit gaming community which has raised over £34, 000 for charity since 2017 https://herefor.games/knowledge is our knowledge base, including guides, articles and policies. We welcome guest writers and volunteers to help grow it.

subtitle: Come join us for another wild and incredible experience at the Games on Demand Tables.
description_full: Come join us for another wild and incredible experience at the Games on Demand Tables.    Want to try some new roleplaying games?   Or have never roleplayed before?   We welcome people of all levels of experience and interest. Just pick a time slot, take a seat at a table, and our Games Masters will present you with fantastic worlds to explore, enhance, and even if you're feeling up to it, exploit.   We run two hour long games… On the Hour! Every Hour!   Expect games of (but not limited to): Atma , Mouseritter, Feather and bone, Decaying orbit, Lead & Gold, The Score, Killshot, Fist and Nimble, SLA Industries, Dragonbane, Imperium Maledictum, White Star, Black Hack, Root, PTBA, FATE, Black Code, and many more!   If you've never GM'd before and want to try, Games on Demand is a great place to start, and the Games on Demand team can help with feedback on your session too. title: PFS Special The Kaiju Crisis (for levels 1-2)
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Ian Hawthorne A kaiju has been kidnapped by an evil cult and it's up to the Pathfinders to put a stop to their plans.
description_full: PFS Special #7-99 The Kaiju Crisis The centipede queen kaiju has gone missing, leaving a trail of destruction in her path, but everything feels strange. Amara Li, venture-captain of the Lantern Lodge in Tian Xia, calls upon the Society for assistance in not only investigating the disappearance of the kaiju, but also in the uptick of strange cult activity. It's not long before the Pathfinders realize that not only was this monstrous cult stealing one kaiju, but they plan to lure another on a rampage across the Shanguang Desert and beyond! This is a Pathfinder Society multitable special. Where several tables of adventures all work together towards a common goal.  These tables are for low level character levels 1-2. You can bring your own Pathfinder Society Characters or use a provided pregen character.  Everyone welcome.    There are other tables available for this event:  Level 3 -4 https://www.ukgamesexpo.co.uk/events/3299-pfs-special-the-kaiju-crisis-for-levels-3-4/ Level 5 - 6  https://www.ukgamesexpo.co.uk/events/3300-pfs-special-the-kaiju-crisis-for-levels-5-6/ Level 7 - 8 -You must bring your own legal Pathfinder Society Characters to join this table. …

title: STA: The Hunt For April Bozeman
subtitle: 2d20 GM: Jonathon Hocker Age Restrictions: 15+ A veteran captain has gone rogue! Can you find her and bring her home before disaster strikes?
description_full: Captain Madhusudhan has gone rogue. Contact with the U.S.S. April Bozeman was lost just two days after Madhusudhan took command, last seen on a course for the Neutral Zone. A missing ship and crew is bad enough, but the April Bozeman is Starfleet's most advanced cruiser: if it falls into the wrong hands, disaster may swiftly follow… This is a Star Trek Adventures game set in the 2280s (the red tunic era) where up to six players must lead the mission to find and recover a renegade captain and her ship. There will be an exciting mix of intrigue and action, exploring a narrative of loss, grief, duty and loyalty. This game will have plenty of scope for fun and adventure, but is aimed at more mature (15+) players who are comfortable thoughtfully immersing themselves in a role and exploring some meaningful topics with sincerity. Each player will be able to choose from a range of pre-generated characters at the start of the game.

title: Blood on the Clocktower - Live
subtitle: Whether you’re a Clockers expert or new to the game, there’s guaranteed laughter and nonsense aplenty!
description_full: Welcome to the town of Ravenswood Bluff, where the world’s most grizzly sinners are dragged to do battle for what remains of their shattered souls…in this comedy gameshow by the creators of Werewolf: Live, in association with The Pandemonium Institute!  5 board game comedians enter, one is the demon, one is the minion, the rest are townsfolk trying to figure out how their information makes sense and how to convince the rest of the group that they’re innocent, before the demon kills them. Plus comedy! It’s high-stakes gothic social deduction silliness on stage using a boiled down Teensyville Clocktower script, as well as characters modified for the live show by Steven Medway to produce maximum carnage on stage as our brave townsfolk battle for their lives, attempt to stop the demon, and most importantly, try to figure out who’s drunk (too many sherries!!) Whether you’re a Clockers expert or new to the game, there’s guaranteed laughter and nonsense aplenty as our brave players try to figure out who is what – ably assisted by their fabulous, purple-suited storyteller (Jon Gracey), and you, the audience, his loyal acolytes…   Live Entertainment tickets will go on sale Monday 19th…

title: The Thin Purple Line
subtitle: Peacekeepers GM: Adam Taylor Crime-fighting capers in a fantasy city. A combat-free, rules-light, light-hearted game of investigations, action, and (mis)adventure.
description_full: Crime-fighting capers in a fantasy city. A combat-free, rules-light, light-hearted game of investigations, action, and (mis)adventure. Accessible to new players but just as suited to old-hands looking for something a bit different. The celebration by Arcanopolis' elven community of the centenary of their victory in the Kobold War is likely to be a tense affair. Not least because many of the city's kobold citizens maintain that it was their ancestors who won the War of the Elves. It's the task of the Peacekeepers to ensure that the tribute doesn't become a re-enactment.

title: Your Adventure Awaits | Roll Britannia
subtitle: Have your say in how this unique adventure unfolds in an improvised oneshot where the audience can change the show faster than a mimic chest attacks
description_full: Your Adventure Awaits is an Audience-Led Improv D&D One-Shot from the cast of Roll Britannia. Have your say in how this unique adventure unfolds in an improvised oneshot where the audience can change the show faster than Yallan mops a carpet... Join the cast of Roll Britannia for an adventure that has never been played before, whilst the players set forth on a quest for adventure, what awaits them in the darkest of dungeons? A goblin? A tarrasque? Or perhaps it's just Bob the farmer on his way home? Will there be treasure, and will the players' magic items behave as expected? With opportunities to influence the game like never before, this improvised one-shot is not to be missed! Roll Britannia Bio:  Roll Britannia is a British DnD 5e comedy actual play about pirates, heists, and very questionable plans that somehow work. Story first, jokey, rules light, with sharp improv, punchy combat, and a big warm found family vibe. If you like British comedy, Dungeons and Dragons, and seafaring shenanigans that keeps paying off, you’re in the right place. Meet the crew, Tom as Keth Frostiron, Paul as M.Tosscobble, Chip as Jeff Silverbow, Alex as Derek Normalbeard, and Sophie as River, with…

title: Disney Lorcana On-Demand Constructed Events
subtitle: Join us for our Disney Lorcana On-Demand Constructed Side Events, Hosted by OPE.
description_full: 🌐 Disney Lorcana On-Demand Constructed Side Events UKGE, Birmingham UK Presented by Organized Play Events May 29th,30th & 31st 2026 Hello, Illumineers of Europe! Organized Play Events is proud to bring Lorcana Constructed Side Events to the legendary  UK Games Expo!  Join us at the National Exhibition Centre In Birmingham for a weekend of high-stakes competition, community, and unforgettable adventure! title: Wingspan
subtitle: Join MSO for a friendly, non‑elimination Wingspan tournament with classic 3‑player gameplay.
description_full: Ready to attract the most impressive wildlife to your habitats? Join the MSO team for a fast‑paced, welcoming Wingspan tournament where every bird you play shapes your scoring opportunities and tactical choices. Our non‑elimination format keeps everyone involved throughout the qualifying rounds, matched with opponents of similar ability as you build habitats, manage food and eggs, and create powerful card combinations. After three qualifying rounds, the top three players will advance to the grand final, where one competitor will take the title. Tournament format • 3 players per table • 3 qualifying rounds • Grand final for top 3 • Base game (no expansions) Full tournament rules and format details are already available on the MSO website: https://mindsportsolympiad.com/uk-games-expo/ For any queries, please contact Mike at mikedixonmso@gmail.com

title: Leaders Tournament
subtitle: Join us for a friendly Leaders tournament for a chance to win Hachette BGUK Store Credit!
description_full: Leaders is an intense tactical and strategic duel, perfect for fans of chess, drafting and abstract games. Recruit characters with unique abilities during each turn. Smartly move your team on the board (no character elimination). Make the best use of your characters' skills to capture the opposing Leader. During each game, build your team of 5 unique characters in order to capture the opposing Leader. Watch a How To Play Video Or Visit the Hachette Board Games stand (2-416) for a demo! Registration: 9:30am Start time: 10:00am Format: Swiss Rounds* with a Top Cut** Structure: 1v1  Best of 3 matches Prizes: Winner: £50 store credit at the Hachette Boardgames UK Stand (2-416) Runner Up: £25 store credit at the Hachette Boardgames UK Stand (2-416) 3rd & 4th Place: £15 store credit at the Hachette Boardgames UK Stand (2-416) *A Swiss Tournament means players will be paired against each other and play a number of rounds without direct elimination. The number of rounds will depend on the total number of players. The results of the Swiss Rounds will culminate in a Top Cut. ** Top Cut: direct elimination rounds to decide the winner.

title: Flabbergasted
subtitle: Flabbergasted GM: Michelle Barbour The club president has been hornswoggled by a grifter posing as a prince! Now you’re all in a jam unless you can get that cheddar back.
description_full: I say, old boy, bit of bother at the club.  The president has only gone and invested all the readies in some get rich quick scheme involving a movie star, a mystic and a prince who has promised him half a pyramid. We’ll be in a jam until we can get that scratch back. Flabbergasted is a comedic, narrative driven game set in the roaring 20's where players take on the roll of an aristocrat, a bohemian, a well-to-do or a member of staff. Together you are all members of the same social club dealing with cocktail parties, family luncheons, rival clubs and all manner of hijinks - adventures all in the style of Jeeves and Wooster. Game uses D6s and characters and the theme of the social club will be created at the table.

title: PFS2 #7-16: A Star's Journey
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Mark Price When a unique automaton goes missing during the exploration of an ancient Jistkan ruin, the Pathfinders are called in to investigate.
description_full: During the exploration of an ancient Jistkan ruin in Katapesh, the automaton Star goes missing, leaving their archeologist companions worried for their safety. The head archeologist calls upon the Pathfinder Society for assistance, but warns the agents that arrive that the ruin is filled with dangerous creatures and traps and that they should be careful while exploring. A strange frozen automaton meets the Pathfinders on each floor, slowly pointing the way deeper and deeper into the ruin. Will they find Star? Or does the automaton have more malicious motives? A Pathfinder Society adventure for 1st-2nd level characters. This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Pathfinder Organised Play Character, but Pregenerated Character Sheets are also available. GM: Mark Price

title: SFS2 #1-10 Rites Of Rekindling
subtitle: Starfinder 2e GM: Philip Lucas Age Restrictions: 12+ A Starfinder Society adventure for Character levels 1-2
description_full: Deep in the Vast, the dying star Sota has miraculously rekindled, bathing the frozen planet Lajok in glorious light and blessing thousands of the planet’s inhabitants with a solar spark. As scientists and skeptics ponder this inexplicable twist of fate, vlakas the galaxy over undertake the sojourn home to witness this miracle for themselves and celebrate Sota’s revival. Thanks to a coincidental meeting, the Starfinder Society has been invited to participate in one such celebration: the Rekindling Festival in Sour Spring. When strange occurrences and a missing relic cast a shadow over the celebrations, it’s up to the Starfinders to investigate. Is someone to blame for Sour Spring’s misfortunes, or is Rekindling cursed? Written by Hilary Moon Murphy.   Pre-generated characters are available.

title: Corvum Council's call for Adventure
subtitle: Dungeons and Dragons 5th Edition GM: Kathryn Reeve A Humblewood (animals of farthingwood meets D&D) 5e (2014) adventure
description_full: The local Corvum council have raised a call for a party of 5 great (they hope) adventuring humblefolk to investigate a monstrous disturbance at the local Humblewood farm. Your team of humblefolk will need to investigate what is happening and why are the Corvum Council so afraid that they can't take action themselves. A 1shot adventure for 5 lvl 5 characters within the humblewood campaign setting - https://humblewood.com. Pregens provided, no outside characters

title: PFS2 6-10 Once in Whispers
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Steven Blease When the Society needs to deal with on-the-spot decisions, it sends seasoned agents to deal with the problem. For character levels 5-8.
description_full: On the border of Numeria and Ustalav, there sits an abandoned manor filled with strange technology and shuffling undead named the Crushed Meteor. Once a stronghold of the Technic League, it has fallen into the hands of the Whispering Way and the Pathfinder Society has successfully lobbied with Kevoth-Kul to finally handle the building and exterminate those within. However, a leader of the Whispering Way sits inside the building, considering its many secrets and offers the Pathfinders a choice: let her finish her research and gain information on an enemy, or perish. It's up to the agents within to make a choice that may sacrifice the values of the Society for valuable knowledge! This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Pathfinder Organised Play Character, but Pregenerated Character Sheets are also available.  GM: Steve Blease

title: PFS2 7-01: Intro to Year of Battle’s Spark
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: James David Fridd The Pathfinder Society joins forces with Andora in its war against Cheliax for democracy. A Pathfinder 2e Scenario for characters level 1-4
description_full: Hellknight forces have forcibly taken over Citadel Altaerein, the abandoned Hellknight citadel on the edge of Breachill, a small town in Isger, while also leading a reign of terror on the innocent civilians and the leadership alike. The Eagle Knights of Andoran have called upon the Pathfinder Society for backup while they handle the citadel, requesting that they rescue the civilians and prevent any unneeded harm. While the Pathfinders are moving throughout the town, they learn of a secret way into the citadel, and though it's not without its dangers and threats, they could learn so much from the enemy... This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Pathfinder Organised Play Character. But Pregenerated Character Sheets are also available. GM: James Fridd

title: Heroic Deeds - Exploring the Verdant Wilds
subtitle: Heroic Deeds GM: Peter Lattimore Age Restrictions: 18+ Experience all four play pillars of this new goal-based heroic fantasy dungeon delving RPG!
description_full: WELCOME ADVENTURER! Heroic Deeds is a goal-based heroic fantasy role-playing game with an old-school aesthetic, but modern mechanics and d12 dice pools. It’s about building your legend, exploring unknown lands, locating strange ruins, and delving into dangerous dungeons. This session will give you a taste of all elements of play of this new game. What is the adventure? You stand on the edge of the Verdant Wilds, a huge magic-infused forest that covers the remnants of the ancient dwarven city of Bargdumir. The civil war has just ended and the lord of Emberwatch has recruited troops of adventurers to head out into the wilds to reclaim the lost magi-tech of the dwarves for the nation of Pargranin. Your party will begin their adventure at Emberwatch with a DOWNTIME action before undertaking a JOURNEY to a distant Adventure Location. There they will EXPLORE the dungeon below avoiding hazards and obstacles to clear the location. And who knows, there might just be the odd bit of COMBAT to test your hero's mettle. You'll get to change the world you explore by applying RUMOURS to the Adventure Location you select as your destination. You'll select one of four locations to investigate. What…

title: BattleTech - Alpha Strike BTCC Tournament
subtitle: Three round Alpha Strike Tournament using BTCC Rules at 400PV
description_full: Cunningly build your 400PV Alpha Strike list, lovingly paint your BattleTech mini's, then bring them to a symphony of competition destruction against all comers, and maybe take home a prize trophy - or will you receive the much coveted (3d printed) Wooden Spoon? Players engage in a no holds barred Alpha Strike tournament, with 3 Games over the course of the Sunday, using the BTCC tournament ruleset. Each game will be 90 minutes long. Players will have random pairings for the first round, then Swiss Pairs for later.  The BTCC  Tournament format can  be downloaded here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1R6oD0dZZVDunO97zk3jmFbAr7BAGZaKg/view?usp=drivesdk     For rules  clarification Formations are not used in BTCC, nor are SCA's. SPA's may be allocated to up to 25% of your force according to skill level as outlined in AS:CE *Wooden Spoon is 3d printed and for display purposes only, and not to be used for cooking! Please note whilst UK BattleTech events are suitable in content for  younger players, children must be accompanied by a guardian whilst playing. You will also need a valid UKGE Entry ticket to attend this event.

title: BattleTech Gothic - Against the Beasts
subtitle: Hunt the enemy down using your small team of Mechs and Abominations - but who hunts the hunters?
description_full: The universe of BattleTech: Gothic is bleak indeed. With the Endless War constantly raging, the Human Sphere has little hope to spare. Amalgamations of flesh and metal, known as Abominations, stalk the battle lines of the Great Realms as BattleMechs dominate the field. Players will take a small team of BattleMechs and Abominations to hunt down enemy stragglers in their rightful lands - but beware who hunts the hunters, because the MechWarriors and Abominations on the other side consider this their rightful clay, and will hunt you in turn. A first hand look at CGL's first BattleTech Continuum release, and a chance to pit yourself against in combat with and against it's awful twisted denizens whilst piloting familiar but subtly different Battlemechs. Please note whilst UK BattleTech events are suitable in content for  younger players, children must be accompanied by a guardian whilst playing.   You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event.

title: BattleTech - Alpha Strike:  Drafted For War
subtitle: Players will draft blindly from Salvage Boxes to build a force. Players then take their force and play in a tournament to win fabulous prizes!
description_full: Drafted for War is a fast paced Alpha Strike tournament of three rounds, each of a 45 minute battle on a preset 36" by 24" battlefield. Initial opponents are random, followed by a Swiss Pairing style draw for later rounds. Your force will consist of three BattleMechs drafted from Salvage boxes, which you will keep at the end of the tournament after leading them to victory (or death). A working knowledge of Alpha Strike is advisable but young or old, veteran or rookie, this is a brilliant event to dip your toes into the tournament scene as the focus is on fun and firepower! Win first place and take home a large scale BattleMech model as prize; the loser will receive the much coveted 3d printed Wooden Spoon*. The player pack for the event can be found here Please note whilst UK BattleTech events are suitable in content for  younger players, children must be accompanied by a guardian whilst playing. *Note 3d printed wooden spoon is for display purposes only and not for cooking

title: Age of Vikings - Charity Game in the Viking Village
subtitle: Age of Viking RPG Play Chaosium's Age of Viking RPG surrounded by VIKINGS!
description_full: Join Chaosium's GMs and Ardenweard 's viking re-enactors for an immersive RPG experience! Brave players will need to head to the Viking Villiage outside the NEC on Pendigo Lake, and make themselves known, so they can take part in one of the following scenarios:   Age of Vikings, scenario title: Belly of the Beast   Description :   You were so close. After a months-long journey, you had nearly made it home when the storm struck, swift and sudden. Despite your crew's best efforts, your tiny boat, intended only for travel along the coastal shallows, was swept out into deeper waters, helpless against rapidly shifting currents, whorls and eddies that seemed to shift and change to draw you ever further away from home. Then danger turned into a nightmare. A heavy, foul-smelling mist settled over the sea even as the waters calmed and you found yourselves, desperate for shelter and reprieve, rowing toward an unfamiliar island. No sooner had you drawn close than the fjord's waters began to churn and shift and you were swallowed by the sea itself. The last thing you saw before you lost consciousness was the jaws of a massive, terrifying beast swallowing your crew and boat whole.     Age of…

title: Games in Education
subtitle: Games in Education Academic Track
description_full: If you are designing, using or adapting games for learning this event is for you. You are welcome to take part in any or all of it.  10.30 Welcome and introduction 10:40 Speakers from both Industry and Higher Education will talk about the shifts, trends and developments we have seen in Games for Education over the last year. 11.30 The Fishbowl or Unpanel: Can table-top games save the world? This unconference format allows everyone to get involved, ask and answer questions, or bring examples from their work  We will start with a panel of our original speakers, and open up to anyone who wants to take the floor. We expect a lively discussion about what matters in board game design for well-being, community-building, education and research, and in the spaces between 12:20 Break and reset the room 12.30 Mixer and "Show your work". title: AH LCG: War of the Outer Gods
subtitle: Arkham Horror LCG Epic Multiplayer Game of War of the Outer Gods
description_full: Epic Multiplayer game of the side scenario of War of the Outer Gods.  Which cult will come out on top?  Or will the investigators stop the summoning?  All tables work together to intercept and stop the cults. As Arkham Horror LCG goes into Chapter 2 this year take the opportunity to play in a free for all Epic Multiplayer game of Chapter One. Build your deck using Legacy, Taboo or current.  The choice is yours, we do not enforce any restrictions.  Use standalone deck guidance on weaknesses and experience to build the deck that you want to play. We will bring some resources but in order for this to run as effectively as possible it helps us if people can bring (in order of importance) One investigator deck to play  (We'll bring a couple for those who forget, but this is only for extreme cases) An extra investigator deck of two to avoid too much doubling up A copy of the scenario (we will have about three or four of these, so if some people don't bring their own we will have issues) Chaos bag, tokens and resources for your table.  Again, we will have some spares. We hope to offer 3 hours of intense Arkham play for any that it interests.  Can't wait to see you there!

title: Chess Simul
subtitle: Take part in a simul and play an expert at Chess!
description_full: Simultaneous Exhibitions (aka ‘Simul’) are a novel format where a strong player plays multiple games at the same time against different opponents. In this event, you can book your ticket to take part in a Chess Simul against Etan Ilfeld. Etan is a US Chess Federation National Chess Master, and the inventor of Diving Chess. The Simul event is open to players of all levels, and will be run by the team behind the Mind Sports Olympiad and PlayStrategy on their stand in Hall 1. Any player who can win against Etan Ilfeld will receive free entry to a Mind Sports Olympiad non-prize Chess tournament in London in August (precise tournaments and dates TBA). You can come and practise Chess and meet Etan at the stand before the event. All of the ticket sales, less VAT, will be donated to the 2026 UKGE Charities . You will need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event.

title: Juliette Burton: Villain Era (Work In Progress)
subtitle: Calling all late-night legends, dungeon-crawling romantics, and big-hearted heroes! Juliette Burton is summoning YOU.
description_full: As the sun sets, a new hero awakens. Calling all late-night legends, dungeon-crawling romantics, and big-hearted heroes! Juliette Burton is summoning YOU. This after-dark work in progress comedy confessional steps into the dark side.    A brand new, adult comedy quest for grown-up geeks and justice-hungry joy seekers ready to battle the REAL dragons: sexism, queer inequality and bad sex lives. It’s time to iron out the kinks!   Expect deep comic book lore, dark jokes and emotionally naked comedy. An exclusive from award-winning comedian and super nerd Juliette Burton. She’s bringing armour made of hard truths, high fantasy and highly hilarious punchlines. Live nerdgasms possible. Live Entertainment tickets will go on sale Monday 19th January   You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event

title: Big Table: State of the Industry talk
subtitle: Analysing the state of the tabletop industry in the UK and worldwide
description_full: Join people from all sectors and levels of the British and Irish games industry to discuss the last year for tabletop games businesses, the successes and failures, the hurdles and problems, and what lies ahead for 2027 and beyond. This panel is hosted by Big Table, the trade body for the games industry in Britain and Ireland, and is aimed primarily at people working in games, although we welcome everyone with an interest in the subject.  You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event.

title: BattleTech - Grinder
subtitle: Put your piloting skills to the test across the weekend in an ever deadlier series of Battlemechs, respawning in a new ride when knocked out.
description_full: BattleTech Grinder The BattleTech Grinder is a casual, competitive event great for all ability levels where players pilot one mech at a time.  The idea of the Grinder is that players start with a simple, small mech that uses basic weapons and rules. When you die you get a bigger, better mech as it were that has increasingly more complicated and powerful weapons and rules.  This way players are introduced to the vast rules of tabletop Battletech over time. The event runs throughout the weekend, and players are encouraged to book more than one session - you will receive a slip confirming your kills and current ride when you leave a session, and can pick right back up from there when you play again!  All miniatures and record sheets are provided, just bring yourself and a friendly willingness to get stuck in to some heavy metal mayhem. Please note whilst UK BattleTech events are suitable in content for  younger players, children must be accompanied by a guardian whilst playing.   You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event.
