title: Gwent: The Legendary Card Game Tournament
subtitle: Join us for a friendly Gwent tournament for a chance to win Hachette BGUK Store Credit!
description_full: Celebrate 10 years of legendary strategy with the official physical edition of Gwent: The Legendary Card Game — faithfully recreated in collaboration with CD PROJEKT RED . A game originally designed by Rafał Jaki and Damien Monnier. Inspired by the iconic mini-game from The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt , this premium boxed set brings the beloved digital experience to the tabletop, offering high-stakes battles of wit, power, and cunning between five iconic factions: ⚔️ Northern Realms 🌿 Scoia’tael 👹 Monsters 💀 Skellige 🕵️ Nilfgaard With its easy-to-learn, hard-to-master ruleset, Gwent is accessible for newcomers yet rich in tactical depth for seasoned strategists. Build your deck, pick your moment to pass, and outmanoeuvre your opponent to secure victory over two out of three rounds.  How It Works: Players choose a faction. Each turn, play one card to the battlefield or pass. The player with the highest total Strength at the end of a round wins it. Lose a round, lose a gem. Lose all your gems, and it’s game over. Watch a How To Play Video Or Visit the Hachette Board Games stand (2-416) for a demo! Registration: 12:30pm Start time: 1:00pm Format: Swiss Rounds* with a Top Cut** Structure:…

title: Games on Demand
subtitle: Come join us for another wild and incredible experience at the Games on Demand Tables.
description_full: Come join us for another wild and incredible experience at the Games on Demand Tables.    Want to try some new roleplaying games?   Or have never roleplayed before?   We welcome people of all levels of experience and interest. Just pick a time slot, take a seat at a table, and our Games Masters will present you with fantastic worlds to explore, enhance, and even if you're feeling up to it, exploit.   We run two hour long games… On the Hour! Every Hour!   Expect games of (but not limited to): Atma , Mouseritter, Feather and bone, Decaying orbit, Lead & Gold, The Score, Killshot, Fist and Nimble, SLA Industries, Dragonbane, Imperium Maledictum, White Star, Black Hack, Root, PTBA, FATE, Black Code, and many more!   If you've never GM'd before and want to try, Games on Demand is a great place to start, and the Games on Demand team can help with feedback on your session too. If you would like to take part in this event as a Games Master please email rpgs@ukgamesexpo.co.uk More information about running RPGs at UKGE, including support packages, see this page https://www.ukgamesexpo.co.uk/events/running-event/running-an-rpg/    You will need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this…

title: John Robertson: The Gaming Special (Work in Progress)
subtitle: New show for 2026! Stand-up! Gaming! More swearing than you’d expect at one in the afternoon!
description_full: New show for 2026! John Robertson’s got some new jokes about gaming, and he’d be honoured if you’d let him try them out on you! John’s working on a stand-up special about videogames and boardgames and card games and his favourite game which we can’t name here (here’s a hint, you can fit a surprisingly large amount of players in there, but my god you’ll need to stretch first.) Come along and have a wild time watching a loving stand-up roast of videogames, TTRPGs, geek culture, neurodiversity, and most of all, see an extremely excitable man with ADHD do everything he can to stay on topic, get off topic and once again do a deeply entertaining show that wasn’t the one he came here to test.   ★★★★ “A punk rock Robin Williams” – Fringesider  ★★★★ “A force of nature” – Daily Telegraph  ★★★★★ Starburst Magazine  ★★★★ “If one were inclined to wager on rising stars of British comedy circuitry, it would be prudent to secure tickets now- before some Taskmaster-type programme claims him for mainstream fame and his star becomes unreachable. Sit in the front row if you can; you’ll want to say ‘oh yes, I saw him when…’” The Reviews Hub Over 18s only   Live Entertainment tickets will go on sale…

title: £1000 GIVEAWAY!
subtitle: UK Games Expo is giving away £1000 every day at the show! Get here for 1:30pm PROMPT or miss your chance!
description_full: UK Games Expo are delighted to announce that we will be giving away £1000 everyday at the show!   Each day we will be placing a series of posters around the halls. All you have to do is take a selfie with these posters and upload your selfie to your Instagram page!    To be in with a change to win, please read below - Enter the halls at the UK Games Expo 2026 Look for the 2m high standees displaying the £1000 Giveaway slogan. Take a selfie with the standee behind you clearly in view. Upload your image to Instagram. Use the hashtags #1000giveaway and #ukgamesexpo . Make sure you are following @ukgamesexpo as well. Post it onto your Instagram profile. A virtual raffle ticket will be issued to your account on the UK Games Expo website. (Limited to one per account) Don't have an account? Well, it's easy to create. Register your account before you visit the show or at the show via our website or progressive app. On each day of your visit, head to the Main Stage in hall 1 where the draw will promptly commence at 1:30 pm . Once participants are in place, we will draw a physical raffle ticket. This will correspond with a virtual ticket that someone may have in their portal for that day.…

title: Flesh and Blood TCG New Player Experience
subtitle: A curated experience with everything you need to know to play in Flesh and Blood tournaments
description_full: There has never been a better time to join the tournament scene of Flesh and Blood.  With the introduction of Silver Age and the Chapter decks, for £15 you will not only get to grips with a competitive event format with our experts, but also walk away with your very own deck that is ready to compete at your local game store and beyond.   Don't be afraid if you're new to the game, or haven't played for a while. Where here to support you and you should feel free to stop by the Flesh and Blood booth (4-402) to learn more or get a refresher on the game before taking part in this event.   Your experience will start with the Welcome deck and after that, you will play a game a Chapter Deck. These are full tournament decks that will allow you to discover more about the game and the play styles available. After this game you select your Hero to take home with you.   Finally, we have a round of Crack, Shuffle Play with our Mastery booster pack.  All you need to do is Crack open the packs, shuffle the cards together, and play the game.  It is that simple and a great way to experience new cards and game play. This event includes:1 Welcome deck for you to keep1 Silver Age Chapter Deck for you…

title: The Magnus Archives TTRPG Live Play
subtitle: Take on the mysteries of the Archives in this live play of The Magnus Archives Roleplaying Game, winner of UKGE’s Best Tabletop Game Award 2025!
description_full: Take on the mysteries of the Archives in this live play session of The Magnus Archives Roleplaying Game,  the record breaking TTRPG based on the world’s most popular horror podcast! Join players from gaming and podcast titans Monte Cook Games, Indie Boards and Cards and Rusty Quill as they examine what lurks in the Archives of the Magnus Institute, an organisation dedicated to researching the esoteric and the weird.   Powered by the Cypher System, The Magnus Archives Roleplaying Game  will challenge and terrify players and audience alike, with an expert Monte Cook GM guiding our investigators through the Archives, as they dig into the supernatural and attempt to hold back the machinations of entities that threaten humanity. Because when you stare into the Archives, something starts to stare back… Entry to this event is included with your UKGE entry ticket. Please have yours with you when you attend, or you will be refused entry.  There are no reserved seating for this event, please arrive early and enjoy the wonderful British tradition of queuing to avoid disappointment.

title: BattleTech - Urby Derby
subtitle: A free for all respawning death match in a shifting arena, where everyone pilots the ultimate warmachine - the fearsome Urbanmech!
description_full: URBY DERBY 2026  "Welcome 'Mech Combat Fans to the Steiner Arena for this Year's Beloved Urby Derby! Those lovable little tin cans with a kick are back in force this year, and the match officials tell me that there will be some unique tactical options this year. So roll on up, place your bets (with credited Solaris Officials obviously) and if you're brave enough, jump into one of these awesome little machines and test your mettle and luck!"  This event is open for up to eight players. You should be familiar with the basics of BattleTech, but help will be available for newer players. Included is a bespoke card system which changes the battle from moment to moment and offers advantages and tactical options. Each player will pilot an Urbanmech in the Steiner Arena with it's shifting walls and pillars, counting their kills and respawning for revenge when their mech is knocked out, in a fast paced free for all where no one is out the action for even a minute. Please note whilst UK BattleTech events are suitable in content for  younger players, children must be accompanied by a guardian whilst playing.   You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event.

title: Shadowrun Takedown: The search for  Archangel
subtitle: A Shadowrun themed co-op timed miniature based boardgame for 1-4 players; in between runs, players can resupply using their ill-gotten gains.
description_full: A simple milk run in return for info on your missing friend. That's how it started. But nobody expected just how far this would escalate and what monsters you'd encounter. Play the first runs of the Shadowrun: Takedown campaign, a Co-op timed boardgame for 1-4 players. Inbetween runs, players can resupply using their ill-gotten gains. In Shadowrun: Takedown, players perform a variety of missions in real-time rounds, trying to reach their objective and get back out before the cavalry arrives. Each mission can be played by itself, or as part of a branching campaign, resupplying in between runs as the runners try to find their missing friend. Please note whilst events run by UK BattleTech, including Shadowrun: Takedown, are suitable in content for younger players, children must be accompanied by a guardian whilst playing.     You will also need a valid UKGE entry ticket to attend this event.

title: Quinns Quest: Play to Find Out... LIVE!
subtitle: Come watch Quinns try and GM a notorious old TTRPG!
description_full: In Play to Find Out , the acclaimed podcast from Quinns Quest, Quinns and his friends blow the dust off the ancient TTRPGs of yesteryear and mostly discover that those designers were cooking.  Come along and watch Quinns and players Emily Johnson and Rob Morgan suavely master bizarre dice systems, problematic content, and landing a story in just over one hour.   Entry to this event is included with a valid UKGE entry ticket, please have yours with you when you attend.  There are limited seats available for this event, please arrive early and enjoy the British tradition of queuing politely, to avoid disappointment

title: Pin Collective Swap!
subtitle: Start your collection. Find your favourites. Join the Pin Collective.
description_full: Designed exclusively for UK Games Expo, the Pin Collective offers attendees the chance to discover, collect, and trade unique enamel pins created especially for the event. Each participating exhibitor has designed their own exclusive pin, which are available only from their stand across the show weekend.   Whether you're an avid pin collector or simply looking for a memorable keepsake from this year’s Expo, the Pin Collective is a fun and engaging way to explore the event, meet new people, and take home something truly special.   Start your collection. Find your favourites. Join the Pin Collective.   Join us every afternoon to swap with other Pin Collective members, and complete your set! Find out more about the Pin Collective here h ttps://www.ukgamesexpo.co.uk/whats-on/show/the-pin-collective/

title: The Bleakwater Blackhole
subtitle: Dungeons and Dragons 5th Edition GM: James Anderson Age Restrictions: 12+ A fun D&D 5e adventure (inc. 2024 rules), set in a demonically influenced subterranean prison.
description_full: The Bleakwater Blackhole is an adventure for characters levels 5-8. Character sheets are provided, however, if a player wants to bring their own character, that's fine too! The story revolves around the wrongful imprisonment of the characters in an ancient prison, and their attempts to escape, whilst interacting with the factions that have emerged within the prison since its abandonment by the authorities. Mixing both humour and danger, the adventure has been extensively play tested and provides the ideal introduction to new D&D players, and a fun experience for veteran players.  You will also need a valid UKGE Entry ticket to attend this event.  RPG Event Tickets will go on sale from Monday 2nd February 2026.  More information about running RPGs at UKGE, including support packages, see this page https://www.ukgamesexpo.co.uk/events/running-event/running-an-rpg/

title: PFS2 7-02 Shipyard Sabotage
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Miguel Angel Sacristan Pathfinders are in the market for a new ship, when pirates start swarming the docks. Pathfinders, stop them!
description_full: Tensions are high following the Battle of Hellknight Hill, and while Cheliax hasn't taken any direct action, they've encouraged privateers to attack Andoran shipping. One of these pirates is especially overconfident, and believes she can win more favor with a more direct attack–one on the Augustana shipyards. Coincidentally, the Pathfinder Society is in the market for a new ship, and the heads of Supplies are touring some that are available when the attack begins. As the escorts to Nairaba and Kitsch, the two aforementioned heads of their divisions, it's up to you to keep your charges safe while dealing with the chaos. This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Pathfinder Organised Play Character. But Pregenerated Character Sheets are also available. GM: Miguel Sacristan

title: SFS2 #1-15:  Ruins of the World Soul
subtitle: Starfinder GM: Terence Thambipillai A deadly reality‑bending game show pulls you into a battle of wits, survival, and cosmic stakes.
description_full: A Starfinder Society Scenario designed for 3rd- through 4th-level characters. Kor-Montak is an ancient ritual site where shobhads of old communed with the spirits of the planet Akiton itself. A place of power and pilgrimage, Kor-Montak was abandoned sometime during the Gap and is believed to be cursed. In the ensuing centuries, numerous mystics, leaders, and warriors attempted the pilgrimage up the glacier passes to Kor-Montak, but none returned and Kor-Montak remains a place of myth and memory, lost to time but never forgotten. Impressed by the Starfinder Society’s dedication and ingenuity on a recent joint rescue mission, shobhad geomancer Aruk has invited the Starfinders to explore Kor-Montak and determine the cause of its long-standing curse. Aruk is hopeful the Starfinders can break the curse and return Kor-Montak to its people, as the Starfinder Society is known the galaxy over for their expertise in excavating ancient ruins and handling strange magic. Will you survive the ruins of the world soul? This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Starfinder Organised Play Character,  but pre-generated character sheets will be available. GM: Terry T

title: PFS #3-10 Delve The Pallid Depths
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: William Boyle Sequel to 2025’s Dwarven dungeon & as all Pathfinders know: the only way is down! A Pathfinder 2e Scenario for levels 1-4 .
description_full: After a group of prospectors discovered an ancient, abandoned dwarven ruin within the mountain known as Droskar's Crag, they reported their finding to the Pathfinder Society. The Society sent a group to enter the peak and explore the sprawling complex within. In the process, they made some new allies, recovered some lost relics, and discovered multiple entrances leading deeper into the ruined site. What else lies within the depths of Droskar's Crag? Venture-Captain Luna Aldred has sent out a call for Pathfinders to delve the ruins once more in search of treasure and knowledge that might otherwise be lost to the ages, but there is no telling what dangers might lie in wait... This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Pathfinder Organised Play Character. But Pregenerated Character Sheets are also available.: GM: William Boyle

title: PFS2 #6–06: Rotten Apples
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Nicola Barnes The Leshy village of Compost Watch has fallen silent. The Pathfinders are called upon to investigate. For Characters levels 3-6.
description_full: A 2e Pathfinder Society Scenario designed for 3rd-6th level characters. Deep in the Fangwood Forest in war-torn Nirmathas, sits an isolated Leshy village called Compost Watch, surrounded by a sacred Leshy graveyard: the Compost Forest. Working in tandem with the Ashfall Lodge, Compost Watch has kept up their vigil and maintenance of the primal space for generations, however after a recent distress signal from the trees of the Fangwood, no one's heard from the little town. It's up to the PCs to enter into the Compost Forest and see what's upsetting the balance of life, death, and nature!

title: SFS2 1-13 Foul Humors
subtitle: Starfinder 2e GM: Jay Boylan You must bring a dreamscape scientist to a supposed holy site in a haunted ice field on the edge of the system. For characters of levels 1-2
description_full: When a nascent godling called the Newborn was birthed from the planet Aucturn, chunks of its planetary womb and embryonic fluids were cast across the Pact Worlds, showering the nearby planets of Apostae and Bretheda, and careening through open space. Most of this debris—called aucturnite—collected in a haunted ice field at outer rim of the system called the Gelid Edge. For all its dangers, the Gelid Edge is a frontier of new discoveries and forbidden knowledge, and many Newborn evangelists, anomaly hunters, and occult researchers have flocked to the region to learn its secrets. Among them is Dreamlink Laboratories, a research facility that used aucturnite to create a dreamscape purportedly born from the thoughts of the Newborn. Using this dreamscape, Dreamlink Labs has pinpointed the location of a site they believe is important to the Newborn, though they lack the experience to perform an on-site exploration alone. It’s up to the Starfinder Society to escort an enthusiastic scientist from Dreamlink Labs to investigate this “holy” site! Content note: This scenario contains themes related to graphic depictions of disease and surreal settings intended to invoke disgust. Please…

title: PFS2 #7-08 The Haunted Corridor
subtitle: Pathfinder 2nd Edition GM: Philip Lucas Age Restrictions: 12+ A Pathfinder Society adventure for Character Levels 1-4.
description_full: As the Pathfinders slowly regain their footing within the elven nation of Kyonin, Venture-Captain Viore Ciobanu has set his sights on cleaning up what remains of Talhindir Lodge. As such, he's requested a small group of Pathfinders to come and assist him with some minor pest control in the basement library and archives within the lodge, and is happy to reassure them that there's no danger greater than a stubborn rat or hungry centipede. However, when the doors shut behind the agents, it quickly becomes all too clear that sometimes empty lodges aren't always as empty as they seem... Written by John Curtin Content Note : This scenario contains themes of involuntary imprisonment, blood, and experiencing death. Pre-generated characters available.

title: SFS2 1-11 Friends of the Forest
subtitle: Starfinder 2e GM: Thomas Baird A cure requires one final ingredient but will corporate greed stop the Starfinders from getting it? A SF2e Scenario for characters level 1-2.
description_full: First Seeker Sarmak has called on the scientist Dr. Heldin Sevaille to create an inoculation for an process known as “conversion” which is transforming wildlife and residents of the Sloughscar Hills into monsters in the service of the Wreck of the Returned. The final ingredient Dr. Sevaille requires is found in a remote forest called Ste Xinnith on Marata, one of Bretheda’s moons. Dr. Sevaille dispatches a team of Starfinders to collect samples of this rare plant with the aid of a few local scientists. But trouble is brewing in Ste Xinnith… Frozen Trove, a Triaxian biotech corporation notorious for unethical and illegal methods that damage environments to maximize profits, has established a laboratory in the area, leaving a trail of destruction in their wake. With the entire ecosystem at risk, it’s time for the Starfinders to take a stand. This game is open to all. You are welcome to bring your own Starfinder Organised Play Character. But Pregenerated Character Sheets are also available. GM: Thomas Baird

title: Terror in Ten Towns (DDAL Epic Tier 1)
subtitle: Dungeons and Dragons 5th Edition GM: David Wright Age Restrictions: 12+ A beastly army approaches Ten-Towns. The heroes lead efforts to fortify and defend the region, but will the towns’ mutual distrust be their undoing?
description_full: This is a D&D Adventurers League event. Pre-Generated Characters : Yes – 1st Level Pre-generated Characters will be available. Existing Adventurers League Characters:  If you have an existing 1st to 4th level Forgotten Realms Adventurers League character, which has been updated for the 2024 / 5.5e rules, then you can use that to play in this adventure. Guidance on updating to the 2024 / 5.5e rules is here: https://www.dndbeyond.com/posts/1819-d-d-adventurers-league-update-for-the-2024-core Adventurers League Info:  Want to create your own 1st level character? Follow the guidance in the D&D Adventurers League Player's Guide which can be downloaded here: https://www.dndbeyond.com/posts/1676-what-is-adventurers-league Scenario : DDEP10-01: Terror in Ten Towns (Tier 1) Full Description : As a beastly army approaches Ten-Towns from the south, heroes take the lead in fortifications and defence. But can the heroes’ optimistic hard work overcome the worst enemy—the towns’ distrust of one another? Terror in Ten Towns is a special D&D Epic adventure, which means multiple tables will be playing the same scenario at the same time.

title: The Schooling of Tomomi: K-Pop Damsel Hunters
subtitle: Manifold GM: Martin Pickett Protect the hidden princess at a demonic K-Pop concert. A magical girl anime adventure.
description_full: An anime adventure for Manifold The King of the Six Elements, one of the magical rulers of the world, has been murdered by Lord Blackstorm who wishes to seize his throne and powers. His heir, the Princess of the Wind and the Earth, has vanished into the mortal world. Tomomi is the beautiful new girl at school, and lots of the kids want to be her friend. You are the students given the task of making sure that Tomomi fits in smoothly. As a result, you have also recently become the Elemental Guardians of the Princess of the Wind and the Earth. Everyone is excited for the special concert being thrown by BLK/STRM, the latest and hottest K-Pop boy band. Rumour has it that the band will pick some lucky kids from the audience to join them on stage! What could possibly go wrong?

title: Sword of Destiny
subtitle: Eternus GM: Ben Redmond Castle Bloodstone is under attack by the evil Despilpuoer, Cassius and his mutant legions. Only the missing Sword of Destiny can turn back the tide
description_full: Only the Sword of Destiny has the power to free Castle Bloodstone from Cassius's brutal siege, but it went missing decades ago. The heroes must go on a perilous mission to recover it. Eternus is a powered-by-the-apocalyse-like rules light space fantasy game, inspired by Dune, Red Rising, the Interdependency series, Empire of Silence, and Masters of the Universe.

title: The Vault in the Undercity
subtitle: Dungeon Crawl Classics RPG GM: Michael Davis Age Restrictions: 15+ An extraplanar excursion for DCC RPG level 3 characters, by GM/creator Michael C. Davis
description_full: Death stalks the streets of Spittle-Fields — an elusive killer committing horrible crimes. A century past, dread gripped the teeming slum of the Tenements. Women were savagely murdered by a shadowy figure who vanished into the fog. The murders stopped, but the killer was never found. Now a fresh murder awakens fears that the Ripper has returned. Guild Architect Nicolas Hawkmoon's greatest achievement was his discovery that buildings can be empowered by suffering, soaking up the despair and terror that reverberates in the soil and stones. His greatest and final edifice was a Vault deep below the streets of Spittle-Fields. Now the party must enter the Vault to thwart his plan to return from beyond the grave… This scenario is Part III of Return of the Ripper , an urban horror investigation adventure for DCC RPG. Three linked adventures will run across the weekend, but each part can be played independently.

title: LA HP2-2 That Which Lies Beneath
subtitle: Dungeons and Dragons 5th Edition GM: Ciaran Doidge Age Restrictions: 15+ HP2-2 That Which Lies Beneath: The World of Shattered Empire
description_full: HP2-2 That Which Lies Beneath The Heroes are asked to solve the mystery of missing miners in the very profitable Fervidite mines before they are forced closed. Could the savage Voei be behind the disappearances or does something more sinister lurk beneath? A Standard adventure optimized for 4th level characters.   This adventure is part of the Living Arcanis 5e campaign. Players are rewarded with certificates that allow them to advance their heroes and play them in other Living Arcanis 5e adventures. Leave Your Mark Upon the Shattered Empires Arcanis is a world of epic adventure, intrigue, and exploration. A world beset on all sides by the machinations of inhuman empires and creatures both fell and foul. A world painted in shades of grey, rather than stark black and white, where your enemy today may be your only hope tomorrow. It is a world in desperate need of Heroes to hold back the tide of night and become legends! This game is designed for mature players and explores complex themes that may include conflict, moral dilemmas, interpersonal relationships, and emotional intensity. While the content is presented in a respectful and inclusive manner, it may delve into topics such as…

title: Dune: Adventures in the Imperium - Wormsign
subtitle: 2D20 Dune GM: James Carrington Age Restrictions: 18+ Learn to play Dune: Adventures in the Imperium, with this exciting one-shots, set on the iconic world of Arrakis
description_full: Experience the Dune Universe firsthand in this gripping introductory adventure! Investigate reports of spice smugglers beyond the shield wall, in the deep desert of Arrakis, where death is a constant threat, whether from heat, Harkonnen attacks or the mighty Shai-Hulud; the sandworms. This is usually a shorter one-shots of between 2 and a half to 3 and a half hours. Dune: Adventures in the Imperium - Wormsign is suitable for between 2 - 6 players. Dice needed: 2-5 d20 Characters are pre-generated and the system is very easy to learn.

title: Bar(d) Shots Live
subtitle: A monster hunt gone horribly wrong. Join Bard Shots Live for a chaotic Daggerheart one-shot inspired by Faster, Purple Worm! Kill! Kill!
description_full: Join us for Bar(d) Shots Live , a special Daggerheart one-shot inspired by Faster, Purple Worm! Kill! Kill! A group of Level 1 adventurers find themselves going up against a terrifying Tier 4 adversary in a fight they are absolutely not prepared for. The odds are stacked against them from the start, but when has that ever stopped adventurers before? Come watch the story unfold live and see who rises to the challenge,  and who becomes a cautionary tale.

title: Flesh and Blood New Player Tournament
subtitle: You've learnt the game form our experts, it is now time to put your new skills to the test with a tournament!
description_full: So, you have learnt the game form our experts, it is now time to put your new skills to the test with a tournament.   Participation in this event is included in the New Player Experience <LINK>    This event will be 3 rounds long and you will play against a different opponent each round. For the first round, we will give players extra time as the game is still new to you.  You will also be allowed to ask the judge and staff for advice, as this is a casual, fun event meant to allow you to learn more about your new deck and give you the confidence to play at your local game store. the 2nd and 3rd round will be 35 minute rounds - exactly what they will be at your local game store. For taking part you will receive some prize regardless of how well you do, so do not worry if you believe you won't win.  That is not the purpose of this event, so everyone gets prizes. You will also need a valid UKGE Entry ticket to attend this event.

title: Pile 'O' Games
subtitle: Enter the draw at Pile 'O' Games Feature Zone and come find out if you WIN!!
description_full: Pile O Games is BACK! Purchase a raffle ticket for charity and potentially win a massive pile of games.  Make sure you're at the draw on time to win your pile of games.    Tickets draws will start promptly at Friday 17:30  Saturday 17:30 Sunday 16:30   All monies received will go to our 2026 Charities More information about the charities UKGE supports can be found here https://www.ukgamesexpo.co.uk/terms-policies/uk-games-expo-charity-policy/  More information about Pile O Games and other Feature Zones can be found here https://www.ukgamesexpo.co.uk/whats-on/show/special-feature-zones/

title: Mind Burp Games: Sneak Peek & Demo Madness
subtitle: Join Mind Burp Games for live demos of our hit magic games Mind Waves and Scribble Snap, plus an exclusive first look at two brand-new 2026 releases.
description_full: Come and kick off UK Games Expo with a visit to the Mind Burp Games stand in Hall 3, Stand 260. We’ll be demoing last year’s sell-out favourites Mind Waves and S cribble Snap , two easy-to-learn, impossible-to-forget magic games that completely flew off the shelves after launch. But that’s not all… Be among the very first to experience Mental Match , a brand new self-working magic effect launching exclusively at the Expo, alongside Binary Flip , our very first strategy card game using only black and white cards.  Simple idea.  Absolute chaos.  A flippin’ mental game of strategy where every move matters. Live demos running throughout the day.  Come say hello, play some games, and have your mind pleasantly burped.

title: Tales From The Spectral Sea
subtitle: A short, 1 hour session of Tales From The Spectral Sea
description_full: In this narrative-focussed TTRPG, you play as the crew of a ship who died at sea but couldn't pass on due to unresolved baggage or trauma. Instead, you sail The Spectral Sea, an afterlife for those with a love of adventure where they can finally 'live' out their swashbuckling dreams. All the while you'll be crossing paths with an eclectic bunch of other dead folks, helping them pass on, and eventually, passing on yourself.

title: Pop Away Playtest
subtitle: Try out Pop Away, and help us playtest the latest prototype!
description_full: Ad-Hoc demos of Pop Away. 2-6 players welcome for demos and playtesting.

title: Family Fun
subtitle: Swing by Bear Faced Games to pick‑up‑and‑play Hankman, KPop Demon Hunters: Truth or Dare, The Cup Challenge, and Pokémon Trainer Expert
description_full: Swing by Bear Faced Games to pick‑up‑and‑play Hankman, KPop Demon Hunters: Truth or Dare, The Cup Challenge, and Pokémon Trainer Expert. Go on, play one of our games we double bear dare you!

title: Terrorscape
subtitle: Terrorscape - Hide and Seek. Hunt and Escape. Killer and Prey!
description_full: Some nights, the shadows are alive… and they’re hunting you. When a lonely mansion stands against a stormy night, the worst thing you can do is seek shelter. Terrorscape is a 2–4 player asymmetric horror board game where one player becomes a relentless killer and the others are a team of survivors trying to escape a haunted mansion. Survivors must search for five keys or repair the radio while avoiding noise that attracts the killer, collecting items, and managing fear as they attempt to flee the nightmare. Meanwhile, the killer uses terrifying powers to track sound, block paths, and hunt survivors down with brutal efficiency. With varied characters on both sides — each with unique abilities and miniatures — every match feels different and tense. Games take about 30–45 minutes, making Terrorscape a quick but gripping horror experience. Fast-paced and atmospheric, Terrorscape throws you straight into a classic horror narrative, where survival is uncertain, trust is fleeting, and every shadow could be your last.

title: Draw with our Creator and Illustrator
subtitle: Design and draw whimsical characters, environments and stories with ourCreator and Illustrator, Jaz.
description_full: Come and try our cosy drawing and worldbuilding activities with our Creator Jaz, and create new worlds, characters and stories. Jaz will be giving away her sketches to those who draw with her throughout UK Games Expo.

title: Chess-à-tête Demos
subtitle: Play the chess-inspired card game Chess-à-tête
description_full: Come and play the chess-inspired card game Chess-à-tête; a 2 player card battle game full of stategy and mayhem.  No chess experience required! Suitable for all ages. play against the creators or play against a friend as we guide you through the game.  Freebies will be on the stand, exclusive offers and Prizes to be won for anyone who can win by a checkmate ♟️ Also you can test out our new expansion packs and playmats which will be available for purchase at the expo.

title: Three Kobolds in a Trench Coat Demo
subtitle: Three Kobolds in a Trench Coat is a bluffing, party game for 2-4 players. The last player with hidden Kobolds wins the game.
description_full: Three Kobolds in a Trench Coat is a bluffing, party game for 2-4 players. After spending too long in the dark, the Kobolds are ready to see what life is like in the village of Crumblebatch. But there's a problem: the villagers aren’t exactly welcoming to monsters. To blend in, the Kobolds have come up with a cunning plan - to dress up in a trench coat and pretend to be a regular person. Now, as a “citizen”, players must avoid suspicion. Each player must keep their Kobolds hidden by completing Quests, collecting Gold, and defeating opponents in Challenges. Pay the Guards to redirect attention toward others and use Items to protect themselves or expose their rivals’ Kobolds one by one. The last player with hidden Kobolds wins the game.

title: Live Demo - Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit
subtitle: Step Into the Hunt. Capture Cryptids Before Your Rivals Do.
description_full: Enter the World of Kryptothera The hunt has already begun. Across a fractured world shaped by myth and ambition, cryptids roam freely. Hunters rise from every corner, chasing legend, power, and prestige. In Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit , you will step into this world and experience the thrill of the chase in a guided session led by one of the game’s creators. What You’ll Experience This is not just a demo. This is your first expedition. 🎲 A guided 30-minute session led by the creators 🗺️ Play through 5 rounds of the game with the full experience condensed 🐉 Hunt, capture, and secure cryptids before your rivals ⚖️ Feel the tension of competitive PvE and PvP gameplay 💬 Hear the story behind the creation of the game as you play Every decision matters. Push deeper into the wild, or return to safety before everything is lost. How It Works   👥 Up to 4 players per session 🚶 Drop-in play — no booking required ⏱️ Sessions run continuously throughout the event Step in when a table opens… and begin your hunt. Prepare for the Hunt Study the hunter’s handbook before you arrive and gain the edge: 👉 Read the Rulebook Find Us Join us at the NoctiLux Games stand (3A-644) and discover what…

title: Cryptid Smash - Live Demo
subtitle: Cryptid Smash: Unleash the Chaos
description_full: Step into a world where legendary creatures do not hide in the shadows… they collide. In Cryptid Smash , cryptids clash in a fast-paced, unpredictable card battle where every move can turn the game on its head. Match cards, trigger powerful effects, and sabotage your opponents as you race to be the first to empty your hand. One moment you are in control, the next everything spirals into chaos. Inspired by folklore, each card introduces a new twist. Reverse the flow of play, force your rivals to draw, mirror their moves, or unleash devastating combinations at just the right moment. It is easy to learn, quick to play, and designed for big groups, loud reactions, and constant momentum. 🎮 Game Details • Players: 2 to 10 • Playtime: ~20 minutes • Age: 7+ Curious to master the chaos before you arrive? 👉 Read the Rulebook here Or experience it the way it was meant to be played. Join us at the NoctiLux Games booth (Hall 3A-644) and jump straight into a live demo. Our team will guide you through the game, teach you the rules in minutes, and throw you into the action alongside other players. No booking needed. Just drop in, take a seat, and let the cryptids loose. 🐉

title: GoGo Demo
subtitle: App demo - find 1000+ places to play across the UK. Is your local club/ BGC listed?
description_full: Download free @ https://gogogamearranger.com Find local groups, BGCs, FLGSs across the UK. Organise events & arrange games - the app to get your game on Good for Gaming

title: Cubyria: Architects of a Lost City demo games
subtitle: Come try Cubyria, the beautiful 3D tile-laying game for 2-5 players. Like 3D, competitive Tetris. Coming soon to Kickstarter!
description_full: Come try Cubyria , the decade's most original new board game, coming soon to Kickstarter! Imagine the mental challenge of Tetris combined with the tactile pleasure of Lego, all set to a drumbeat of fierce competition. You play as an Architect, working against your rivals to please the Mad Vizier by building the most spectacular additions to his palace. Collect cards to place Rooms, Roofs and other building components onto a complex, beautiful and ever-growing structure. The rules are easy to learn, but the challenge ramps up every round. Skilful players can cleverly take advantage of the many point multipliers, but beware the Vizier’s Whimsy Cards, which can throw every plan into disarray. Board gamers experience Cubyria as a new dimension of play. Fans of RPGs and miniatures relive the pleasure of laying out a map and handling beautiful components. And Cubyria is a great family game – kids love it. By the end of the game, you've built a gorgeous, unique 3D palace , which you won't want to put away!

title: Tenby demo by Benjie Talbott 𓅰
subtitle: Learn how to play Tenby with designer and illustrator Benjie Talbott!
description_full: Tenby is one of the most beautiful towns in Wales. Wander our colourful streets, walk along our piers with some scrumptious fish and chips, and relax on our stunning beaches with a nice cold ice cream and a warm feeling in your heart. The aim of Tenby is to create the best town you can using the available cards. On your turn, you will draft and place cards to add terraces, piers, and Tenby town’s landmarks into your streets. If you can persuade a hard working local resident to help, you might just pick up some extra points! Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner!

title: Learn how to play Pinched!
subtitle: Learn how to play Pinched!
description_full: Try to outsmart other burglers in Pinched! - a new set collection game by David Gordon and Jonathan Gilmour-Long for 2 to 5 players. You become “The Mastermind”, planning the perfect heist. In the meantime, the other burglars try to guess where the break-in will be... Who will take the most loot?

title: Learn how to play For the Gods! ⚡
subtitle: Learn how to play For the Gods!
description_full: As a seafaring builder in ancient Greece, in For the Gods! you'll navigate the archipelago, constructing towering monuments to the gods and vying for control of sacred islands. For the Gods! is a tactical area majority game in which every stone shapes your path to victory. The rules are simple: Sail the seas to establish new temples or elevate existing ones. Along the way, collect God stones and unleash their divine powers at the right moment. With twelve unique God powers, each game offers fresh strategies and dynamic gameplay, ensuring high variability.

title: Learn how to play Yotei 🌸
subtitle: Learn how to play Yotei
description_full: After a successful Kickstarter last month, Yotei is now for the first time available for a demo at UKGE! Yotei is a Machi building game for 2-4 players where you use potatoes as a currency to build the most enchanting Hokkaido town. Buy or bid on fields, forest and mountain plots, and harvest potatoes. Then use your resources to showcase the undeniable charm of the north - serve ramen, host a potato festival, open a ski resort or a serene hot spring! The game offers a perfect blend of tactics and strategy that gives players a satisfying peek into life in Hokkaido.

title: Learn how to play Red North
subtitle: Learn how to play Red North
description_full: Outsmart your enemies in Red North - a new combative game of hidden information and bluffing for 2 to 4 players. Sharpen your axes and send your fiercest heroes and raiders to seize control of the Northern Outposts. Early victories may bring glory, but beware for during Ragnarok, the Gods themselves may tip the scales…

title: Maladum Demo: Dungeons of Enveron
subtitle: Try Maladum: Dungeons of Enveron Starter Set in a guided demo. Explore a dungeon and learn as you play.
description_full: Step into the world of Maladum: Dungeons of Enveron Starter Set and try it for yourself at our stand. Join a live demo where you’ll take control of a band of adventurers, explore a dungeon packed with danger and see how the game blends tactical combat with a rich, story-driven campaign. We’ll guide you through the rules as you play, so you can jump straight in, no adventuring experience needed. Drop by, grab a character, and see if your party survives the depths of Enveron.

title: Core Space Demo: Evolution
subtitle: Be among the first to jump into the action of Core Space: Evolution in a guided demo. Lead your crew and escape with your loot.
description_full: Be among the first to jump into the action of Core Space: Evolution. Join us on our stand and take control of a crew of traders and try to stay one step ahead of the deadly Rogue Purge.  Swing by, pick your crew and see if you can make it back to the ship, with your loot, intact.

title: 108 Outlaws: Learn to play in 5 minutes
subtitle: 108 Outlaws: Learn to play in 5 minutes
description_full: Relive one of Chinese history’s classic epics in 108 Outlaws ! In this immersive and challenging tableau-building card game, put together a motley troop of reformed criminals with different abilities and effects, embark on game-changing missions and write your own history. With 108 unique bandits to choose from, every game will be an all-new adventure! Ages 14+

title: Preview of Moby Dick: Wrath of the Seas
subtitle: Preview of Moby Dick: Wrath of the Seas! 1-6 players, 60min asymmetric board game
description_full: Join us a preview of our upcoming game, Moby Dick: Wrath of the Seas! You can book a demo slot here , or just show up at our stand to have a quick look! About the game Prototype game box Harness the power of the ocean as Moby Dick, or ride currents and hunt whales as the relentless whaleboat crew, in this asymmetric board game for 1 to 6 players. As  Moby Dick , you control the mighty white whale and other whales appearing in the ocean. Your goal: destroy the Pequod, sailors' main boat. As the crew , you impersonate one of the whaleboat chiefs (boatsteerer): Captain Ahab, Starbuck, Stubb and Flask. Each of them has their personal style, which is reflected in different character boards. All of them, are on a mission to hunt to hunt whales and Moby Dick! Crew play cards to move through dangerous waters and ride currents, all while trying to have their obsession under control, keeping their boat steady and escaping the white whale’s attacks. Will you harness the power of the ocean as Moby Dick, or brave the waves as the relentless whaleboat crew?The hunt is on!

title: Trouble Brewing - Demo
subtitle: Pop by our stand and try our debut game Trouble Brewing!
description_full: “Trouble Brewing”, the debut indie board game for Nightjar's Rest Studio, is a game of garden tending, potion brewing, fae magic using madness for 2-4 players. Players are pixies summoned by an overwhelmed Witch to help with her thriving potion business. Plant seeds, water them to grow them into ingredients, then harvest and add them to the cauldron to brew a variety of potions. Beware, adding the wrong ingredient to the cauldron will cause it to Boil Over! Use your fae magic to cause chaos in the garden - trick the Witch, help yourself, or hinder your opponents. Each helpful thing you do will earn you honey and sweet biscuits, a pixie's favourite things, and the player with the biggest haul of rewards at the end of the game is the winner! Trouble Brewing is a chaotic game of bluffing, planning, strategy and sabotage!

title: 8 Dragons - Demo
subtitle: Learn how to play 8 Dragons
description_full: Dragon Swarm placement meets lair building. Minimal downtime. Maximum Dragon time. In 8 Dragons you play a mighty Dragon soaring across two kingdoms. But you don't fly alone. Your Wyrmlings have just hatched and are eager to fly. You form Swarms, with your own Wyrmlings and those of the other Dragons. On your turn, you visit wondrous locations and activate effects for yourself and every Wyrmling in your Swarm. When your Wyrmlings fly with others, you benefit from their turns too. Along the way, friendly villagers help you expand your Lair, chamber by chamber. Collect artifacts, fulfill Missions, and hoard as much Gold as you can. And as befits true dragons: whoever hoards the most Gold wins.

title: Kelp: Offshore Offspring Expansion - Demo
subtitle: Learn how to play the new expansion for Kelp
description_full: Raise offspring, unlock new abilities, hunt and hide in new ways. Survival is no longer enough — only your legacy will decide who endures. There is new life in the kelp forest, and the fight for survival deepens. Offspring change everything: juveniles arrive, grow, and demand new tactics from both sides. Offshore Offspring introduces brand-new components and strategies for both the Shark and the Octopus. As the Octopus, you must protect your young while mastering a completely new magnetic modular block system with swappable tiles. Unlock different camouflage colors, each with unique abilities. Set traps that wound pursuing Sharks, and evolve juveniles into adults, creating fresh layers of deception and survival. Food gets a new layer: eat to grow, then risk everything on a daring new escape route. As the Shark, you command not just the mother but also two new juvenile hunters, giving you the power to hunt as a pack. With new Growth tiles, you unlock the ability to swim over each other, letting you cover more of the kelp forest than ever before. And while some Octopus traps can wound you, successful attacks on Octopuses can help keep your hunger at bay. Each choice forces you to…

subtitle: Strategy game about the Native peoples of the US Great Plain
description_full: The wind sweeps across the Great Plains. The buffalo are still far. Winter is coming. TATANKA is a deep strategy game about the Native peoples of the Great Plains - their spirituality, traditions, and the relentless passage of time. Designed by Danilo Sabia with over a decade of historical and anthropological research behind every mechanic and every symbol. Illustrated by the Master KK Deb. https://gamefound.com/en/projects/creardo/tatanka

subtitle: Demo of Don Quixote: The Ingenious Hidalgo! 2-6players, 20min game simultaneous voting and hidden bidding
description_full: Join us for a game of Don Quixote: The Ingenious Hidalgo! About the game: Based on the masterpiece novel from Miguel de Cervantes, Don Quixote: The Ingenious Hidalgo is a fun game of wit and strategy that lets you experience the original story. It features dynamic set-collection, simultaneous voting and hidden bidding. 2-6 players, age 8+, 20min per game

title: Aster
subtitle: An ancient space strategy game of stellar influence. 2-3 players
description_full: 2 or 3 players, 20 minutes, Ages 9+, Abstract Strategy, Area Control, Space, Tactical Movement An ancient game of cosmic skysails and stellar influence, gifted to our ancestors by ancient travellers who sailed the stars on streams of sunlight. Played on a circular seed of life board, Aster is an ancient space strategy game where players take turns building castras (bases), moving ships along circular light streams, planning attacks, and securing places to lay aster petal pieces. Inspired by sacred geometry and ancient cosmic civilizations, Aster blends abstract strategy with beautiful illustrated art and unusual but familiar mechanics. Aster pre-launch page available here (you might see a draft, full pre-launch page will be coming soon!).

subtitle: Relicblade is a tabletop tactics-RPG, focusing on heroic characters, dangerous adventures, and intuitive gameplay.
description_full: Relicblade is a tabletop tactics-RPG, focusing on heroic characters, dangerous adventures, and intuitive gameplay. Players command a party of champions on an epic quest to decide the fate of a dying world. The game plays on a 2'x2' board and lasts 30-45 minutes. Duration of a full game: 30-45 minutes Players: 1-4 players

title: Get Started with Sculpting
subtitle: An hour session on the fundamentals of miniature sculpting, including tools, putties, mixing techniques, and preparing miniatures for sculpting work.
description_full: Join Siege Studios for an in-depth, one-hour masterclass focused on introducing the core skills and techniques needed to begin sculpting on miniatures. This session will show  you the tools and materials commonly used for sculpting, including different putties, mixing ratios, and how to prepare miniatures ready for additional sculpted details. The team will also demonstrate how to make some of your own sculpting tools and cover essential knife safety when cutting and handling putty. You’ll then learn the basics of working with putty, including shaping, handling, and using a variety of sculpting tools effectively. To finish the session, the team will demonstrate how to sculpt armour gussets and, if time allows, additional details such as beards, helping you understand how these techniques can be applied to your own projects.

title: Miniature Painting with Markers
subtitle: Miniature Painting Workshop with Refillable Markers
description_full: In this workshop, you’ll paint miniatures from various board games and wargames (fantasy, sci-fi, heroes, monsters, and more), learning how to work on both large surfaces and small details using refillable markers. Our expert painters will guide you step by step so you understand how to control your strokes, mix colors, and achieve striking effects—even if it’s your first time. The goal is for you to leave with a well-painted mini and, above all, with the feeling that “I can do this!” Plus, we’ll teach you easy and super fun tricks: clean outlines, quick highlights, simple gradients, textures, and small effects that bring the figure to life without complicating things with difficult techniques. There will be practical tips to save time, avoid common mistakes, and enjoy the process while experimenting with different styles. This workshop is designed for everyone —to learn, try things out, and have fun painting. Find out more about us https://www.greenstuffworld.com/

title: Play-to-learn Demos & Playtests
subtitle: Come and explore our educational games
description_full: Do you know what a trophic pyramid is? How about a terribly unethical business decision? Do you want your career to have less meetings and more play? Or do you hate it if a game is ‘educational’? Come and explore our educational games or play-test our prototypes to contribute your views or learn more about how you could use games to support your learning (or that of others).

title: Skalvenia pre-campaign demo
subtitle: Visit our booth to discover and play Skalvenia - a Lite 4X
description_full: Visit our booth to discover and play Skalvenia - a Lite 4X board game planned for crowdfunding launch in Q1 next year. Play with 2–4 players and choose between a full game or just a few rounds - whatever suits you best. Step into the role of a jarl and lead your Viking clan to glory through the colonization of a new land, worship of ancient gods, and glorious battles. Sail your drakkar to an uncharted realm to establish the first settlements there. Carefully balance the conquest of new territories with the development of your capital in the Old Land.

title: Try a full game of Escape The Ghost Train!
subtitle: Play a full game of Escape The Ghost Train at the Playtest Zone!
description_full: Head to the Playtest Zone (Hall 2-108) to play a full game of Escape The Ghost Train! No sign ups necessary, just head to the table and take a seat. If it's full up, don't worry - we'll find space for more games in the Open Gaming area in Hall 1 during the rest of the Expo. See us on the Beardy Boo Games stand (3A-B59) for details! And don't forget, Playtest UK have dozens of other exciting new games for you to try - check them out! Escape The Ghost Train is a spooky push-your-luck competitive board game for 1-4 players, designed by Craig Tubbs with artwork by Amanda Sutton. Click the link for our Kickstarter page. Come and meet us at the Beardy Boo Games stand (3A-B59) to see the game in action, try it for yourself, and pick up some FREE GOODIES, and enter our contest to win a copy of the game!

Deploy workers to claim key locations, block opponents and control the flow of the city. Spend gold to gain extra actions and turn the tide in your favour. Every decision counts in Guildlands. Will your Guild rise to dominate the rebuilding of Ferrum’s Ford and earn the Queen’s favour? Let the city rise! A strategic asymmetric tile-laying game by Ken Boyter and Kedric Winks.

title: Basing Workshop
subtitle: Level up your basing
description_full: Join Siege Studios for a one-hour session focused on the art of basing—an essential step in bringing your miniatures together as complete, immersive pieces. This workshop explores how to design and build bases that enhance your model’s story, setting, and overall visual impact. You can look forward to  techniques for creating a variety of textures and environments, from simple, effective tabletop bases to more detailed scenic compositions. You’ll witness how to work with materials such as texture paints, pigments, tufts, and natural elements, as well as how to tie your base seamlessly into the colour scheme of your miniature. Whether you want to elevate your army to a cohesive force or give individual models a striking display finish, this session provides practical tips and professional approaches. . Ideal for hobbyists of all levels, it’s the perfect way to add that final layer of polish to your work.

title: Weathering Armour
subtitle: An hour session on weathering armour on miniatures, including rust, streaks, grime, incorporating transfers and more.
description_full: Join Siege Studios for an in-depth, one-hour masterclass focused on bringing realism and character to your miniatures through advanced armour weathering techniques. This session will showcase you through the process of transforming clean, flat surfaces into battle-worn masterpieces full of story and depth. Covering a range of essential skills, the team will demonstrate how to create convincing rust effects, realistic streaking, and natural-looking grime that enhances the narrative of your models. You’ll also learn how to seamlessly incorporate transfers and decals into your paintwork, blending them into the surface so they look like an integral part of the armour rather than an afterthought.

title: Company of Heroes - Learn to Play - Table 1
subtitle: Command the front in Company of Heroes! Learn all phases of this WWII tactical masterpiece.
description_full: Sign up here: https://bit.ly/3PQHUU8 Join the team of Bad Crow Games for an immersive "Learn to Play" session of the Company of Heroes board game. We provide a comprehensive walkthrough of the tactical combat, resource management, and unit veterancy systems that bring the acclaimed RTS experience to your tabletop. Whether you are a seasoned commander or a new recruit, our team will guide you through every phase of the game—from initial deployment and capturing territory to the final push for victory points. Experience the high-stakes decisions of WWII combined arms warfare in a supportive, beginner-friendly environment designed to get you battle-ready in a single session. As a thank you for joining the front lines, every participant will walk away with an exclusive event souvenir and a special discount on Company of Heroes products.

title: Tales From The Spectral Sea
subtitle: A short, 1 hour session of Tales From The Spectral Sea
description_full: In this narrative-focussed TTRPG, you play as the crew of a ship who died at sea but couldn't pass on due to unresolved baggage or trauma. Instead, you sail The Spectral Sea, an afterlife for those with a love of adventure where they can finally 'live' out their swashbuckling dreams. All the while you'll be crossing paths with an eclectic bunch of other dead folks, helping them pass on, and eventually, passing on yourself.
