title: Three Kobolds in a Trench Coat Demo
subtitle: Three Kobolds in a Trench Coat is a bluffing, party game for 2-4 players. The last player with hidden Kobolds wins the game.
description_full: Three Kobolds in a Trench Coat is a bluffing, party game for 2-4 players. After spending too long in the dark, the Kobolds are ready to see what life is like in the village of Crumblebatch. But there's a problem: the villagers aren’t exactly welcoming to monsters. To blend in, the Kobolds have come up with a cunning plan - to dress up in a trench coat and pretend to be a regular person. Now, as a “citizen”, players must avoid suspicion. Each player must keep their Kobolds hidden by completing Quests, collecting Gold, and defeating opponents in Challenges. Pay the Guards to redirect attention toward others and use Items to protect themselves or expose their rivals’ Kobolds one by one. The last player with hidden Kobolds wins the game.

title: Live Demo - Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit
subtitle: Step Into the Hunt. Capture Cryptids Before Your Rivals Do.
description_full: Enter the World of Kryptothera The hunt has already begun. Across a fractured world shaped by myth and ambition, cryptids roam freely. Hunters rise from every corner, chasing legend, power, and prestige. In Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit , you will step into this world and experience the thrill of the chase in a guided session led by one of the game’s creators. What You’ll Experience This is not just a demo. This is your first expedition. 🎲 A guided 30-minute session led by the creators 🗺️ Play through 5 rounds of the game with the full experience condensed 🐉 Hunt, capture, and secure cryptids before your rivals ⚖️ Feel the tension of competitive PvE and PvP gameplay 💬 Hear the story behind the creation of the game as you play Every decision matters. Push deeper into the wild, or return to safety before everything is lost. How It Works   👥 Up to 4 players per session 🚶 Drop-in play — no booking required ⏱️ Sessions run continuously throughout the event Step in when a table opens… and begin your hunt. Prepare for the Hunt Study the hunter’s handbook before you arrive and gain the edge: 👉 Read the Rulebook Find Us Join us at the NoctiLux Games stand (3A-644) and discover what…

title: Cryptid Smash - Live Demo
subtitle: Cryptid Smash: Unleash the Chaos
description_full: Step into a world where legendary creatures do not hide in the shadows… they collide. In Cryptid Smash , cryptids clash in a fast-paced, unpredictable card battle where every move can turn the game on its head. Match cards, trigger powerful effects, and sabotage your opponents as you race to be the first to empty your hand. One moment you are in control, the next everything spirals into chaos. Inspired by folklore, each card introduces a new twist. Reverse the flow of play, force your rivals to draw, mirror their moves, or unleash devastating combinations at just the right moment. It is easy to learn, quick to play, and designed for big groups, loud reactions, and constant momentum. 🎮 Game Details • Players: 2 to 10 • Playtime: ~20 minutes • Age: 7+ Curious to master the chaos before you arrive? 👉 Read the Rulebook here Or experience it the way it was meant to be played. Join us at the NoctiLux Games booth (Hall 3A-644) and jump straight into a live demo. Our team will guide you through the game, teach you the rules in minutes, and throw you into the action alongside other players. No booking needed. Just drop in, take a seat, and let the cryptids loose. 🐉

title: Cubyria: Architects of a Lost City demo games
subtitle: Come try Cubyria, the beautiful 3D tile-laying game for 2-5 players. Like 3D, competitive Tetris. Coming soon to Kickstarter!
description_full: Come try Cubyria , the decade's most original new board game, coming soon to Kickstarter! Imagine the mental challenge of Tetris combined with the tactile pleasure of Lego, all set to a drumbeat of fierce competition. You play as an Architect, working against your rivals to please the Mad Vizier by building the most spectacular additions to his palace. Collect cards to place Rooms, Roofs and other building components onto a complex, beautiful and ever-growing structure. The rules are easy to learn, but the challenge ramps up every round. Skilful players can cleverly take advantage of the many point multipliers, but beware the Vizier’s Whimsy Cards, which can throw every plan into disarray. Board gamers experience Cubyria as a new dimension of play. Fans of RPGs and miniatures relive the pleasure of laying out a map and handling beautiful components. And Cubyria is a great family game – kids love it. By the end of the game, you've built a gorgeous, unique 3D palace , which you won't want to put away!

title: Learn how to play Pinched!
subtitle: Learn how to play Pinched!
description_full: Try to outsmart other burglers in Pinched! - a new set collection game by David Gordon and Jonathan Gilmour-Long for 2 to 5 players. You become “The Mastermind”, planning the perfect heist. In the meantime, the other burglars try to guess where the break-in will be... Who will take the most loot?

title: Learn how to play Tenby
subtitle: Learn how to play Tenby
description_full: Tenby is one of the most beautiful towns in Wales. Wander our colourful streets, walk along our piers with some scrumptious fish and chips, and relax on our stunning beaches with a nice cold ice cream and a warm feeling in your heart. The aim of Tenby is to create the best town you can using the available cards. On your turn, you will draft and place cards to add terraces, piers, and Tenby town’s landmarks into your streets. If you can persuade a hard working local resident to help, you might just pick up some extra points! Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner!

title: Learn how to play For the Gods! ⚡
subtitle: Learn how to play For the Gods!
description_full: As a seafaring builder in ancient Greece, in For the Gods! you'll navigate the archipelago, constructing towering monuments to the gods and vying for control of sacred islands. For the Gods! is a tactical area majority game in which every stone shapes your path to victory. The rules are simple: Sail the seas to establish new temples or elevate existing ones. Along the way, collect God stones and unleash their divine powers at the right moment. With twelve unique God powers, each game offers fresh strategies and dynamic gameplay, ensuring high variability.

title: Learn how to play Yotei 🌸
subtitle: Learn how to play Yotei
description_full: After a successful Kickstarter last month, Yotei is now for the first time available for a demo at UKGE! Yotei is a Machi building game for 2-4 players where you use potatoes as a currency to build the most enchanting Hokkaido town. Buy or bid on fields, forest and mountain plots, and harvest potatoes. Then use your resources to showcase the undeniable charm of the north - serve ramen, host a potato festival, open a ski resort or a serene hot spring! The game offers a perfect blend of tactics and strategy that gives players a satisfying peek into life in Hokkaido.

title: Learn how to play Red North
subtitle: Learn how to play Red North
description_full: Outsmart your enemies in Red North - a new combative game of hidden information and bluffing for 2 to 4 players. Sharpen your axes and send your fiercest heroes and raiders to seize control of the Northern Outposts. Early victories may bring glory, but beware for during Ragnarok, the Gods themselves may tip the scales…

title: Maladum Demo: Dungeons of Enveron
subtitle: Try Maladum: Dungeons of Enveron Starter Set in a guided demo. Explore a dungeon and learn as you play.
description_full: Step into the world of Maladum: Dungeons of Enveron Starter Set and try it for yourself at our stand. Join a live demo where you’ll take control of a band of adventurers, explore a dungeon packed with danger and see how the game blends tactical combat with a rich, story-driven campaign. We’ll guide you through the rules as you play, so you can jump straight in, no adventuring experience needed. Drop by, grab a character, and see if your party survives the depths of Enveron.

title: Core Space Demo: Evolution
subtitle: Core Space: Evolution
description_full: Be among the first to jump into the action of Core Space: Evolution. Join us on our stand and take control of a crew of traders and try to stay one step ahead of the deadly Rogue Purge.  Swing by, pick your crew and see if you can make it back to the ship, with your loot, intact.

title: Preview of Moby Dick: Wrath of the Seas
subtitle: Preview of Moby Dick: Wrath of the Seas! 1-6 players, 60min asymmetric board game
description_full: Join us a preview of our upcoming game, Moby Dick: Wrath of the Seas! You can book a demo slot here , or just show up at our stand to have a quick look! About the game Prototype game box Harness the power of the ocean as Moby Dick, or ride currents and hunt whales as the relentless whaleboat crew, in this asymmetric board game for 1 to 6 players. As  Moby Dick , you control the mighty white whale and other whales appearing in the ocean. Your goal: destroy the Pequod, sailors' main boat. As the crew , you impersonate one of the whaleboat chiefs (boatsteerer): Captain Ahab, Starbuck, Stubb and Flask. Each of them has their personal style, which is reflected in different character boards. All of them, are on a mission to hunt to hunt whales and Moby Dick! Crew play cards to move through dangerous waters and ride currents, all while trying to have their obsession under control, keeping their boat steady and escaping the white whale’s attacks. Will you harness the power of the ocean as Moby Dick, or brave the waves as the relentless whaleboat crew? The hunt is on!

title: Play-to-learn Demos & Playtests
subtitle: Come and explore our educational games
description_full: Do you know what a trophic pyramid is? How about a terribly unethical business decision? Do you want your career to have less meetings and more play? Or do you hate it if a game is ‘educational’? Come and explore our educational games or play-test our prototypes to contribute your views or learn more about how you could use games to support your learning (or that of others).

title: Trouble Brewing - Demo
subtitle: Pop by our stand and try our debut game Trouble Brewing!
description_full: “Trouble Brewing”, the debut indie board game for Nightjar's Rest Studio, is a game of garden tending, potion brewing, fae magic using madness for 2-4 players. Players are pixies summoned by an overwhelmed Witch to help with her thriving potion business. Plant seeds, water them to grow them into ingredients, then harvest and add them to the cauldron to brew a variety of potions. Beware, adding the wrong ingredient to the cauldron will cause it to Boil Over! Use your fae magic to cause chaos in the garden - trick the Witch, help yourself, or hinder your opponents. Each helpful thing you do will earn you honey and sweet biscuits, a pixie's favourite things, and the player with the biggest haul of rewards at the end of the game is the winner! Trouble Brewing is a chaotic game of bluffing, planning, strategy and sabotage!

title: 8 Dragons - Demo
subtitle: Learn how to play 8 Dragons
description_full: Dragon Swarm placement meets lair building. Minimal downtime. Maximum Dragon time. In 8 Dragons you play a mighty Dragon soaring across two kingdoms. But you don't fly alone. Your Wyrmlings have just hatched and are eager to fly. You form Swarms, with your own Wyrmlings and those of the other Dragons. On your turn, you visit wondrous locations and activate effects for yourself and every Wyrmling in your Swarm. When your Wyrmlings fly with others, you benefit from their turns too. Along the way, friendly villagers help you expand your Lair, chamber by chamber. Collect artifacts, fulfill Missions, and hoard as much Gold as you can. And as befits true dragons: whoever hoards the most Gold wins.

title: Kelp: Offshore Offspring Expansion - Demo
subtitle: Learn how to play the new expansion for Kelp
description_full: Raise offspring, unlock new abilities, hunt and hide in new ways. Survival is no longer enough — only your legacy will decide who endures. There is new life in the kelp forest, and the fight for survival deepens. Offspring change everything: juveniles arrive, grow, and demand new tactics from both sides. Offshore Offspring introduces brand-new components and strategies for both the Shark and the Octopus. As the Octopus, you must protect your young while mastering a completely new magnetic modular block system with swappable tiles. Unlock different camouflage colors, each with unique abilities. Set traps that wound pursuing Sharks, and evolve juveniles into adults, creating fresh layers of deception and survival. Food gets a new layer: eat to grow, then risk everything on a daring new escape route. As the Shark, you command not just the mother but also two new juvenile hunters, giving you the power to hunt as a pack. With new Growth tiles, you unlock the ability to swim over each other, letting you cover more of the kelp forest than ever before. And while some Octopus traps can wound you, successful attacks on Octopuses can help keep your hunger at bay. Each choice forces you to…

title: Play Don Quixote: The Ingenious Hidalgo
subtitle: Demo of Don Quixote: The Ingenious Hidalgo! 2-6players, 20min game simultaneous voting and hidden bidding
description_full: Join us for a game of Don Quixote: The Ingenious Hidalgo! About the game: Based on the masterpiece novel from Miguel de Cervantes, Don Quixote: The Ingenious Hidalgo is a fun game of wit and strategy that lets you experience the original story. It features dynamic set-collection, simultaneous voting and hidden bidding. 2-6 players, age 8+, 20min per game

title: Tea Tasting
subtitle: Try some Fantasy Tea
description_full: Come and see, taste, smell and generally sample our range of 18 Character class teas. Be one of the first to taste the Artificer and Warrior teas - NEW at UKGE 2026 We will have four available each day, so come back throughout the show to try something new!

title: Aster
subtitle: An ancient space strategy game of stellar influence
description_full: 2 or 3 players, 20 minutes, Ages 9+, Abstract Strategy, Area Control, Space, Tactical Movement An ancient game of cosmic skysails and stellar influence, gifted to our ancestors by ancient travellers who sailed the stars on streams of sunlight. Played on a circular seed of life board, Aster is an ancient space strategy game where players take turns building castras (bases), moving ships along circular light streams, planning attacks, and securing places to lay aster petal pieces. Inspired by sacred geometry and ancient cosmic civilizations, Aster blends abstract strategy with beautiful illustrated art and unusual but familiar mechanics. Aster pre-launch page available here (you might see a draft, full pre-launch page will be coming soon!).

title: Cyberpunk TCG Demo
subtitle: Cyberpunk Demo Sessions
description_full: Join us on the stand for non-stop demoing!

title: Learn to Play First Blood!
subtitle: We hope to see you in person and have a great time teaching you our game and tactics! Bring a friend and dive in this amazing Skirmish game of Conques
description_full: Attending this Demo at the booth for 15 GBP teaches you the basic Rules of our Skirmish Game First Blood and gets you also an exclusive fishgnome miniature you can't find anywhere else!

title: Sculpting Capes and Robes
subtitle: An hour session on sculpting fabric details for miniatures, including robes, capes, folds, and flowing cloth effects.
description_full: Join Siege Studios for an in-depth, one-hour masterclass focused on creating realistic fabric elements for your miniatures through sculpting techniques and putty work. This session will begin with a brief introduction to the tools, sculpting materials, and putty mixes used throughout the demonstration, along with guidance on preparing and handling putty effectively. The team will also demonstrate how to work with putty on glass surfaces to achieve smoother results and improved control while sculpting. During the class, you’ll learn how to sculpt robes onto a Space Marine miniature and create a single-stage cape, with step-by-step guidance on making putty resemble naturally draped fabric. The session will also cover how to create convincing folds, flowing movement, and wind-swept effects to add realism, motion, and character to your sculpted details.

title: Sculpting Capes and Robes
subtitle: An hour session on sculpting fabric details for miniatures, including robes, capes, folds, and flowing cloth effects.
description_full: Join Siege Studios for an in-depth, one-hour masterclass focused on creating realistic fabric elements for your miniatures through sculpting techniques and putty work. This session will begin with a brief introduction to the tools, sculpting materials, and putty mixes used throughout the demonstration, along with guidance on preparing and handling putty effectively. The team will also demonstrate how to work with putty on glass surfaces to achieve smoother results and improved control while sculpting. During the class, you’ll learn how to sculpt robes onto a Space Marine miniature and create a single-stage cape, with step-by-step guidance on making putty resemble naturally draped fabric. The session will also cover how to create convincing folds, flowing movement, and wind-swept effects to add realism, motion, and character to your sculpted details.

title: Miniature Painting with Markers
subtitle: Miniature Painting Workshop with Refillable Markers
description_full: In this workshop, you’ll paint miniatures from various board games and wargames (fantasy, sci-fi, heroes, monsters, and more), learning how to work on both large surfaces and small details using refillable markers. Our expert painters will guide you step by step so you understand how to control your strokes, mix colors, and achieve striking effects—even if it’s your first time. The goal is for you to leave with a well-painted mini and, above all, with the feeling that “I can do this!” Plus, we’ll teach you easy and super fun tricks: clean outlines, quick highlights, simple gradients, textures, and small effects that bring the figure to life without complicating things with difficult techniques. There will be practical tips to save time, avoid common mistakes, and enjoy the process while experimenting with different styles. This workshop is designed for everyone —to learn, try things out, and have fun painting. Find out more about us https://www.greenstuffworld.com/

title: Rosebyrne Manor Demo
subtitle: A Dungeon Delving Board Game Where the Heroes Investigate a Cursed Manor
description_full: Step into the shadows of Rosebyrne Manor, a sprawling estate of mystery, monsters, and hidden treasure. Play as heroic adventurers seeking glory, wealth, or redemption—or take on the dark role of the Spirit of Lord Kallidus, orchestrating the horrors that await.   Explore a Living, Dangerous Manor: An ever-changing map of the dungeon below the manor, twisting corridors, and ancient secrets ensure no two adventures are ever the same. Fight and Survive: Tactical combat rewards clever teamwork, careful planning, and daring heroics—but one misstep can mean death. Make Decisions with Consequences: Every choice matters. Solve puzzles, navigate treacherous traps, and influence the fate of Rosebyrne itself. Grow Your Heroes: Earn experience, unlock abilities, discover powerful artefacts, and return stronger to face the manor’s ever-deepening darkness. Create an Epic Story Together: Each session is a chapter in an evolving campaign, blending strategy, adventure, and unforgettable storytelling. Do you have what it takes to survive the darkness, uncover the manor’s secrets, and shape the destiny of Rosebyrne? Adventure awaits…

title: Peruke Games
subtitle: Learn how to play Peruke dice game
description_full: Learn how to play Peruke, the quick fire dice game. The designer will be around all weekend to show to show you how to play.

title: Burgle Bros 3 Demo
subtitle: Learn how to play Burgle Bros 3 - the cooperative heist
description_full: The Burgle Bros are back for a cyberpunk heist! After a dynamite-induced mishap, the team is propelled to a future dominated by AI and oppressive corporations. The classic Burgle Bros crew will use their old tricks as well as some newfound skills to infiltrate and take down these corporations from the inside.  Player count: 1-4 Estimated game time: 90 min There are two sides to everything - especially in Burgle Bros 3! Double sided Room Tiles  - Now when you explore you draw a tile from the bag - and use the side indicated based on what's happening in the game. This makes the map layout more diverse and more intelligent! Double sided Characters  - You start in a disguise that gives you cover for infiltrating. When you lose your "cool" you flip over to your "geared" outfit and gain a new ability! Double sided Guards  - Guards are now nastier and more intelligent androids called "Sysops" - there are 9 unique sysops each with their own special ability. They flip over to their red alert side as the game escalates!

title: Cubyria World Championship -- Semifinal Round
subtitle: Back for our second year! Could you be the Cubyria World Champion?
description_full: Compete against your fellow Architects to please the Mad Vizier and secure your permanent place in the Cubyria Hall of Fame ! In this semifinal round, you'll play a single game of Cubyria against up to four other competitors. The winner of each game will go on to the Saturday afternoon final!

title: The Great Commission Strategic Card Game Demo
subtitle: Full Demo of The Great Commission Strategic Card Game.
stand_name: The Great Commission Strategic Card Game
stand_label: The Great Commission Strategic Card Game (3-669)
description_full: While we will do brief descriptions ad-hoc all day long, this is a 20-minute demo of how to play. Going through two scripted rounds and covering all the bases. 11:00 and 14:30 each day.

title: Learn to Play First Blood!
subtitle: We hope to see you in person and have a great time teaching you our game and tactics! Bring a friend and dive in this amazing Skirmish game of Conques
description_full: Attending this Demo at the booth for 15 GBP teaches you the basic Rules of our Skirmish Game First Blood and gets you also an exclusive fishgnome miniature you can't find anywhere else!

title: Speed daemons 1-hour demo
subtitle: Illegal mech racing in the far future. It's The Matrix meets Fast & Furious with mechs!
description_full: Speed Daemons  is a Forged in the Dark game of illegal mech racing, set in a crumbling domed city on an alien world. Players form a team and race their mech in high-octane duels to release the relentless pressures of everyday life. But racing isn’t just a way to blow off steam - it’s a chance to reshape lives dominated by the oppression of the Three Houses. In the underground mech racing scene, races are arguments and victories are currency. Teams are united by their drive, a principle that every member believes in: family, an ideal, revolution, revenge. By racing, they win favours, make contacts, defeat rivals, earn (and offer) concessions, and work towards their finish line: a climactic race to decide their ultimate fate. It’s  The Matrix  meets  Fast & the Furious  with mechs. We'll give you a 1-hour crash course (heh) taster of the game. Pre-bookings available here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13B4ksaPEX3tREZWqbw-Aox_m0aXqaP21mkegcgUwGns/edit?usp=sharing

title: Learn to Play First Blood!
subtitle: We hope to see you in person and have a great time teaching you our game and tactics! Bring a friend and dive in this amazing Skirmish game of Conques
description_full: Attending this Demo at the booth for 15 GBP teaches you the basic Rules of our Skirmish Game First Blood and gets you also an exclusive fishgnome miniature you can't find anywhere else!

title: Basing Workshop
subtitle: Level up your basing
description_full: Join Siege Studios for a one-hour session focused on the art of basing—an essential step in bringing your miniatures together as complete, immersive pieces. This workshop explores how to design and build bases that enhance your model’s story, setting, and overall visual impact. You can look forward to  techniques for creating a variety of textures and environments, from simple, effective tabletop bases to more detailed scenic compositions. You’ll witness how to work with materials such as texture paints, pigments, tufts, and natural elements, as well as how to tie your base seamlessly into the colour scheme of your miniature. Whether you want to elevate your army to a cohesive force or give individual models a striking display finish, this session provides practical tips and professional approaches. . Ideal for hobbyists of all levels, it’s the perfect way to add that final layer of polish to your work.

title: Meet BattleTech Authors
subtitle: Meet BattleTech Authors!
description_full: Ever wanted to meet some of the BattleTech writing team? Now’s your chance! Several of the writing team will be at UKGE and will be available on the booth 3-150 to sign your books and answer questions about how they got started writing BattleTech, and how you might join their merry band! Current guests include: Chris Hartford:   Chris has played BattleTech since 1986 (which he bought at Games Workshop in Nottingham) and has been part of the writing team since 1991 after meeting Jordan Weisman and Ross Babcock in London.   Over the last 35 years he has contributed to too many BattleTech products to count. He has written for FASA, WizKids, FanPro and Catalyst Game Labs, including sourcebooks, Shrapnel articles, short stories (in Fire for Effect , The Proliferation Cycle , Honor Code and Tales of the Bounty Hunter )  and a serialized novel, Fall from Grace. He is currently working on [REDACTED] and [REDACTED]. Daniel Isberner: Daniel is a German novelist. He has written multiple novels for his own universes and dabbled in multiple shared universes. Battletech has been his long time favorite for more than 20 years and he has been working on it in different capacities for more than a…

title: Meet / Play with the Creators
subtitle: Meet the creative team behind the game and maybe even play a demo with them.
description_full: All 3 members of our team, the designer, artist, and producer will be on the stand and ready to demo ‘Trouble on the Tempus’ during these hours. They may be at the stand at other times over the weekend but these are the scheduled hours all of them will be there.

title: Nice to Know! Cosmos, Debut UK Playtest
subtitle: We are hosting the first-ever user demonstration of Nice to Know! Cosmos in UK.
description_full: You are invited to attend the debut demonstration of Nice to Know! Cosmos . As this is the first time the game will be showcased to a user group, the session will focus on live gameplay, mechanic walkthroughs, and initial user feedback. This is a rare opportunity to experience the game in its premiere state and contribute to its journey from prototype to launch. Yes the space is unlimited but for this event, our spaces are limited. :) See you there.

title: Adrian Tchaikovsky Meet
subtitle: Meet Adrian Tchaikovsky and talk Tyrant Philopshers RPG!
description_full: Author of The Tyrant Philosophers series (and many more!) is on hand to say hello, sign books and talk about the upcoming Tyrant Philosophers RPG from Handiwork Games

title: Glorious Revolution
subtitle: 1688: William of Orange landed at Torbay with around 14,000 men.
description_full: Each player takes on the role of a fugitive Stuart Judge, roaming across England visiting supporters and arranging for shipping of valuable donations to Carlisle ready for their escape into Scotland.  A quick tactical game of greed & treachery as players steer the revolutionary forces, gather loot and race for safety.

title: Learn to Play First Blood!
subtitle: We hope to see you in person and have a great time teaching you our game and tactics! Bring a friend and dive in this amazing Skirmish game of Conques
description_full: Attending this Demo at the booth for 15 GBP teaches you the basic Rules of our Skirmish Game First Blood and gets you also an exclusive fishgnome miniature you can't find anywhere else!

title: Blending Colours
subtitle: An hour session on blending paints, learning colours, how to apply smooth paint
description_full: Join Siege Studios for a focused, one-hour session dedicated to mastering smooth paint application and confident colour use on your miniatures. This workshop breaks down the core techniques behind clean, professional-looking finishes, helping you move beyond rough layers and visible brushstrokes. This demo will outline essentials of paint consistency, brush control, and layering, showing how to achieve seamless blends and smooth transitions across various surfaces. You’ll also explore key colour theory principles, learning how to choose, combine, and balance colours to create depth, contrast, and visual impact in your work. Whether you're struggling with chalky highlights or want to better understand how colours interact, this session is one not to miss.

title: Potemkin Villages - demo with designer
subtitle: Play the game with designer - Petr Čáslava
description_full: Play a tricky Trick-taking game Potemkin Villages with designer Petr Čáslava!

title: Feed the Kraken 'Sea of Shadows'
subtitle: Play a preview game with the Sea of Shadows expansion before its KS launch in Autumn 2026 with it's designer Maikel Cheney.
description_full: Set sail on a new, even more dangerous journey across the Sea of Shadows with this highly anticipated Feed the Kraken expansion. Rated the second highest social deduction game on BGG, Feed the Kraken engulfs you in world of hidden loyalties and treacherous betrayals. The Sea of Shadows expansion enriches the highly acclaimed core game with even more suspense mystery, and deduction, challenging you to navigate new threats and uncover the truth before it's too late.

title: Sneaky Goose - learn and  Play Session
subtitle: Meet the creators of Sneaky Goose, learn how to play, and jump straight into a game at the Worgan Games stand. Drop in, have a go!
description_full: Join Worgan Games at UK Games Expo for a hands-on Sneaky Goose Learn & Play session. This is a casual, drop-in demo where you can meet the creators, get a quick rules teach, and play the game right at the stand. Whether you’re completely new, just curious, or a seasoned gooser wanting to take on the masters, we’ll walk you through how Sneaky Goose works and let you experience the game as it’s meant to be played. No booking needed, no pressure, just turn up at any point during the session, play a round (or five), ask questions, and see what makes Sneaky Goose tick. Great for those who want to try something new, chat with the designers, and get a feel for the game before taking it home.

title: Crows versus Cats
subtitle: Collect your crow's favorite shiny thing before the cats can get their paws on them
description_full: A cozy chaos card game of collecting your favorite shiny things before the cats can knock them back to the discard pile. Avoid the thieving magpies, winds of change, and other agents of change in order to be the first to gather your shiny things before the other crows. This is a drop-in event. Stop by for a quick demo or a full play-through.

title: Mermaid's Song
subtitle: Hire mermaid ambassadors to entice sea creatures to help you claim the Coral Throne
description_full: A cozy chaos card game of mermaid diplomacy. Power up your mermaid ambassadors to entice sea creatures to your side to gain enough power to take the Coral Throne. Beware of the Kraken and the Treasure of the Deep which can sink your chances. Stop by the booth for a demo, or sit down for few rounds to try it out.

title: Live game demonstration of Blocks of Glory®
subtitle: Live demonstration of new game Blocks of Glory®, which introduces WarPlay - a new tactile and immersive wargaming experience.
description_full: Live game demonstration of Blocks of Glory®, which offers a tactile and immersive experience by integrating physical components like markers and messengers into core gameplay mechanics. Its focus on realism, command structure, and visual clarity makes it a unique and engaging alternative to more abstract or streamlined wargaming systems.

title: Pivot Demo
subtitle: Drop-in demos of Pivot running throughout the day at stand 4-673. Sessions 30–45 minutes.
description_full: Come and play Pivot — an economic strategy game about building tech startups, manipulating market hype, and timing your exit. Pre-production copies on the table for the first time. Sessions run 30–45 minutes and cover the full core loop. No experience needed — we'll teach you at the table. Sign up to the Kickstarter mailing list on the day for early access to the campaign launching February 2027. Stand 4-673. Drop in anytime or find us at teomachgames.com to follow the journey.

title: Try It Out
subtitle: Let your creativity flow — join us and build a base. Easier than it looks.
description_full: Think basing is only for experienced painters? Think again. Come join us at the GamersGrass station and let your creativity take over. Pick your materials, follow your instincts, and build a base that's entirely yours — our team is here to help every step of the way. It's simpler than it looks, it's free, and you take it home when you're done.

title: Fluffypede Demo
subtitle: Try out Fluffypede: Our super cute & compact card game with lots of depth and tactics!
description_full: During the full event, we will have live demos of Fluffypede . Games are short of around 20 minutes. Come alone or gather a group of up to 5 and try it out! Fluffypede is a super cute and compact card game, full of depth and tactical decisions. Players take the role of one of 8 unique Toymakers and take turns adding two-sided piece cards to the Fluffypedes on the table. The player who puts the last card that exactly completes an order, scores all its points! Swap, rotate, multiply or even cut Fluffypedes to surprise your opponents. Collect and use thread to use your unique abilities, that range from stealing and playing another player's card to changing the type of the pieces on the table. Anything goes to become the best Toymaker!

title: IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE STAND 4-316
subtitle: XD GAMES LIVE AUGMENTED REALITY GAMING
description_full: Free entertaintment for the period of the show: we provide our gaming tablets to try out our new crime investigation game in augmented reality: NUITS ROUGES .  Scan markers while moving around our stand to make objects appear in 3D - and try to solve the Quantum mystery murder case.

title: UNO Elite™
subtitle: Discover & Play UNO Elite™!

title: Console Wars The Card Game | Play!
subtitle: Try before you buy | Console Wars The Card Game
description_full: Curious if this vicious multiplayer game is going to be for you? Try before you buy!

title: Plunder: A Pirates Life Demos
subtitle: Learn to Play Plunder
description_full: Learn to Play Plunder: A Pirates Life, as you sail the seas in this turn based board game. Take over Islands, Upgrade your Fleet of Ships, Attack your Opponents and Hunt for Buried Treasure. Ages 10+

title: Mind Burp Games: Last Chance Mind Burp Demos
subtitle: Final day to experience the Mind Burp Games line-up at UK Games Expo
description_full: It’s your final chance to catch the full Mind Burp Games experience at this year’s UK Games Expo. Visit Hall 3, Stand 260 for live demos of our best-selling magical hits Mind Waves and Scribble Snap , alongside our newest launches Mental Match and Binary Flip . Binary Flip is our brand new black and white strategy game that proves you don’t need loads of components to create absolute tabletop chaos.  Meanwhile, Mental Match delivers powerful magic moments with minimal effort and maximum reactions. Whether you missed us earlier in the weekend or want one last game before the Expo ends, come and join the fun before the doors close.

title: SAS Rogue Regiment
subtitle: Come learn SAS Rogue Regiment with designer Robb Butler
description_full: The creator of the impressive and super popular SAS Rogue Regiment is joining us with Publisher Mark Rapson (Word Forge Games) to demo the game. This will also be the first opportunity to bag yourself a copy of the new ConShot 26 Expansion.

title: Devil Pig's Heroes of the Pacific
subtitle: Devil Pigs and their partner Word Forge Games bring Heroes of the Pacific to UK Games Expo
description_full: The Heroes system is back with Heroes of the Pacific. This is the first time this awesome game has been presented at UK Games Expo. Come check it out and get a demo

title: AWRY: The Forest
subtitle: Join creator James Ginn as he demos and discusses AWRY: The Forest
description_full: Only recently Kickstartered, AWRY the Forest should be on sale at Games Expo, but even if it isn't you can meet the creator James Ginn and get to demo his beautiful horror card game. Will you escape the Forest?

title: Pirates in a Barrel
subtitle: Join Henn Soffe-Hill as he demos and discusses Pirates in a Barrel, his first game in his ERG series of RPGs for families
description_full: Henn Soffe-Hill, the creator, demos Pirates in a Barrel, a family focused RPG. Henn is also joined by Elsa Rapson, the internal page artist to talk about the game and their plans for more games in their range (ERG - Educational Roleplaying by Elfling Games): I see Greeks in a Horse and Bards in a Theatre on the horizon.

title: Pocket Nautilus
subtitle: The new Pocket Nautilus by Scott Cyzsz debuts at UK Games Expo
description_full: New from the designer of the BGG award winning Pocket Landship comes Pocket Nautilus. This game features all new art and excellent game play. Can you out wit the British Navy and the creatures of the deep whilst discovering the treasure of the deep in this quick fun solo play pocket game.

title: SHIVER, the Universal Horror RPG
subtitle: Come try out SHIVER, a horror RPG for players of all experience levels!
description_full: SHIVER is the award winning horror RPG that helped make Parable Games what it is today. Come try a quick interactive demonstration with the creators!

title: ION Heart, the Cozy Mech Solo RPG
subtitle: Come and meet the creators of ION Heart, the Solo Mech RPG
description_full: ION Heart Solo is Parable Games most popular RPG, where you sail the stars with your mech best friend. Come try a quick interactive demonstration with the creators!

title: Don't Play This Game, Dark Solo Horror RPG
subtitle: Don't Play This Game, a crafty Solo game of dark horror.
description_full: Don't Play This Game is a pioneering Solo RPG about getting cursed by a terrifying entity. You'll have to write, photograph, craft and create your way to madness! Come try a quick interactive demonstration with the creators!

title: Ionic Smart Colors Demos & Paint and Take
subtitle: Discover Ionic Smart Colors with demos from painters and try them yourself!
description_full: We are running demos using Ionic Smart Colors throughout the expo, where you can ask questions and see the paints at work. Alongside this is a paint and take where you can try the paints out on a completely free model to take home with you!

title: Trench Crusade Demos
subtitle: Come and try the Trench Crusade ruleset!
description_full: We are running demos of Trench Crusade, with the Cruciform Order of St George facing off against Heretic Legion forces!

title: Teleporting Towers Demo/Playtesting
subtitle: If you like strategy board games, come along to try out Teleporting Towers!
description_full: I am sharing and playtesting my strategy board game, Teleporting Towers, from Sydney, Australia. It is designed for 2-4 players and games average between 30 minutes (for 2 players), 45 minutes (for 3 players), and 60+ minutes (for 4 players).  It is suitable for ages 12+ and it will take an additional 10-20 minutes to learn how to play.

title: Tales From The Spectral Sea
subtitle: A short, 1 hour session of Tales From The Spectral Sea
description_full: In this narrative-focussed TTRPG, you play as the crew of a ship who died at sea but couldn't pass on due to unresolved baggage or trauma. Instead, you sail The Spectral Sea, an afterlife for those with a love of adventure where they can finally 'live' out their swashbuckling dreams. All the while you'll be crossing paths with an eclectic bunch of other dead folks, helping them pass on, and eventually, passing on yourself.

title: Trouble Brewing - Demo
subtitle: Pop by our stand and try our debut game Trouble Brewing!
description_full: “Trouble Brewing”, the debut indie board game for Nightjar's Rest Studio, is a game of garden tending, potion brewing, fae magic using madness for 2-4 players. Players are pixies summoned by an overwhelmed Witch to help with her thriving potion business. Plant seeds, water them to grow them into ingredients, then harvest and add them to the cauldron to brew a variety of potions. Beware, adding the wrong ingredient to the cauldron will cause it to Boil Over! Use your fae magic to cause chaos in the garden - trick the Witch, help yourself, or hinder your opponents. Each helpful thing you do will earn you honey and sweet biscuits, a pixie's favourite things, and the player with the biggest haul of rewards at the end of the game is the winner! Trouble Brewing is a chaotic game of bluffing, planning, strategy and sabotage!

title: Black Metro Demo - Drop In
subtitle: Running drop in game demos at stand 4-533 near Hall 4 entrance.
description_full: Overview Black Metro is a strategic area control game where players battle each other to amass the most power and become the next ruler of the dark city. Gather resources to research powerful technologies, build fortifications and upgrade units. Control districts through military strength and dominate your opponents. Gain massive power through syndicate support and mission objectives. Features Workers have dual use: Winning spaces and using spaces Winning spaces prevents other players from fully using them Spread workers to use more spaces or consolidate for control Powerful technologies to ‘mix and match’ playstyles Manipulate objectives to serve your best interest

title: Free D20 Roll - Critical Hit Wins A Prize!
subtitle: Critical hit, to win a prize! Try your luck with a D20.
description_full: Are you feeling lucky? Roll a D20, hit a nat 20 and win a prize! Prizes include pins, minis and custom dice systems. Free to enter.

title: Split the Hoard Demo
subtitle: Play Split the Hoard in 30 minutes
description_full: Stop by the stand to join a game of Split the Hoard - on sale for the first time at UKGE for £15. Games will take around 30 minutes to play including teach time (subject to number of players). Split the Hoard is a competitive card game for 2-5 players, the games features hidden victory points, set collection, and " I cut, you choose " mechanics. In the game you take on the role of an adventurer who has achieved the pinnacle of any character’s career, the slaying of an ancient dragon. You and the other players are attempting to claim the best rewards from the hoard. You score points for treasures specific to your adventurer's needs and secret agendas. Negotiate, steal or bluff to ensure you get the loot you desire!

title: Survive Alive Board Game
subtitle: Survive Alive Board Game
description_full: Survive Alive is a draw and write game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Each round, survivors (players) need to manage their resources drawn from the community bag, build facilities for their characters in order to increase the community health and morale and most importantly defend their base to protect from the Zeds.

title: Stack the Letters. Defy Gravity. Win a Game!
subtitle: How high can you stack our giant letters before they fall?
description_full: Build the tallest free-standing tower. When the stack falls, that’s your final height! Note: Players must be quite tall or have very long arms. On purchasing a copy, enter your email into a raffle to win your money back!

title: Malediction
subtitle: Our demos will allow newcomers to step into the world of Malediction and learn what lies within.
description_full: Our demo event will allow newcomers to step into the world of Malediction and learn what lies within. Taught by some of our experienced helpers, these events will give new players the opportunity to fully immerse themselves in Malediction and learn the ins and outs of its rules. No material is necessary for you to bring, as we will provide everything needed to play. All you need to do is bring the energy and excitement to the tables! Demo's duration: 25min.

title: Shattered Destinies - The Mad King's Ire
subtitle: Come and try The Mad King's Ire
description_full: The Mad King’s Ire by Converge Games is coming to UKGE.  A brand new co-operative fantasy dungeon crawling board game featuring: Fast paced gameplay and combat with simultaneous turns. A twisting dungeon that is never the same. A whole host of dangerous foes and strange encounters to survive. Diverse character building options, level up, gain skills and powerful items to build your hero the way you want. Can you escape the Mad King’s dungeon before you succumb to the dangers within? Visit the Converge Games booth to try it out! The Mad King’s Ire coming to Kickstarter soon!

title: Shattered Destinies - The TTRPG
subtitle: Come and Try The Shattered Destinies TTRPG
description_full: Shattered Destinies is a fantasy tabletop roleplaying game featuring an intuitive dice pool system which seamlessly blends narrative and mechanics. Easy to pick up, with depth for those that want it. Save the town of New Verge! Throughout the weekend you will have the chance to decide the fate of a small town trying to rebuild after a devastating war. The populace find themselves under threat, beset by all manner of dangers, and in need of heroes to rescue them from their plight. The Shattered Destinies TTRPG core rulebook - The Heroes Primer, featuring everything players and GMs need to begin their adventures using the Shattered Destinies system will be available to buy at a special UKGE only discounted price.

title: Hercules and the 12 Labors
subtitle: Step into the sandals of Hercules and battle your way through the legendary 12 Labors in this epic solo card and dice game.
description_full: Hercules: The 12 Labors is a solo card and dice game that plunges you into the heart of Greek mythology. Take on the role of the legendary hero as you face each of the Twelve Labors, iconic challenges that will test your strength, endurance, and strategy. Each labor presents unique obstacles, events, and dangers. As Hercules, you’ll manage your health, harness powerful artifacts earned from past victories, and balance your growing divinity as you push closer to godhood. Every decision matters, as success in one labor can shape your chances in the next. Designed for solo play, Hercules: The 12 Labors delivers a rich, replayable experience with escalating difficulty, meaningful choices, and a strong narrative arc, all in a compact format. Can you survive the trials, complete the labors, and ascend to Olympus?

title: Cats vs Cucumbers
subtitle: Sometimes referred to as Catzee, Cats vs Cucumbers is a press your luck dice game packed with chaotic fun and laugher, watch out for those cucumbers!
description_full: Roll the dice and chase combos in Cats vs Cucumbers! Collect sets of boxes, cat paws, toys, and treats to score points, but watch out for dreaded cucumbers, or you’ll bust and lose it all. This press your luck game challenges you to balance risk and reward as you decide whether to push your luck for bigger combos or play it safe. With multiple paths to victory, every roll counts! Easy to learn, endlessly replayable, and packed with unpredictable fun, Cats vs Cucumbers is perfect for families, casual gamers, and anyone who loves a little feline chaos.

title: Tiny Game Series
subtitle: Big fun in tiny boxes! The Tiny Game Series features clever solo and multiplayer games Confusing Lands, Sirens, Defrag, and 16 Candies!
description_full: Discover the Tiny Game Series by Envy Born Games, a collection of small, but mighty travel size games packed with big ideas and endless fun! Each game offers a unique experience that’s easy to learn, quick to play, and perfect for gaming on the go. Confusing Lands lets you draft and place whimsical floating world cards, scoring in different ways each game for endless strategic variety. Sirens is a Greek mythology-inspired card drafting game for 1 to 2 players where you draft cards to create songs, unlocking your inner composer, even if you don’t read music. Defrag challenges your spatial awareness with travel sized solo puzzles that test your logic and dexterity. 16 Candies is a fun set collection game where players are encouraged to eat candies or sweets when they lose health. This is a light game looking to introduce a younger audience to gaming. Compact, portable, and endlessly replayable, the Tiny Game Series proves that great adventures don’t need big boxes, they just need big ideas.

title: SWAT: First Response 'TOP COP' Competition
subtitle: Have you got what it takes to be a top cop? Play our fast and deadly SWAT encounter at UKGE and win exclusive prizes!
description_full: Have you got what it takes to be a top cop!  Play our fast and deadly SWAT encounter against the clock. Players will be on a timer to see who can get into the gang hideout, locate the big bad guy and take him down in the fastest time possible. Rescuing hostages and taking down other bad guys don't count in this exclusive UKGE competition version. We just want you to take out the big bad! Officer training will take around 5 minutes, then you're on you're own! Here's what could happen: 1 - Join in, take a wrong move and get taken out by the bad guys (or maybe you accidentally shot a hostage) and you'll still walk away with a free gift. 2 - Join in and take out the bad guy successfully.  Your time will be recorded on the scoreboard. 3 - By 3pm on the Sunday, the player with the fastest time will be given a mention on our Instagram feed and full bragging rights and promoted to the official SWAT top cop! A live scoreboard will keep track of players over the 3 day competition. Players may enter more than once to improve their time! Whilst we're happy to see players of all ages, parents of children under 14 should be aware of the thematic nature and imagery of the game. The game depicts…

title: Galaxy Farmer - Save the Galaxy!
subtitle: Play Galaxy Farmer before its release! Get a FREE game promo item.
description_full: Galaxy Farmer is a worker placement and resource management game that has a good mix of space-pirate fighting, strategy, order fulfilment and galactic adventuring! The game is live on kickstarter soon (along with our other two games SWAT: First Response and Package Pandemonium). Get the chance to rocket around the galaxy, fight pirates and fulfil an order with your workerbots on our exclusive demo copy at the UKGE show. Space mission briefings will take about 5 minutes and farming the galaxy will take around 20 minutes.

title: Package Pandemonium - 3 rounds of mayhem!
subtitle: Package Pandemonium - play 3 rounds of package mayhem and try to win the most points! FREE Game promo item!
description_full: Package Pandemonium is a 2 - 4 player route planning, package collecting, priority bidding, take-that, race for points around a whacky city! The game is live on kickstarter soon(along with our other games SWAT: First Response and Galaxy Farmer)! In this demo version, players will throw down against their opponents to see who can get the most points.  The full game comes with four different playtime settings, allowing players to choose how long they have to ‘get a game in’ and comes with secret missions and much more.

title: Feed the Kraken with the designer
subtitle: Join this epic social deduction game lead by the designer Maikel Cheney throughout the day.
description_full: Feed The Kraken is a hidden role deduction game featuring three asymmetric factions, each with their own secret agenda. Though all players are aboard the same ship, their goals couldn’t bet be more different! The loyal sailors must navigate the ship safely to the mainland, while the pirates covertly steer it toward Crimson Cove. Meanwhile, a mad cultist works to sway the crew into summoning the Kraken from the depths, believing it will ‘save’ them all. Trust no-one as deception lurks around every corner!

title: All Day Demos
subtitle: All-day battles. All-out tactics. Drop in any time.

title: Try before you buy
subtitle: If you are interested in any of the games we have on sale but want to give them a go first here is your opportunity.
description_full: Unhappy Arrangements, Orcwood Showdown and Dirty Spatula are all available for demoing. Just come on down and tell us what you want to play.

title: Heroes Vs Hordes
subtitle: Heroes VS Hordes is a cooperative wave based survival game, become of one of the Heroes and try to keep the Demon Lord and his minions at bay
description_full: Heroes VS Hordes is a cooperative wave based survival game, take on the role of one of the adventurers and try to keep the Demon Lord and his minions at bay. Random enemies will be spawned every turn as you desperately try to keep them back, earning currency to buy new items and upgrades. As you become more powerful, so to will the horde, sending more dangerous enemies into the fray. After 6 rounds, one of the Demon Lord's lieutenants will surge from the portal to try to stop you personally. Transitioning to the second phase will bring a new map and the enemies will be fight harder to get their revenge. You must continue to survive to draw out the true master of these fiends to stop them once and for all. Are you up to the task?

title: Family Fun
subtitle: Swing by Bear Faced Games to pick‑up‑and‑play Hankman, KPop Demon Hunters: Truth or Dare, The Cup Challenge, and Pokémon Trainer Expert
description_full: Swing by Bear Faced Games to pick‑up‑and‑play Hankman, KPop Demon Hunters: Truth or Dare, The Cup Challenge, and Pokémon Trainer Expert. Go on, play one of our games we double bear dare you!

title: Sanibel
subtitle: COLLECT THE SHELLS OF SANIBEL ISLAND: Stroll along the shore, collect seashells, and arrange them for points. Elizabeth Hargrave’s Sanibel game.
description_full: Sanibel Island, Florida is known for its treasure trove of seashells. Stroll its shore and collect shells and other natural wonders: sand dollars, sea stars, crabs, and more! In the Sanibel board game, designed by Elizabeth Hargrave, players move their player token along the beach-themed board, drafting shell tiles and strategically arranging them on their mat for points. Collect different shell sets and combinations to earn the most points possible. The player with the highest score wins! The rules are simple to learn, and players can enjoy mastering strategies in this highly replayable game. Enjoy it as a game for 2 players or with up to 4. Tile laying games and family board games are fun games for a vacation home, Family Game Night, and after dinner. Strategy board games for adults and family are also wonderful gifts for kids ages 10+, teens, and adults.

title: Market Fresh
subtitle: A simple tile-laying game of market mastery, designed by Michael Kiesling and Wolfgang Kramer. Ages 8+
description_full: "A simple tile-laying game of market mastery, designed by Michael Kiesling and Wolfgang Kramer. For every business-savvy farmer in town, the local farmers market is the place to be! Stack your stall with crates of picture-perfect produce and shut your competitors out of the market. The more you stack, the more you'll sell! ​   In the Market Fresh board game, players strategically stack produce crates in their shopfront to maximize their stock—and shut competitors out of the market along the way! They earn points as they add fresh produce, but must be sure to keep an eye on the market as they go. As the competition heats up, space in the market might become scarce. Once all the crates have been placed, the player with the most points wins!   This strategic tile game features an engaging story, mental depth, beautiful custom artwork, and endless replayabilty."

title: Great Heights
subtitle: Great Heights Board Game, Family Strategy Games for Kids, Teens, and Adults, Ages 10+
description_full: Race to the top in the Great Heights strategic board game! It’s the golden age of mountaineering, and 5 rival climbing groups are vying to be the first to summit an unexplored mountain. Lead a crew and take the journey: choose each step carefully, enlist rescue dogs to avoid hazards, and make the news as your crew climbs. Each player gets a unique board and set of mountaineer pawns. On their turn, they pick a card from their hand to play and pass the rest. Some cards help players move pawns up their board’s path, while others offer resources like rope and tents. Make strategic choices to earn points. The player with the most after 3 rounds wins! Includes 5 boards and 52 cards with droll illustrations by Charlie Layton, 55 wooden meeples, and more. Strategy board games for kids and adults are fun games for Family Game Night, and the Great Heights game is one of the best strategy games for game nights with friends.

title: Minero
subtitle: GET RICH OR GO BOOM: In the Minero strategy card game, players push their luck to win big or bust!
description_full: Get rich or go BOOM! The Minero strategy card game is a fun and fast-paced game for the whole family. Take turns flipping cards from the draw pile and placing them on the table. Be ready to think quick and slap fast to claim gem, gold nugget, and diamond cards. But don’t wait too long—if 4 sticks of dynamite are flipped, the mine will blow and wipe all the remaining treasures off the table. Once players have reached the end of the deck, the mine is empty and whoever claimed the most valuable objects wins! Designed by Ken Gruhl and Quentin Weir, this fun family game combines simple rules and strategy. For 2 to 5 players ages 8+, the Minero game is an engaging family party game for games nights and everyday play. Party card games for families also make cool kids gifts for fans of fun family games.

title: Hi9
subtitle: SUPSENSEFUL CARD GAME OF STRATEGY & LUCK: The tension builds with every flip of a card in the edge-of-your-seat! It’s a fast and easy to learn.
description_full: Fit the grid or bust in the Hi9 card game! On each player’s turn, they’ll flip cards from the deck and try to place them in a 3x3 grid. First they’ll pick a spot in the grid to place a card. Then, before they flip, they’ll predict whether the number on the card will be greater or less than the cards adjacent to that spot. Guess right and add it to the grid. Guess wrong and collect all the cards in the grid! The player with the fewest cards at the end of the game wins! Includes 70 bright, bold cards, illustrated in a modern pop art style by Ronin Design. It’s a fun card game for game nights, icebreakers, and impromptu play. Family card games for kids and adults are great holiday gifts and rewards for those who love party card games and strategy card games.

title: Priorities
subtitle: HILARIOUS PARTY GAME OF EXTREME HONESTY & ABSURD CHOICES: How well do you know your friends?
description_full: The Priorities game is the party game of absurd choices. To play, draw 5 everyday item cards and rank them from love to loathe. The other players work as a group to try to guess your order. Then compare your answers. It’s everyone versus the game! You all earn a card for every item in the same rank, and the game earns the rest. To win, spell PRIORITIES using the letters on the backs of your earned cards before the game does. For 2 or more players, this unpredictable, fun party game for adults and teens takes only 2 minutes to learn and about 30 minutes to play. So, if you’re looking to add hilarity to Family Game Night and gatherings with friends, rank the Priorities game at the top of your list! Its compact size makes it a great portable game for vacations, camping, and nights out. Game night games for groups are cool gifts for teens ages 14+ and adults too.

title: Monopoly FIFA + Monopoly FIFA Legends Booster
subtitle: COLLECT, TRADE, COMPETE: Go for FIFA World Cup 2026 glory in this Monopoly Panini Prizm: FIFA World Cup board game!
description_full: Celebrate current stars, FIFA WORLD CUP legends, and memorable moments—and compete at the FIFA World Cup 2026 in the Monopoly Panini Prizm: FIFA World Cup game! In this version of the Monopoly game, select soccer stars on Panini cards to build a world-class team. Then move around the board taking control of as many FIFA World Cup historic matches as possible. Compete for points from opponents who land on those matches by comparing stats on the Panini cards and rolling special dice. To earn more points, beat opponents in Game Changer challenges and compete at the FIFA World Cup 2026! The player with the most points at the end of the game wins. Looking for fun games for Family Game Night or cool gifts for kids, teens, college students, or adults? This strategy board game for soccer fans is a great choice! For 2 to 4 players, ages 8+.

title: Monopoly Deal No Mercy
subtitle: MOST RUTHLESS EDITION YET: Warning: This outrageously fun and fast Monopoly Deal No Mercy card game may cause tears, table-flipping, and tantrums.
description_full: Make bank, not friends in the most ruthless Monopoly Deal edition yet! In the Monopoly Deal No Mercy game, get ready for meaner swaps, sneakier deals, and nastier schemes. Players compete to be the first to collect 3 property sets. But unlike in the classic Monopoly Deal game, a set can be stolen instantly! That’s because Action cards got a mean makeover—use them to charge double rent and even force someone to hand over their Bank. When a player can’t pay an opponent, they must fork over a debt chip and pay them back with one of their cards. This wildly fun family card game is one of the best card games for game nights, parties, and anytime play, and it’s a great portable game for travel. Family games and strategy card games for kids are also cool gifts for ages 8+.

title: Heroquest First Light + Wizards of Morcar
subtitle: EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO START PLAYING: Designed for newcomers and fans alike, the HeroQuest First Light Game System.
description_full: Your hero’s journey starts here! The HeroQuest First Light fantasy adventure game follows 4 heroes through dungeon quests as they discover treasure, explore immersive environments, and battle evil forces controlled by Zargon, the game master. Traverse an ever-changing, 2-sided board that evolves as you trek through each dungeon. Will you prove yourself worthy of the title of hero? Players can immerse themselves in the fantasy with stunning artwork and more than 100 components, including a detailed dragon miniature, 4 hero miniatures, and 67 full-color cardboard standees. Featuring 10 quests and the option to create your own, this HeroQuest board game has endless replayability. It’s a great gift for fans of cooperative games, fantasy board games, and strategy games for adults and teens. Gather friends together for an exciting night of tabletop gameplay in a battle of good and evil. For 2-5 players, ages 14+.

title: Zoology
subtitle: Zoology - Escaped beasts, hidden clues — Can you catch them all?
description_full: When the pages of the Great Encyclopedia Zoologica burst open, the wild is unleashed and only sharp minds can restore order. The Great Encyclopedia Zoologica has cracked, scattering creatures from alpacas to platypuses into a chaotic world where instincts run wild and facts matter more than ever. In Zoology , you become a team of curious and quick-witted zoologists, trying to identify animals based on clues and characteristics before the Age of Discovery slips into an Age of Chaos. Zoology is a 2–6 player deduction game where you become zoologists identifying animals scattered from the Great Encyclopedia Zoologica. Players secretly receive an animal card (visible only to others) and must deduce their own identity by asking comparative questions about characteristics, appearance, and behavior. The game blends analytical thinking and clever communication into a lively 15–30 minute puzzle. Play competitively to identify your animal first, or co-operatively to identify all animals within a turn limit. Optional modules and fun facts add variety to this social deduction challenge.

title: Math Masters Board Game All-Day Demo
subtitle: We will have 2-3 copies of the game set up for players to try and staff to demo.
description_full: We will be presenting our latest release, Math Masters, with copies available to purchase and 2-3 copies set up for consumers / retailers to give it a try. About the Game Deep within the mysterious realm of numbers, hidden among floating digits and sparkling stars, stand the Math Masters Academy. Students will learn how to unravel the secrets of the numeric world! 2 out of 3 children struggle with Maths. By playing Math Masters , maths skills are trained in a fun and playful way. Imagine a world where numbers come alive, logic is your superpower and learning becomes a thrilling adventure. That’s the world of Math Masters . Math Masters is an educational and exciting board game where mental maths, strategy, and magic come together. Designed for children, families, grandparents and even teachers, it makes maths more fun than ever before. Players compete in the game to be the first to reach the finish line. Each turn, you roll the dice, face a maths challenge and make clever calculations to outsmart your opponents. Use the strategic cards at the right moment. The game blends quick thinking with tactical play, offering a mix of fun, challenge and learning moments without the feeling…

title: Crits & Tricks
subtitle: Take a seat at the most dangerous card table in Eldris.
description_full: In the shadowed corners of The Gutter’s End, every shuffle of the deck could lead to riches or ruin. Crits & Tricks is a high-stakes trick-taking game where the quests you embark on each round will reward you with loot. Each quest you draft has a unique objective you’ll strive to complete by pairing your rolled dice with mercenaries from unique classes, Each class not only sets the win condition for the trick but also possesses a powerful CRIT ability that could shift the odds of the game in your favor. Rise to the Barkeep’s Challenge in every round, winning the right number of tricks to claim extra loot. Lighten the pockets of your new 'friends' to win the game—but be wary, or you might walk away with more rivals than riches.

title: Ice and Idols
subtitle: Ice & Idols is a unique pick-up and deliver game for 2-4 adventurers with a twist—literally!
description_full: Embark on a thrilling expedition for knowledge in Ice & Idols! Your expedition has discovered an ancient temple cloaked in ice and dust, containing a labyrinth of ever shifting pathways. Time is of the essence as you navigate this frozen maze, uncovering Idols that hold powerful secrets. Ice & Idols is a unique pick-up and deliver game for 2-4 adventurers with a twist—literally! Rotate the temple ruins and manipulate pathway tiles to your advantage, strategically positioning yourself to research the Idols and harness their hidden powers. Every move you make could lead to groundbreaking discoveries or unforeseen obstacles.

title: Thieves of Eldris
subtitle: In Thieves of Eldris, fortunes are forged in the shadows, one stolen coin at a time.
description_full: Amid the chaos of bustling merchants, you lurk in the shadows, eyes locked on your target, ready to slice their coin purse and make off with the spoils. The Thieves' Guild has taken notice of your talents, but earning your place among them won't be easy. To prove your skill, you must outwit your rivals, steal from your targets, and keep your true identity hidden. Roll the dice to navigate the crowded square, rearranging townsfolk and setting up daring heists. Slip past rival thieves undetected, and when the time is right, liberate your targets of their precious coin. But beware, one wrong move and your rivals might expose you, stealing not only your newfound riches, but your invitation to the Thieves' Guild. Will you become the guild's newest initiate, or will your ambitions leave you penniless in the gutter?

title: Tug of Roar
subtitle: The roar of battle echoes across Eldris.
description_full: The feud between the Elkyr and Lycarans has raged for generations, but this clash could reshape the future of Eldris forever. Townsfolk across the land are watching, ready to lend their skills to the clan they trust to lead them into a new age. As the leader of your clan, you’ll command your Captains to bid for powerful recruits, deploy warbands to contested regions, and inspire your forces to push the Roar Track in your favor, intimidating your rival and hindering their plans. Unleash the unique class abilities of your recruits to outmaneuver your opponent and seize control of the battlefield. Each victory raises more of your clan’s banners, bringing you closer to claiming the throne of Eldris. Only one clan will rise to power, will it be yours?

title: Earth: Animal Kingdom
subtitle: From the burrowing pocket gopher to the soaring golden eagle, each animal breathes new life into Earth.
description_full: Expand the award-winning game Earth with the Animal Kingdom expansion, which introduces 36 new animals, each with powerful asymmetrical abilities that change how you build your tableau. Whenever you use a leaf, your chosen animals activate, generating resources, triggering abilities, or unlocking new scoring opportunities. At the end of each round, a global animal ability activates for all players, providing everyone with an opportunity to plan ahead to leverage its effects. No two animals play the same. Each one interacts with your tableau in a unique way, challenging you to shape your ecosystem to maximize their potential. Animal Kingdom brings your tableau roaring to life with animeeples that roam your tableau, interacting with the flora and terrain you've cultivated.

title: Draft & Write Records
subtitle: Do you have what it takes to hit the big time? Can you take your band from the garage to the world’s most famous concert venues?
description_full: Draft and arrange your lead singer, musicians, production staff, and backstage staff to create harmony – unlocking more fans, money, and opportunities. Plan your schedule, prioritize your assets, and map out your tour route to chain bonus rewards and leave your fans screaming for more.  Will your music rocket to the top of the charts, landing your band in the #1 spot? Or will the pressure of stardom prove to be too much?

title: Perch
subtitle: Keep your feathered friends close and your enemies closer in Perch — a battle of the birds!
description_full: Players fight for control of locations by commanding birds of their own–and other players’–flocks. Earn points and command creatures by having the most birds on a location, pushing your foes off the perch, and breaking ties to take the lead. With a modular tile configuration and a variety of creatures to control, each game will present a new tactical challenge. Don’t let this cozy homestead fool you–get ready for winged warfare!

title: Block and Key
subtitle: Cleverly place 3D blocks in a shared space to unlock the key to victory points.
description_full: A 1-4 player game, where adventurers place 3D clay blocks in a centralized raised playing area, with the goal of completing their own request cards. The challenge is made more interesting as each player is limited to their “2D” viewpoint.

title: Summit: The Board Game
subtitle: Summit is a survival game which can be played competitively, cooperatively or solo!
description_full: In a competitive game, players race up and down the deadly mountain while managing their resources, building their path, overcoming obstacles and attempting to survive their competition. Summit uses a unique Karma System which allows players to actively help or hinder their opponents – but it also affects end game scoring. For a few extra points you could share some of your valuable food or oxygen, or maybe you can afford to lose some points so you choose to cut their rope and watch them disappear down the mountain. In a cooperative or solo game, players must work together to overcome the mountain and survive the expedition. Summit is a game so gruelling you only need one team member to survive the ascent and descent, so players may sacrifice themselves for the good of the team. Mechanics are changed as a “Sherpa Track” and a “Time of Day Track” are added, as well as a whole new stack of event cards. It is unlikely everyone will be returning from this expedition.

title: Escape The Ghost Train Demo and FREEBIES!
subtitle: Escape The Ghost Train | New Spooky Board Game featuring vibrant 100% human-drawn neon art
description_full: Escape The Ghost Train is a spooky push-your-luck competitive board game for 1-4 players, designed by Craig Tubbs with artwork by Amanda Sutton. Click the link for our Kickstarter page. Come and meet us at the Beardy Boo Games stand (3A-B59) to see the game in action, try it for yourself, and pick up some FREE GOODIES, and enter our contest to win a copy of the game!

title: Oranges and Lemons
subtitle: Demo of this Euro based on a traditional British nursery Rhymme
description_full: Oranges and Lemons is a worker placement game. Starting with just two workers, limited storage capacity and only able to transport what one person can carry the players must make the best they can of early 18th-century London, expanding their transport by acquiring first a hand cart, then a horse and cart and ultimately a ship, and by visiting locations mentioned in and activities inspired by the Oranges and Lemons nursery rhyme. Here they can buy and sell goods such as lemons, pancakes, bricks and pans, get involved in the moneylending business, fulfil export contracts at the docks, try their hand at politics, invest in the early stock market or back risky but possibly lucrative expeditions to the East Indies. There are multiple routes to obtaining wealth and prestige. The winner will be the player who can best combine the available strategies to emerge as a Master of Commerce, with the city at their feet.

title: Demo of Great Fire of Chicago1871
subtitle: Can you save the Windy City or watch it burn?
description_full: In 1871 a fire started at the O'Leary Barn swept through and destroyed the heart of the great city of Chicago. In this game players both manipulate and move the fire and at the same time try to contain it and defeat it, protecting their own properties and goods and hidden secret objectives. Can you save the windy city... or just watch it burn? This game is from the same publisher as The Great Fire of London 1666 . The game uses the same core mechanics as Great Fire of London - wind cards move the fire, Action points move the fire fighters and put out the fire. Players have hidden locations to protect. What is new? Its a totally new board based on the City of Chicago in 1871. Objectives are historically important locations in Chicago. Art will be 19th century American in style. New mechanics include: A representation of the alarm mechanism in city A representation of the attempt to get people and possessions across the river.

title: 26.2 Playthrough Demos
subtitle: Playthrough demos of 26.2, a marathon running racing game.
description_full: We will be running demos of 26.2 throughout the weekend. Full demos will be approx 90 mins, short demos will be approx 60 mins. The full demo includes playthrough of both phases of the game, Training and The Race, whilst short demos will include Training and a shorter half-marathon race. The full or short demo is based on player preference. The Training phase is 3 rounds of play and pass card drafting to complete a 12 ‘week’ training plan to create your runner's fitness atributes. The Race phase is hand management from a shared ‘Pace’ deck, with additional movement coming from each player's personal attributes on their Fitness Tracker which were gained during Training. Can you train the perfect runner to win over the iconic marathon distance of 26.2 miles?

title: Chess-à-tête Demos
subtitle: Play the chess-inspired card game Chess-à-tête
description_full: Come and play the chess-inspired card game Chess-à-tête; a 2 player card battle game full of stategy and mayhem. No chess experience required! Suitable for all ages. Play against the creators or play against a friend as we guide you through the game.  Freebies will be on the stand, exclusive offers and Prizes to be won for anyone who can win by a checkmate ♟️ Also you can test out our new expansion packs and playmats which will be available for purchase at the expo.

title: Three Kobolds in a Trench Coat Demo
subtitle: Three Kobolds in a Trench Coat is a bluffing, party game for 2-4 players. The last player with hidden Kobolds wins the game.
description_full: Three Kobolds in a Trench Coat is a bluffing, party game for 2-4 players. After spending too long in the dark, the Kobolds are ready to see what life is like in the village of Crumblebatch. But there's a problem: the villagers aren’t exactly welcoming to monsters. To blend in, the Kobolds have come up with a cunning plan - to dress up in a trench coat and pretend to be a regular person. Now, as a “citizen”, players must avoid suspicion. Each player must keep their Kobolds hidden by completing Quests, collecting Gold, and defeating opponents in Challenges. Pay the Guards to redirect attention toward others and use Items to protect themselves or expose their rivals’ Kobolds one by one. The last player with hidden Kobolds wins the game.

title: Tunnels & Trolls: A New Age
subtitle: A fantasy roleplaying game where ordinary characters become fated heroes, in a land shaped by mighty trolls.
description_full: Trolls are strange creatures, made of earth and rock, said to grow to enormous size. Every child is told that sunlight sends them into a deep slumber, but shelter them in darkness long enough, and they may once again awaken. But perhaps that’s just a story.    One thing is known, though. Centuries ago, the sky turned black and trolls roamed the land. Kingdoms and empires fell, their technology and magic buried with them deep in the earth, along with the truth of what happened.    The sun returned, and people rebuilt. But below the surface, in tunnels that wind deep underground, the riches of the past still lie in wait. To venture where trolls may roam is a task only for the very brave – or the very foolhardy. But then, what would-be heroes aren’t?   Tunnels & Trolls: A New Age reimages the classic game, with combat that is as easy and lightning-quick as it is immediate and thrilling; where your characters are at once ordinary and fated heroes; and where adventures bring you deep into dark tunnels, face-to-face with ancient trolls and powerful magicks.  Beloved in the original game, exploding dice make a triumphant return, with players rolling pools of dice that burst into action…
