title: Strike HQ - The Game of Battle Strategy
subtitle: Learn to play Strike HQ - the hidden movement battle game!
description_full: Strike HQ is an expandable card game that brings the classic thrill of real-time strategy (RTS) video games to the tabletop with an innovative blend of hidden information and action programming. CONSTRUCT. DEPLOY. STRIKE. Starting with only a headquarters and a handful of units, you play commanders of opposing factions racing to CONSTRUCT bases, DEPLOY units, and launch a STRIKE against the enemy HQ.  Key Features:  The Best of RTS – You and your opponent take simultaneous turns building your bases and gathering resources, all while putting together a combined arms offensive of infantry, mechanised, airborne & naval forces.  True Fog of War – Your unit cards enter play and move around the battlefield face down , concealing them from your opponent until they are met in battle. Good commanders will learn to read the limited information on the battlefield and anticipate enemy plans.  A Level Playing Field –Every game of Strike HQ is a fair fight where the winner is determined by player skill alone. Each faction has access to equally powerful cards ensuring complete balance . It’s not about what cards you’ve got, it’s how you use them. Pure Strategy & Tactics - There is no dice…

title: Play Trouble on the Tempus
subtitle: Play our first board game 'Trouble n the Tempus' exclusively at the UKGE
description_full: Our first board game has just been released and can be played at the UKGE 2026 but more importantly can be purchased for the first time at the convention. It is a cooperative game of time travelling disaster management for 2 to 5 players. Our Kickstarter successfully funded at UKGE 2025 and we are thrilled to now have to game out this year.

title: Papyria demo
subtitle: Board game Papyria will be demoing the whole fair
description_full: The board game Papyria will be demoing the whole fair. Get the explanation directly from the designer, grab your copy, and get it signed if you want.

title: Pathfinder Second Edition Demo
subtitle: Try out the Pathfinder roleplaying game as you face off against boggards in the swamp.
description_full: Pathfinder is a fantasy roleplaying game in which players take on the role of daring heroes going on epic quests. The second edition ruleset is easy to learn, quick to play, and offers deeper customization than ever before. Try out the game with this short (approximately 30 minutes) demo adventure, guided by an experienced Game Master! Pregenerated characters and game aids are provided. Absolutely no experience is needed with roleplaying games; players of all skill and experience level are welcome!

title: Starfinder Second Edition Demo
subtitle: Try out the Starfinder roleplaying game as you face off against robots in the street.
description_full: Starfinder is a science-fantasy roleplaying game in which players take on the role of daring heroes going on epic quests–in SPACE! The second edition ruleset is easy to learn, quick to play, and offers deeper customization than ever before. Try out the game with this short (approximately 30 minutes) demo adventure, guided by an experienced Game Master! Pregenerated characters and game aids are provided. Absolutely no experience is needed with roleplaying games; players of all skill and experience level are welcome!

title: Pathfinder Quest Demo
subtitle: A cooperative adventure game where your characters grow in power and shape the story.
description_full: Will the people of Darkmoon Vale return to a peaceful life or will they be forced to flee from their homes to face an uncertain future? Only you and your actions will decide! In Pathfinder Quest, you and your fellow players will undertake a single adventure, braving a series of encounters that form just part of a larger ongoing narrative. As you play through the campaign, your characters will grow in power, gaining new feats and spells that enable you to face even more powerful foes and gather wondrous treasure. Throughout this campaign, your actions will shape the end of the story through the record of your deeds and the choices you’ve made. Players will be taught the game by an expert volunteer and then play an introductory adventure.

title: Come and play Viking Raiders
subtitle: Try out a quick game of Viking Raiders
description_full: This is your chance to try out this highly interactive, award-winning card game. Enjoy the comfy lambskins of our Viking Longhouse, and get a great teach of the game from the designer himself or from one of the other team members (all family). Everyone on our booth has been involved with the game from its very beginnings and has had a hand in making it what it is today, so you won't get a better introduction to the game. An ideal intro for anyone from the age of 7 and up. Expected playing time 25-35 minutes. If you are on your own or in a couple, we will match you up with other players until you have a good group to enjoy the game with.

title: Live Demo - Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit
subtitle: Step Into the Hunt. Capture Cryptids Before Your Rivals Do.
description_full: Enter the World of Kryptothera The hunt has already begun. Across a fractured world shaped by myth and ambition, cryptids roam freely. Hunters rise from every corner, chasing legend, power, and prestige. In Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit , you will step into this world and experience the thrill of the chase in a guided session led by one of the game’s creators. What You’ll Experience This is not just a demo. This is your first expedition. 🎲 A guided 30-minute session led by the creators 🗺️ Play through 5 rounds of the game with the full experience condensed 🐉 Hunt, capture, and secure cryptids before your rivals ⚖️ Feel the tension of competitive PvE and PvP gameplay 💬 Hear the story behind the creation of the game as you play Every decision matters. Push deeper into the wild, or return to safety before everything is lost. How It Works   👥 Up to 4 players per session 🚶 Drop-in play — no booking required ⏱️ Sessions run continuously throughout the event Step in when a table opens… and begin your hunt. Prepare for the Hunt Study the hunter’s handbook before you arrive and gain the edge: 👉 Read the Rulebook Find Us Join us at the NoctiLux Games stand (3A-644) and discover what…

title: Cryptid Smash - Live Demo
subtitle: Cryptid Smash: Unleash the Chaos
description_full: Step into a world where legendary creatures do not hide in the shadows… they collide. In Cryptid Smash , cryptids clash in a fast-paced, unpredictable card battle where every move can turn the game on its head. Match cards, trigger powerful effects, and sabotage your opponents as you race to be the first to empty your hand. One moment you are in control, the next everything spirals into chaos. Inspired by folklore, each card introduces a new twist. Reverse the flow of play, force your rivals to draw, mirror their moves, or unleash devastating combinations at just the right moment. It is easy to learn, quick to play, and designed for big groups, loud reactions, and constant momentum. 🎮 Game Details • Players: 2 to 10 • Playtime: ~20 minutes • Age: 7+ Curious to master the chaos before you arrive? 👉 Read the Rulebook here Or experience it the way it was meant to be played. Join us at the NoctiLux Games booth (Hall 3A-644) and jump straight into a live demo. Our team will guide you through the game, teach you the rules in minutes, and throw you into the action alongside other players. No booking needed. Just drop in, take a seat, and let the cryptids loose. 🐉

title: Ironmasters of Yorkshire and Fantasy Crystals
subtitle: Games demonstration and playtesting
description_full: Ironmasters of Yorkshire   by   Michal Jarzembowski IRONMASTERS OF YORKSHIRE is a competitive economic strategy game set in late 18th-century Yorkshire during the Industrial Revolution. Players take the roles of ironmasters who develop mines, produce steel, establish companies, and build infrastructure across West Ridding. Through careful resource management, strategic expansion, and well-timed investments, players compete to build the strongest industrial network. Seize opportunity, outpace your rivals, and become the greatest industrialist of the age of machines. Players 2 - 5, Play time 90 min, Age 14 + Fantasy Crystals by   ARTSUN.games Have you always wanted glory, wealth and victories? Here is your time! Fantasy Crystals is coming, and with it comes an array of heroes you can lead to triumph in epic clashes! Seize the opportunity to travel to a fantastic land full of riches and irrepressible rivals. Don't hesitate. Stand up to fight! The winner takes all! Players 1 - 4, Play time 30 min, Age 10 +

title: Murder At The Expo
subtitle: Do you like escape rooms? Try our 10-minute murder mystery tabletop game
description_full: Inspired by escape-room puzzles, get a glimpse of how our award-winning games work by solving this 10 minute mystery. There has been a murder at the expo, and it is your job to solve it!

title: Crimson Keep demos
subtitle: Crimson Keep demos
description_full: Come and visit the Crimson Keep stand where we can offer you a demo of the game, or book you in for a more convenient slot during the show. We can offer a 2min overview, a 15min detailed explanation, a 45min sit down example playthrough, or a full game playthrough*. *The full playthrough will be limited to availability as each game takes roughly 2hrs.

title: Learn to Play Winds of Numa Sera
subtitle: An engine-building strategy board game, where you grow your kingdom, customize your heroes, and race to define your legacy.
description_full: Lead your Kingdom to victory over your rivals in this asymetric and highly replayable Kingdom builder and battler. Form your 3 heroes into a line of succession. Then step out into the dangereous continent of Ethera to equip powerful items, learn skills, explore, battle heroes and conquer strongholds in the race to win any 2 of 4 paths to victory.

title: Learn to Play Mythic Baths
subtitle: Welcome to the Mythic Baths. A place for mythical creatures to bathe!
description_full: As our newest employees, it is your job to take  care of our guests; gathering ingredients for their baths, completing treatments, giving nourishment, and cleaning the baths to welcome new and potentially troublesome guests. More complicated treatments will earn you more, but if you complete any treatment exactly, you will be rewarded with valuable tips from our guests!

title: Drillers Demo (CGE)
subtitle: Mine for minerals, upgrade your deck and manage your resources carefully. Every card is multi-use. Every turn is a puzzle. Every descent is a risk .
description_full: In Drillers , players explore an abandoned mine using their mechs, trying to find and excavate anything useful or valuable left behind by a forgotten mining corporation. Each level of the mine brings new opportunities and new challenges as fuel runs low and decisions become tighter. By collecting cards, players unlock new actions and improve the drilling capabilities of their mechs—inspired by iconic real-life vehicles—to push their operations deeper underground. Sell your collected minerals and upgrade your machine once you make it back to the surface, or use drones to automate the logistics. Every decision affects everyone, often creating new opportunities for players. Drillers is a game about planning ahead, tough decision-making, and knowing just how far you can afford to drill. Will you be the first to extend the horizons and uncover what the depths hide? *This game will be taught by a member of our CGE demo team. Players will be split into tables of 3 players each. We will attempt to keep groups together, but we cannot make guarantees.*

title: SETI Demo (CGE)
subtitle: Intelligent life is out there somewhere. Will you be the one to find it? Search among the stars for signs of life.
description_full: In SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence, players lead a scientific institution tasked with searching for traces of life beyond planet Earth and will explore nearby planets and their moons, direct telescopes to gaze into distant star systems to collect data, and upgrade equipment to analyze incoming data more efficiently. SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence pays homage to space exploration, astronomy, and efforts to understand the nature of life in the universe. This game will be taught by a member of our CGE demo team. Players will be split into tables of 4 players each. We will attempt to keep groups together, but we cannot make guarantees.

title: Codenames: Critical Role Adventures Demo(CGE)
subtitle: Enter the world of Exandria, the setting for the hit series Critical Role. Experience Codenames and fantasy adventure like never before!
description_full: Based on our hit word game, Codenames: Critical Role Adventures introduces a challenging spin on Codenames’ original game mechanics. Your GM will lead your party in a fully-cooperative campaign through a series of fantasy encounters, where each adventurer’s abilities will be called on to unlock puzzles and defeat enemies, gaining XP and treasures along the way. This demo will walk you through the first few encounters of the campaign and teach you everything you need to know to continue confidently on your own. You will be assisted by a member of our CGE demo team. Players will be split into tables of 5 players each. 1 player will take on the role of GM. We will attempt to keep groups together, but we cannot make guarantees.

title: Galaxy Trucker Demo (CGE)
subtitle: Snag cargo, fight pirates, try to make a profit, and be the best Galaxy Trucker in this classic board game.
description_full: In Galaxy Trucker, players will race in real-time to build the best ship they can out of spare parts and blast off in pursuit of profitable cargo. Be careful! You want to get to good cargo before anybody else but you will also be dodging meteor swarms and pirates, so make sure your ship can handle them! The player who manages to score the most credits after surviving space is the winner. The theme is lighthearted and humorous and the real-time race to grab ship parts is all in good fun. This demo will run you through your first flight and teach you everything you need to know to continue confidently on your own. You will be assisted by a member of our CGE demo team.

title: Lost Ruins of Arnak Demo (CGE)
subtitle: Explore a lost continent, discover powerful artifacts, ascend the hidden temple, and face fearsome guardians to become the greatest explorer !
description_full: The Lost Ruins of Arnak is a Spiel Des Jahres-nominated (2021) adventure game where players take on the roles of archaeologists searching for legendary artifacts on a mysterious island continent. The gameplay combines elements of deck-building, worker placement, and resource management into an exciting race to score the most points in five rounds of play through careful allocation of actions and resources. This game will be taught by a member of our CGE demo team. Players will be split into tables of 4 players each. We will attempt to keep groups together, but we cannot make guarantees.

title: Dorfromantik Tournament
subtitle: Join our Dorfromantik Tournament on Sunday, 31.05., and compete using a unique custom tournament set! With only 20 spots available, make sure to pre-r
description_full: Get ready for the ultimate Dorfromantik showdown! We’re thrilled to announce a Dorfromantik Tournament like no other—featuring a specially crafted custom tournament set designed exclusively for competition. This is your chance to put your strategy, planning, and creativity to the test in a truly unique format! 🗓 Tournament Day: Sunday, 31.05. 📝 Pre-Registration Opens: Saturday, 30.05. 🎟 Available Spots: Only 16 players! With limited slots available, competition will be tight—so make sure you secure your place as soon as registration opens. Whether you're a seasoned Dorfromantik pro or ready to prove your skills, this is your moment to shine. All tournament rules and details will be provided upon registration. Build. Plan. Compete. Claim your spot and show everyone who can create the most beautiful—and highest-scoring—landscape! Stay tuned for more updates!

title: Wispwood Demo (CGE)
subtitle: Frisky felines chase fantastical lights into the darkened forest. Place tiles of lights to position each light to shine the brightest.
description_full: Welcome to Wispwood, a magical place populated by glowing wisps. In here,  players will place tiles of wisps in their personal grids, their own forest,  that increases in size over the course of three rounds, to get the chosen shape. The player who scores the most points, based on the varying goals set at the beginning of the game, is the winner! This game will be taught by a member of our CGE demo team.

title: Rove: Anchorpoint
subtitle: Rove: Anchorpoint is a compact and affordable campaign game based around a map-based tactical combat system.
description_full: Rove: Anchorpoint is a compact and affordable campaign game built on the challenging and tactical system from the original Rove. It features a 28-encounter cooperative campaign, twelve all-new characters, and deep progression and leveling choices. Designed for both seasoned Rove veterans and newcomers alike, Anchorpoint delivers an epic experience in a small, content-rich package.

title: Stories of legend: Wardens of Wulvengrad demo
subtitle: 4 Wardens. 1 terrifying beast. Only 1 can survive. Forge your destiny now!
description_full: Join us over the weekend and take control of 1 of 4 Wardens with their unique deck of abilities as you face off against the most terrifying monsters to roam the land of Wulvengrad! Come on your own or as part of a group and test your mettle in this cooperative monster hunting boss battler where only 1 can survive. We'll be running demos all weekend and showcasing what makes this game so special: - no dice combat, no random input! Use your unique deck of ability cards to do exactly what you want to do. Be careful though, these also represent your stamina - will you play conservatively, or take the no guts no glory approach? - Card controlled monsters that react to the situation around them! Each unique monster has a 3 tier deck which escalates as it takes damage and it gets angrier. No 2 hunts will ever play out the same! - Token bag health system: you know what's in the bag, but you never know how they will react to being hit! Use your knowledge of what's been drawn and Warden abilities to reduce and mitigate risks, and pray you've stacked the odds in your favour! Join us for an epic hunt that will stay with you as you begin your own story of legend!

title: Pandora Celeste
subtitle: Immerse yourself in one of 2 short scenarios that give you a taste of our love letter to Sci-Fi monster movies.
description_full: Jolted awake from cryosleep by emergency alarms, one truth becomes painfully clear: the Ship itself may be far more dangerous than whatever is stalking its shadowed corridors...   Race to seal the Iso-Ward before the Ship vents all oxygen and kills you all. Or join an anarchic band of Pirates on a mission to steal the secrets of the Pandora from the Company.  Explore the depths of the CSS Pandora Celeste and dodge the monsters lurking in the shadows! Will you survive long enough to fulfil your Agenda and get off the ship?

title: Carta Imperia
subtitle: Try out Carta Imperia: our devious dealmaking game set during the rise of the Roman Republic.
description_full: Use daggers and diplomacy, forging backroom deals in the Senate of ancient Rome.  Bribe, cajole and threaten your way to become First Among Equals in the Roman Republic as it evolves into the Roman Empire.

title: The Rivalry FC Live - Learn to Play in <5mins
subtitle: Step up and take your shot, against the Chairman or against your own rival.
description_full: No booking, no waiting list. First come, first picked. Choose to either drop-in to a quick demo to learn the game, or get ready for a full on Matchday experience, with the ability to build your own squad and go head-to-head against one of our team, or a rival of your own. The Rivalry FC is running LIVE all day.  Outplay your opponent and face the one thing that decides everything - the Goal Roll.  PLEASE NOTE: Capacity is limited to 4 players sitting down at once. Quicker demos can be also be delivered standing up.

title: Panic Stations!
subtitle: Race to find your McGuffin and Abandon Ship in this card game version of Pandora Celeste.
description_full: The Ship's Computer wakes you from Cryo-Sleep.  There’s something Big & Nasty on board! But you’re on this ship for a reason… Race through bug-infested corridors, outwit rivals and hunt down the elusive McGuffin that will unlock the access codes you need to escape before everything goes dark.  If Pandora Celeste is the movie, this is the chase sequence you see in all the trailers.

title: Warmachine Demos (All Day!)
subtitle: Learn to play Warmachine
description_full: Steam. Steel. Spellcasting. Strategy. Welcome to the battlefields of Warmachine, an award-winning tactical miniature wargame set in the war-torn Iron Kingdoms. Take control of warriors, beasts, machines, and the powerful battle-mages who command them all. Head to booth 4-413 and get your first taste of battle in our gripping demo against the invading Orgoth's snarling Gharlghast.

title: Ages of War Gameplay Taster
subtitle: Come see our 3 min gameplay demo
description_full: Drop by and check out our exciting gameplay demo, where we ensure the gameplay and rules will click straight away, and you can whisk yourself away to ancient battlefield and become the ultimate General!

title: Demo Flamecraft Duals
subtitle: Come play Flamecraft Duals! A two player, abstract, travel-friendly game set in the world of Flamecraft.
description_full: Ever wondered what the dragons of Flamecraft do on their lunch break? Play Flamecraft Duals of course! In this 2 player game the artisan dragons have new powers to play with, and this time it’s all about getting your dragons in the right places. Hybrid dragons are also here to play with double the artisanal skills! As you play the board will fill up with dragons, stacking and soaring across the table. You will fire-up abilities, make matches and score shops. Designed by Manny Vega with art from Sandara Tang, Flamecraft Duals is a 2-player abstract pattern matching game that takes 15-20 minutes to play.  Come play a game of Flamecraft Duals by the fountain, at booth #2-593!

title: Play Flamecraft Digital
subtitle: Come play a cozy demo of Flamecraft Digital, the video game!
description_full: In a magical realm a village awakes, and artisan dragons make all manner of crafts and wares! 1-5 players compete to enchant the town with dragons, will you be the Flamekeeper with the most reputation? The hit cozy boardgame Flamecraft is going to be a video game! Monster Couch, the studio behind Wingspan Digital, and Quilts and Cats of Calico, have brought an early version of Flamecraft Digital for you to play. So come cozy up at our booth and see the dragons come to life in pixel-form!  Wishlist Flamecraft Digital on Steam here: store.steampowered.com/app/3201730/Flamecraft/

title: Demo Whisperwood
subtitle: Dig deep into this enchanting bag builder! With the help of ancient golems, woodland animals and elemental magic you will restore life to Whisperwood!
description_full: Whisperwood is a bag-building game for 2-4 players of druids. Players will plan out and perform incantations, restoring air, water and earth, partnering with wildlife, inscribing runes and awakening the Guardian Golems to complete magical tasks. The land is strewn with corruption and the druids must absorb and purify this corruption to heal the forest - but take on too much corruption and your magical abilities will be compromised! Whisperwood is coming to Kickstarter on July 14! Come play a 30 minute demo at our booth, and follow the campaign here!

title: Learn how to play Pinched!
subtitle: Learn how to play Pinched!
description_full: Try to outsmart other burglers in Pinched! - a new set collection game by David Gordon and Jonathan Gilmour-Long for 2 to 5 players. You become “The Mastermind”, planning the perfect heist. In the meantime, the other burglars try to guess where the break-in will be... Who will take the most loot?

title: Learn how to play Tenby
subtitle: Learn how to play Tenby
description_full: Tenby is one of the most beautiful towns in Wales. Wander our colourful streets, walk along our piers with some scrumptious fish and chips, and relax on our stunning beaches with a nice cold ice cream and a warm feeling in your heart. The aim of Tenby is to create the best town you can using the available cards. On your turn, you will draft and place cards to add terraces, piers, and Tenby town’s landmarks into your streets. If you can persuade a hard working local resident to help, you might just pick up some extra points! Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner!

title: Learn how to play For the Gods! ⚡
subtitle: Learn how to play For the Gods!
description_full: As a seafaring builder in ancient Greece, in For the Gods! you'll navigate the archipelago, constructing towering monuments to the gods and vying for control of sacred islands. For the Gods! is a tactical area majority game in which every stone shapes your path to victory. The rules are simple: Sail the seas to establish new temples or elevate existing ones. Along the way, collect God stones and unleash their divine powers at the right moment. With twelve unique God powers, each game offers fresh strategies and dynamic gameplay, ensuring high variability.

title: Learn how to play Yotei 🌸
subtitle: Learn how to play Yotei
description_full: After a successful Kickstarter last month, Yotei is now for the first time available for a demo at UKGE! Yotei is a Machi building game for 2-4 players where you use potatoes as a currency to build the most enchanting Hokkaido town. Buy or bid on fields, forest and mountain plots, and harvest potatoes. Then use your resources to showcase the undeniable charm of the north - serve ramen, host a potato festival, open a ski resort or a serene hot spring! The game offers a perfect blend of tactics and strategy that gives players a satisfying peek into life in Hokkaido.

title: Learn how to play Red North
subtitle: Learn how to play Red North
description_full: Outsmart your enemies in Red North - a new combative game of hidden information and bluffing for 2 to 4 players. Sharpen your axes and send your fiercest heroes and raiders to seize control of the Northern Outposts. Early victories may bring glory, but beware for during Ragnarok, the Gods themselves may tip the scales…

title: Blurrb - demo plus designer
subtitle: Find out more about Blurrb!
description_full: Have a go at playing Blurrb, a new game for 3-6 players based on creative wordplay. The designer Sus C Booth will be on hand to answer questions and sign copies.

title: S*at on a Cat Expansion pack
subtitle: Come check out our new expansion pack - where the cats take the chaos to a whole new level!
description_full: This is the new expansion pack for our game S* at on a Cat the game of flinging s* ats and stealing cats.

title: FACTION - A card game of strategy and control
subtitle: Come along to find out how to play our new card game - FACTION.
description_full: Faction is a fast 20-30 minute intense card game, where everything hangs in the balance to the last card played! We'll be running games throughout the weekend. Venture on which of the 4 Factions vying for power will win and which will lose. Keep your options open as you eliminate characters to effect the balance of power or use their special abilities to your advantage. The Winner at the end of the game has the most control in the winning Faction, minus any stake in the losing Faction.

title: Trench Crusade
subtitle: Trench Crusade is a skirmish miniatures game that pits the forces of humanity against the fiends of hell in the mud-choked trenches of a reimagined WW
description_full: Trench Crusade is a skirmish miniatures game that pits the forces of humanity against the fiends of hell in the mud-choked trenches of a reimagined WW1. During the crusades, an unholy portal was opened by the Templars, unleashing untold horrors upon the earth. Eight centuries later, the Great War still rages on, and now it's your turn to take up arms in the fight for Humanity's soul. Trench Crusade has simple mechanics that make it accessible to players new to wargaming, while offering plenty of strategic depth for veterans. With a brutal, grimdark setting and intensely narrative gameplay, Trench Crusade is designed to tell a story with fast-paced, lethal combat. Even the most basic soldier has the power to turn the tide of battle with blade or bullet. Pick your faction of Faithful or Fallen, and step into the trenches…

title: Carcass Front
subtitle: Carcass Front is a starter set and supplement box for Trench Crusade.
description_full: Carcass Front is a starter set and supplement box for Trench Crusade. It contains a wealth of exciting new content, the core of which is its Campaign book. The book features two exciting campaigns to play through, revamped rules for two fan favourite warbands, as well as lots of spectacular new lore and art. The Carcass Front box also contains gaming accessories, terrain, and two brand new plastic warband sets: the Heretic Naval Raiders and the Procession of the Sacred Affliction .

title: Threaded demos
subtitle: Play demos of Threaded: A Game of Needles and Points, our new crafty worker-placement game!
description_full: We'll be running 3 tables of demos for Threaded all day, every day of the show, each for up to 4 players. We'll have new sign-up sheets on our stand every morning for the slots that day, that can be filled out on a first come first served basis. Threaded is also available to buy on our stand – along with our cat pin for the game as part of the show's official pin collective!

title: Flip Pick Towers demos
subtitle: Play demos of our charming fairytale flip and draw game, Flip Pick Towers!
description_full: We'll be running 1 demo table for Flip Pick Towers all day, every day of the show. We'll have new sign-up sheets on our stand every morning for the slots that day, that can be filled out on a first come first served basis. Flip Pick Towers is also available to buy on our stand – and we'll have copies of the game's promo cards!

title: Rattlesnake demos
subtitle: Play demos of our chaotic card-based Wild West duel, Rattlesnake!
description_full: We'll be running 2 demo games of Rattlesnake all day, every day of the show, each for 2 players. We'll have new sign-up sheets on our stand every morning for the slots that day, that can be filled out on a first come first served basis. Rattlesnake is also available to buy on our stand just ahead of the official release in early June.

title: Idols of the Neon Dark (5e+)
subtitle: Play Idols of the Neon dark with our lead writer, Bee Aitkin
description_full: We have three tables per day of the conference, each one able to host 5 players at a time.

title: Hitster Demo
subtitle: Play The Ultimate Music Party Game!
description_full: Play Hitster, The Ultimate Music Party Game. SCAN the QR code, GUESS the release year of the song & BUILD your music timeline!

title: Match My Beat Demo
subtitle: Play Match My Beat, where iconic songs meet ironic situations
description_full: Play Match My Beat, the game where iconic songs meet ironic situations. PLAY a song, PICK a card, best match WINS!

title: Eco-friendly materials / Snug-fit puzzle demo
subtitle: Discover our 100% plastic-free packaging and high-precision 'Snug-Fit' puzzle technology. See our material library and manufacturing samples in person
stand_name: Ningbo Scribble Tree Stationary Co Ltd
stand_label: Ningbo Scribble Tree Stationary Co Ltd (4-855)
description_full: Precision Tech: Experience our high-density core board and Snug-Fit tech. Sustainability: 100% recyclable, plastic-free solutions (FSC certified). Global Standards: Products meet EN71, ASTM F963, and UKCA standards. Partnerships: OEM/ODM manufacturer for leading global brands.

title: Maladum Demo: Dungeons of Enveron
subtitle: Try Maladum: Dungeons of Enveron Starter Set in a guided demo. Explore a dungeon and learn as you play.
description_full: Step into the world of Maladum: Dungeons of Enveron Starter Set and try it for yourself at our stand. Join a live demo where you’ll take control of a band of adventurers, explore a dungeon packed with danger and see how the game blends tactical combat with a rich, story-driven campaign. We’ll guide you through the rules as you play, so you can jump straight in, no adventuring experience needed. Drop by, grab a character, and see if your party survives the depths of Enveron.

title: Core Space Demo: Evolution
subtitle: Core Space: Evolution
description_full: Be among the first to jump into the action of Core Space: Evolution. Join us on our stand and take control of a crew of traders and try to stay one step ahead of the deadly Rogue Purge.  Swing by, pick your crew and see if you can make it back to the ship, with your loot, intact.

title: Piles! Demos
subtitle: Learn to Play Piles
description_full: Piles is a fast paced free for all card game for 2 - 8 players in which you frantically match and sort cards. Only the quickest will be crowned champion. The game takes about 2 minutes to learn and is ideal for ages 8 and up.

title: Burst Demos
subtitle: Learn to Play Burst
description_full: Burst is press your luck card game for 3-6 players, ages 10+. Play cards to grow the center row, and use power-ups and strategy to save yourself while you force your opponents to BURST!

title: Beat the Game Designers!
subtitle: Play the Designers of Lost Boy Games to Win Games!
description_full: Challenge the Designers of Lost Boy Games like Piles, Burst, Plunder, Super Speed and Robo Rumble. If you win you get a free Lost Boy Game!

title: Puru Puru Paradice: Learn to play in 5 mins
subtitle: Puru Puru Paradice: Learn to play in 5 mins
description_full: Learn to play Puru Puru Paradice . Puru Puru and friends are all striving to live a puru-fect life full of Love and Excitement so they can enter PARADICE. But beware, bouncy jellies don’t last long on the table! The game is played in turns starting from the starting player clockwise. Each player’s turn consists of rolling the dice and resolving the result of the dice. The game ends immediately when either one player obtains 20 Love or Excitement, or one player drips to 0! Ages 7+

title: Overparked: Learn to play in 5 mins
subtitle: Overparked: Learn to play in 5 mins
description_full: In Overparked , it's the day of the big concert and vehicles are coming in from all directions! Learn how to handle the rush of traffic by cleverly parking all incoming vehicles to maximize your points? Players take turns to rotate the steering wheel, determining the vehicles that will come to each player's lot. Then, all players decide which vehicles to place. The game ends when one player has no space left and all players will score for their connected vehicles, surrounded trucks and objectives to see who is the master parker! Ages 10+

title: Altay: Seafarers - Demo
subtitle: Come to Ares Games stand and play Altay - Dawn of Civilization with the Seafarers expansion.
description_full: Come to Ares Games stand and play the deck-building civilization game Altay - Dawn of Civilization with the Seafarers  expansion. Altay  is set in a mythic age at the dawn of time: in a secluded region nestled deep within a vast continent, four mysterious societies have cultivated distinct cultures over countless years, maintaining a fragile balance. The Seafarers  expansion opens the gates to the seas and the mysteries of the ancient Waterfolk. Seafarers expansion introduces three major additions to Altay . First, a brand-new game board, the Forgotten Sea, where players can establish harbors and expand their civilizations through maritime routes. Second, new rules for shipbuilding, sailing, and naval combat, supported by fresh action cards and technologies such as Shipwrights, Explorers, and Astronomy. Ships allow players to cross sea zones, settle distant lands, and engage in battles across the waves, with unique advantages and tactical depth. And third, the new faction, Waterfolk. Long forgotten by history, these enigmatic people could command the waves with their songs and bend the ocean to their will.

title: STEERY Demo
subtitle: STEERY: Steer the story is the party game of stories that will never be told again.
description_full: STEERY: Steer the story is the party game of stories that will never be told again. Drop ludicrous plot twists, spark seemingly impossible conflicts, and hijack the narrative with your cards to score points. No tale is too weird, and no ending too unhinged. In STEERY , you score points by steering the story of one or more characters, using the story cards that you have in hand. To amplify the element of surprise, the game also includes special cards hidden in the main deck to prompt you to introduce new characters into the story or to straight out end it when you least expect it. Learn it in 5 minutes. Bond with your people over unpredictable stories. Unleash your creativity and wit.

title: Questiny : The board game
subtitle: Come and get a taste of the Questiny gameplay with a short play scenario.
description_full: Greetings adventurers, step forth into the realm of Labyrinthia and see if you can conquer your Questiny… This year we will be running shorter (30 minute) demos as an introduction and taster of the gameplay. We will be running a booking system with the available time slots, so please come to stand 2-383 early to secure a slot. These sessions are suitable for 2-3 players, ages 10+ (under 16s will need to be accompanied by an adult). In addition to the demos we will be selling art prints by our artists, giving away some special treats and hosting some competitions with prizes too!  We look forward to seeing you soon, Leon Simmonds (creator)  You can take a closer look at the game on our website, along with tutorial videos, ratings and reviews here: https://www.questinyboardgame.com/  and on Kickstarter at https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/questinyboardgame/questiny-the-board-game “Hugely thematic, massively replayable and  excellently modular, with edge of the seat excitement throughout!". @Plaguemantle “Hands down the highlight of my UKGE! I loved how the system balances meaningful choices with fast turns, this game oozes care and passion". @realpikko  “Questiny successfully…

title: Viking Route - a cooperative adventure game
subtitle: Sail a Longship through legendary worlds in Viking Route, a boardgame with a compass, magnets, and lots of action!
description_full: Come to Ares' stand and play Viking Route , a cooperative game with an ingenious compass-and-magnets movement mechanic.  Players sail a magical Drakkar to the World’s Edge, guided by Odin’s ravens and the winds of Fate, facing powerful Norse creatures, fulfilling challenging quests, and preparing for the decisive battle to avert Ragnarök.  Viking Route is played on a beautiful 3D Viking ship and a scenario board, where the Drakkar is represented by a compass. Multiple magnets (the Ravens and Wind) are manipulated by the players to steer the course of their ship.

title: TEDOKU - a clever roll, flip and write game
subtitle: Roll the die, flip a card and draw a shape with TEDOKU.
description_full: Come to Ares' stand and play TEDOKU , a clever Roll, Flip, and Write game for any number of players, combining the logical satisfaction of Sudoku with the spatial challenges of polyomino puzzles. It can be played solo or as a group, as players only need a pencil and their own sheet. All players use the same inputs, placing shapes so that at least a part of them touch a specific area. After 20 turns, they score points for all completed rows, columns, and sectors. The highest score wins, with ties broken by the fewest empty squares.  With simultaneous turns, easy setup, and solo or group play, TEDOKU is a fast and rewarding game of logic, geometry, and careful planning that’s different every time you play.

title: Perfect Mismatch - Demo
subtitle: Guess words on a card through almost nonsense attributes given on the tablet!
description_full: Come to Ares' stand and play Perfect Mismatch, a fun party game where 2 to 8 players are challenged to guess words from a card, using unusual associations of attributes as hints. Is there anything that is equally square and non-stop? Or extremely herbal, but not verbal at all?  Get ready for plenty of laughs while discussing hilarious attribute combinations and the associations they trigger in this game of creativity, deduction, and teamwork.

title: WunderWaffen - Demo
subtitle: Try WunderWaffen, an asymmetric strategy game set during the final months of World War II.
description_full: Come to Ares' stand and play WunderWaffen , a multi-player strategic game portraying the last year of World War II, when the Normandy landings paved the way to the occupation of Berlin and the resulting defeat of the German army. Through simple rules the game recreates the troubled collaboration between the Russian, British, and American Allies in the final phase of the war, and Germany’s desperate attempt to resist until the very end, developing new and lethal weapons. The game is easy to learn, but presents a deep strategic experience, where every choice matters.

title: Preview of Moby Dick: Wrath of the Seas
subtitle: Preview of Moby Dick: Wrath of the Seas! 1-6 players, 60min asymmetric board game
description_full: Join us a preview of our upcoming game, Moby Dick: Wrath of the Seas! You can book a demo slot here , or just show up at our stand to have a quick look! About the game Prototype game box Harness the power of the ocean as Moby Dick, or ride currents and hunt whales as the relentless whaleboat crew, in this asymmetric board game for 1 to 6 players. As  Moby Dick , you control the mighty white whale and other whales appearing in the ocean. Your goal: destroy the Pequod, sailors' main boat. As the crew , you impersonate one of the whaleboat chiefs (boatsteerer): Captain Ahab, Starbuck, Stubb and Flask. Each of them has their personal style, which is reflected in different character boards. All of them, are on a mission to hunt to hunt whales and Moby Dick! Crew play cards to move through dangerous waters and ride currents, all while trying to have their obsession under control, keeping their boat steady and escaping the white whale’s attacks. Will you harness the power of the ocean as Moby Dick, or brave the waves as the relentless whaleboat crew? The hunt is on!

title: Peranakan: Tiles and Tactics All-Day Demo!
subtitle: Come by and try the UK Games Expo Judges' Choice for Best Abstract Game!
description_full: Come by and try the UK Games Expo Judges' Choice for Best Abstract Game!

title: Play Test of Stone Circles
subtitle: It’s the Neolithic – let’s get building
description_full: In the Neolithic period a major change in human society occurred. Hunter-gatherers who had previously had to spend most of their time just simply surviving, settled into farmsteads. Now they could grow food and once the food was planted or once the pigs were eating, you could leave them alone, and you could spend time on other activities.  So, the Neolithic period is when we're start to see the building of stone monuments, from humble standing stones all the way up to megaliths, the wonders of the day.  In this game starting with just two Stone Age farmers on a simple homestead you will multiply and expand out into the landscape, explore it, find resources and eventually build monuments.  Monuments generate Spirit Points which will vary dependant on how well you can plan your constructions. In the end, the player with the most spirit points generated by monuments will win the game.

title: World Order Paul Grogan - Gaming Rules!
subtitle: Join us at our booth for a demo of World Order, taught by Paul Grogan from Gaming Rules!
description_full: Want to learn how to play World Order? Come visit us at our booth and join one of our scheduled demos led by the renowned Paul Grogan from Gaming Rules! Paul will guide you through the mechanics and get you ready to compete on the world stage. Spots are limited, so swing by early to book your slot!

title: World Order
subtitle: Come visit our booth and book a demo of World Order. Experience the game firsthand and let us walk you through the world stage!
description_full: Want to see World Order in action? Come visit us at our booth and book one of our scheduled demos! Whether you're a seasoned strategist or completely new to the game, our team will guide you through the mechanics and get you ready to compete on the world stage. It's the perfect opportunity to experience the depth and excitement of World Order. Spots are limited, so swing by early to secure your slot!

title: Play-to-Learn Demos & Playtests
subtitle: Come and explore our educational games
description_full: Do you know what a trophic pyramid is? How about a terribly unethical business decision? Do you want your career to have less meetings and more play? Or do you hate it if a game is ‘educational’? Come and explore our educational games or play-test our prototypes to contribute your views or learn more about how you could use games to support your learning (or that of others).

title: Quartermaster General: West Front - preview
subtitle: Come to Ares Games stand to play the upcoming strategy game Quartermaster General - West Front.
description_full: Come to Ares' stand and play a demo/preview of Quartermaster General: West Front, the third entry in Quartermaster General ’s two-player line, which is due to release in the second half of the year. West Front is played over 23 seasonal game rounds, from Fall 1939 through Spring 1945, with one player controlling the Allies’ forces - United Kingdom, United States, and France – and the other playing the Axis - Germany, Italy, and other associated countries (the “Pact,” so called after the Tripartite Pact). West Front  also includes components and rules to create massive, combined games with  Quartermaster General: East Front and  South Front .

title: War of the Ring Card Game - Hope and Despair
subtitle: Come to Ares' stand and play a demo of the upcoming new expansion for War of the Ring: The Card Game.
description_full: Come to Ares' stand and play a preview of Hope and Despair , the 3rd expansion for War of the Ring: The Card Game , due to release later this year. Hope and Despair  adds a new type of card, the Story card. Inspired by key events and turning points of The Lord of the Rings , Story cards represent natural and supernatural influences on the events of Middle-earth and provide a powerful way to modify your playing decks. It will be in demo at Ares’ stand at the show.

title: Paint & Take with Tesseract Miniatures
subtitle: A free paint and take giving you the chance to try out some new hobby gear under the watchful eye of Stu from Tesseract Miniature Studios
description_full: Take some time (and some weight of your feet) to try out a range of hobby supplies by painting your own miniature. You'll get chance to try out: Brushes  - Tesseract Miniature Studios Painting Handles - Four Score Gaming Paints - Ionic Smart Hobbies  And maybe a few more bits. This is a completely free activity, and of course you get to take your model home with you!

title: BattleTech and Alpha Strike Demos
subtitle: BattleTech and Alpha Strike Demos
description_full: Ever wanted to learn to play BattleTech or BattleTech: Alpha Strike? Members of the UK BattleTech community will be running demos of both systems all weekend on their stand … and maybe some other surprises too! Please note whilst UK BattleTech events are suitable in content for  younger players, children must be accompanied by a guardian whilst playing. Sponsored by Catalyst Game Labs

title: Spell Poker demo
subtitle: Spell Poker Demo
description_full: Play one round of Spell Poker with a deck of your choice!

title: Circadia Card Game Demo
subtitle: From the designer of Love Letter (Hisashi Hayashi) and the publisher of Compile comes your latest card game obsession!
description_full: From the designer of Love Letter (Hisashi Hayashi) and the publisher of Compile comes your latest card game obsession! Long ago, the world of Circadia pulsed in perfect rhythm, each habitat watched over by its guardian spirit. But when Day lingered too long and Night grew restless, the strength of the guardians began to wane. You are a Guide of the Dreaming Paths, tasked with leading the Winged Bear, the Rooted Axolotl, and the Cloud Goose back to their domains. By weaving the powers of Spirit Creatures into harmonious gatherings, you will restore their connection to the Habitats. But only the Guide who brings the most balance back to Circadia will be remembered as the Keeper of the Eternal Cycle. In this captivating card game, you and your fellow Guides compete as you restore balance to Circadia. On your turn, play Spirit Creature cards to create powerful sets. The stronger the set, the more valuable the Habitat you can claim. Each Habitat card brings you closer to victory by awarding Balance points. Carefully manage your hand and plan your sets to create a harmonious sequence of Day and Night cards. When one Guide reaches 15 Balance points, it is time for one final round. And…

title: Compile Main 2 Demo
subtitle: Competing AIs stack themed ideas to compile three protocols quickly.
description_full: In the card game  Compile , you are competing Artificial Intelligences trying to understand the world around you. Two players select three Protocols each to test. Concepts ranging from Darkness to Water are pitted against each other to reach ultimate understanding. Play cards into your Protocols' command lines to breach the threshold and defeat your opponent to Compile. First to Compile all three Protocols grasps those concepts to win the game. Control your opponent's Protocols with card actions, Compile your own as fast as possible, and Compile your reality.

title: Shallow Sea Demo
subtitle: A multi-layer puzzle board game featuring marine animals of the Great Barrier Reef
description_full: In Shallow Sea , a multi-layered puzzle board game inspired by the breathtaking beauty of the Great Barrier Reef, players create their own vivid ocean landscapes by strategically arranging an array of marine life, colorful fish, and corals. Unlike typical puzzle games in which pieces merely stack up, the elements in Shallow Sea can activate, deactivate, and even move, creating exciting combos and thought-provoking dilemmas that keep you on your toes. On your turn, choose tiles showing fish, coral, or sea life, and place them on an empty space on your board. When fish surround a coral of the same color, you flip over the completed coral, which becomes a home for fish. Choose which fish will inhabit the coral, keeping the puzzle and ecosystem cards in mind. Use seashells to lure fish and move them, ideally completing multiple coral at once if you build them strategically. Invite other creatures to enrich your ocean, trying to match the distinct scoring requirements of the ecosystem cards in order to score the most points.

title: Nature Demo
subtitle: Grow your population while evolving in a constantly changing ecosystem.
description_full: Nature is a redesign of the blockbuster Evolution to be more streamlined, more forgiving, strategically deeper, and seamlessly expandable. The secret sauce is a modular system that allows players to create a unique ecosystem each time they play. Every combination creates a unique environment to discover. Nature is a card-driven tableau-builder played over 4 rounds.  Adapt to the Changing Environment: The goal of Nature is to grow thriving populations in an ecosystem where food is scarce and predators lurk. Evolve traits like Tusked for foraging, Fast for escaping danger, or Clawed for hunting. Create a Unique Ecosystem Each Time You Play: The core game of Nature is an accessible gateway into a world of dynamic ecosystems. Each game can be tailored to the tastes of the people at the table. Add Nature: Flight for people who prefer to avoid conflict, Nature: Jurassic for a more aggressive game, or Nature: Arctic Tundra for a survival game on the edge of the livable world. There are 5 modules and 2 mini-modules that can be combined to create 96 different ecosystems. After the Summer 2026 releases there will be over 700 combinations to explore! For UKGE only; those who demo or buy a…

title: Animal Rescue Team
subtitle: Join a team of specialists performing daring animal rescues!
description_full: Calling all animal rescuers! When disaster strikes, animals will need your help to escape floods, fires, and earthquakes. Do you have what it takes to succeed in Animal Rescue Team ? Test your skills against the worst disasters that nature has to offer. Can you free a cat trapped in a collapsed building, rescue a goat from a rushing river, or save a pair of dogs caught behind a fire line? In this fully cooperative game, you'll work with a team of expert specialists to safely evacuate animals to shelters, before time runs out and a second team must arrive to save the day! Animal Rescue Team is designed by Matt Leacock (Pandemic, Daybreak) and is the first title in the "Shut Up & Sit Down Presents" game line.

title: The Brain
subtitle: One brain. No words.
description_full: In this abstract heist, players work together without speaking, playing cards to trigger actions that manipulate the display of evidence or give more opportunities for others to do so. With just 36 cards ad one shared brain, players require logic, deduction, counting and a little luck to play them all and escape clean. The Brain consists of one or more attempts to solve a puzzle, with 1-4 players continuing to try until they give up or succeed. You are not allowed to communicate with each other during play. Will you manage to clear all the cards with logic, deduction, counting, and a little bit of luck? Try it on every level until you succeed! On your turn, you must place a card from your hand in the middle of the table, perform the corresponding action, then draw a card from the deck. If all cards in your hand have been played and the draw pile is empty, you win — but as soon as there is a predetermined number of cards on the table at the end of a turn, you all lose. If this happens, you can discuss how to do better next time, then try again!

title: Not Alone Remastered Edition
subtitle: The shipwrecked Hunted try to escape Artemia while eluding pursuit by the Creature.
description_full: The asymmetric hunt game returns for its 10th anniversary. This edition offers an enhanced experience by combining the base game and its two expansions, Sanctuary and Exploration, in a single box. This version centralizes the content developed over the decade and features a visual overhaul and improved components for a streamlined and complete gameplay experience. Not Alone is an asymmetric card game blending bluffing, deduction, and hand management. One player takes on the role of the Creature, an indigenous entity attempting to assimilate space survivors on the planet Artemia. The other players, the Hunted, must cooperate and use the powers of various locations on the planet to survive until rescue arrives.

title: Soothsayers Demo
subtitle: Capture the Tarot in this mystical engine-building game!
description_full: You are a powerful mystic in a tense race against rivals to control the fate of the universe. Capture the Empress, the Moon, even Death itself, and harness the arcane powers of the tarot to bend destiny to your will. On your turn, choose an action: earn coins, draft cards, ascend to higher levels, or capture a tarot card. Rival soothsayers may choose to follow your action, but if you have a higher level, they must pay you for the privilege. Each tarot card you capture grants you a new game-changing ability. Combine these with your leveled-up actions to create unstoppable combos. Seize the tokens of Fate before your rivals to win the game!

title: Compile Main 1 Demo
subtitle: Competing AIs stack themed ideas to compile three protocols quickly.
description_full: In the card game Compile , you are competing Artificial Intelligences trying to understand the world around you. Two players select three Protocols each to test. Concepts ranging from Darkness to Water are pitted against each other to reach ultimate understanding. Play cards into your Protocols' command lines to breach the threshold and defeat your opponent to Compile. First to Compile all three Protocols grasps those concepts to win the game. Control your opponent's Protocols with card actions, Compile your own as fast as possible, and Compile your reality.

title: Escape the Dark Forest
subtitle: A simple, fantasy adventure game with a focus on atmosphere and player cooperation – perfect for newcomers.
description_full: Players take the roles of brave woodland creatures , recently escaped from the Dark Castle, who now find themselves faced with the challenge of escaping the Dark Forest . You must work together using custom dice and item cards to overcome the Forest’s many challenges, each of which is represented by a large, beautifully illustrated chapter card. Like its predecessor, Escape the Dark Forest is a simple, fantasy adventure game with a focus on atmosphere and player cooperation – perfect for newcomers to tabletop gaming. It takes 2 minutes to set up, lasts around 30 minutes, and no two games are ever the same. Escape the Dark Forest takes you on a brand-new adventure, deep into the twisted landscape beyond the Dark Castle. It runs on the same game engine as Escape the Dark Castle (2nd Edition) but adds new Fear and Darkness mechanics which are unique to Forest.

title: Escape the Dark Castle (2nd Edition)
subtitle: Escape the Dark Castle is a simple, fantasy adventure game with a focus on atmosphere and player cooperation – perfect for newcomers!
description_full: Escape the Dark Castle is a simple, fantasy adventure game with a focus on atmosphere and player cooperation – perfect for newcomers to tabletop gaming. It takes 2 minutes to set up, lasts around 30 minutes, and no two games are ever the same. Players take the roles of prisoners and must work together using custom dice and item cards to overcome the Castle's many horrors, traps and challenges - each of which is represented by a large, beautifully illustrated chapter card. What's new in Second Edition?  More Variety – the core set now features mechanics formally restricted to expansions, plus more chapters, more items, and more bosses than 1st Edition. Better Balance – A three-act system similar to Escape the Dark Sector reduces swings in difficulty, while a re-worked combat setup system brings improved player-scaling. Ranged Combat – wield fantasy classics like the Crossbow and Magic Staff, alongside melee weapons, all in one smooth round of simple, satisfying combat. Durability System – similar to The Last of Us: Escape the Dark, items of equipment and armour steadily degrade as you use them, adding new tactical choices. Stamina System – Stamina is a new, luck-mitigating resource…

title: The Last of Us: Escape the Dark
subtitle: The officially licensed board game of The Last of Us!
description_full: The Last of Us: Escape the Dark  is an atmospheric co-operative survival board game set in the world of the critically acclaimed Naughty Dog video game franchise. Powered by the latest evolution of the  Escape the Dark  system,  The Last of Us: Escape the Dark  offers  solo  and  co-op  multi-player modes, allowing  up to 5 players  to experience this iconic setting in a brand-new way. Playing as a group of survivors, you will weave your own unique story of survival and companionship as you explore a open world map. Beginning your journey in a forsaken quarantine zone, your goal is to travel to the reputed safe haven of Jackson while keeping everyone in the group alive . Carefully plot your route through the troubled landscape, resolving immersive Chapter cards at each location to gain vital intel, weapons, and equipment. Survival will depend on making difficult choices , and on tactical use of Item cards and custom dice to overcome a variety of threats including  Hunters ,  FEDRA  agents, and the dreaded  Infected . ENDURE AND SURVIVE!

title: 8 Dragons - Demo
subtitle: Learn how to play 8 Dragons
description_full: Dragon Swarm placement meets lair building. Minimal downtime. Maximum Dragon time. In 8 Dragons you play a mighty Dragon soaring across two kingdoms. But you don't fly alone. Your Wyrmlings have just hatched and are eager to fly. You form Swarms, with your own Wyrmlings and those of the other Dragons. On your turn, you visit wondrous locations and activate effects for yourself and every Wyrmling in your Swarm. When your Wyrmlings fly with others, you benefit from their turns too. Along the way, friendly villagers help you expand your Lair, chamber by chamber. Collect artifacts, fulfill Missions, and hoard as much Gold as you can. And as befits true dragons: whoever hoards the most Gold wins.

title: Kelp: Offshore Offspring Expansion - Demo
subtitle: Learn how to play the new expansion for Kelp
description_full: Raise offspring, unlock new abilities, hunt and hide in new ways. Survival is no longer enough — only your legacy will decide who endures. There is new life in the kelp forest, and the fight for survival deepens. Offspring change everything: juveniles arrive, grow, and demand new tactics from both sides. Offshore Offspring introduces brand-new components and strategies for both the Shark and the Octopus. As the Octopus, you must protect your young while mastering a completely new magnetic modular block system with swappable tiles. Unlock different camouflage colors, each with unique abilities. Set traps that wound pursuing Sharks, and evolve juveniles into adults, creating fresh layers of deception and survival. Food gets a new layer: eat to grow, then risk everything on a daring new escape route. As the Shark, you command not just the mother but also two new juvenile hunters, giving you the power to hunt as a pack. With new Growth tiles, you unlock the ability to swim over each other, letting you cover more of the kelp forest than ever before. And while some Octopus traps can wound you, successful attacks on Octopuses can help keep your hunger at bay. Each choice forces you to…

title: Crown of Ash - Monuments Expansion
subtitle: Crown of Ash - Monuments Expansion Board game demo
description_full: We'll be allowing players to try out the Crown of Ash Monuments expansion no knowledge of the base game required just head by the stand and join us for a guided game.

title: Fetching Feathers Demo
subtitle: Attract fancy flocks to your seasonal sanctuaries. 2-4 players, Ages 10+, 25mins
stand_name: Unfringed - Home of Fetching Feathers & Zuuli
stand_label: Unfringed - Home of Fetching Feathers & Zuuli (2-628)
description_full: The seasons are changing and these well dressed birds are looking for a new place to call home. Hard-headed Eagle Owls love company in warm weather but need some personal space when it’s cold. Regal Kingfishers and Determined Woodpeckers thrive together when food is plenty, but what happens when it’s scarce? Over three seasons, create sanctuaries as fetching as the birds themselves in this simultaneous drafting and bonus-driven set collection game. Experience a novel take on seasonal change by rotating and upgrading location cards each round/season to reflect changing food availability, whilst carefully balancing a variety of bonuses, from bird buddy benefits to full flock freebies.

title: D.O.T Demo
subtitle: Choose when to make a Difference.Over.Time. 2 Players, Ages 10+, 10mins
stand_name: Unfringed - Home of Fetching Feathers & Zuuli
stand_label: Unfringed - Home of Fetching Feathers & Zuuli (2-628)
description_full: In D.O.T , you secretly play cards into personal and shared pools, manipulating colored dot totals to gain the highest scoring Difference.Over.Time. The twist? The goalpost shifts. Sometimes you're rewarded for being far off the mark, and at other times for getting as close as possible. Master the shifting logic, outwit your opponent, and disrupt their plans at just the right moment to claim victory.

title: Bushiroad Demo Sessions
subtitle: Bushiroad International Demo Sessions
description_full: Join us for demo's across your favourite TCG's! Schedule below;  Friday & Saturday 9am-9.30am - Cardfight!! Vanguard & Shadowverse: Evolve 10am-2:30pm - Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME 3pm-3:30pm - Weiss Schwarz & Shadowverse: Evolve 4pm-4:30pm - Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME 5pm-5:30pm - Cardfight!! Vanguard & Shadowverse: Evolve   Sunday 9am-9.30am - Cardfight!! Vanguard & Shadowverse: Evolve 10am-2:30pm - Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME 3pm-3:30pm - Weiss Schwarz & Shadowverse: Evolve

title: QORK Demos
subtitle: QORK Game Demos
description_full: Think fast, react faster! When the dice total seven or show doubles, you must pull your string before the Cupper slams the cup. Be careful—hesitate too long or pull too soon, and you’ll be hit with points!    ●     Easy to learn!  ●     Endlessly replayable!  ●     Fun for all ages!   React quickly–don’t get caught! When the dice total seven or show doubles, you must pull your string before the Cupper slams the cup. Be careful—hesitate too long or pull too soon, and you’ll be hit with points!

title: Flip 7 with a Vengeance Demos
subtitle: Flip 7 with a Vengeance Game Demos
description_full: Flip 7 is back - With a Vengeance! All of the fun of the original game, plus new player interactions and special take-that cards!  Flip over cards one by one without flipping the same number twice. Sound easy? Think again! This isn't just any deck of cards… In Flip 7: With A Vengeance, there's only one 1 card, two 2's, three 3’s, etc. plus a bunch of special cards that can cut your points in half, steal any card, or force an opponent to draw four cards! Are you the type of player to play it safe and bank points before you bust, or are you going to risk it all and go for the bonus points by flipping over seven in a row? Press your luck meets strategy in this addictive card game where no one is ever really safe. The hard-boiled sequel to the award-winning, instant classic, Flip 7.

title: Play our Games and Meet their Designer
subtitle: Come and play the relaunched multi-award-winning game Norse-themed, Thieves, and our new Victorian occult-themed game, Demons
description_full: Thieves and Demons are two-player games of strategy and chance, inspired by ancient myths and ancient games. They take only a few minutes to learn, but the dilemmas of choosing the best strategic or tactical actions add complexity and excitement. To play a game of Thieves typically takes 30-45 minutes. A full game of Demons is a match of two battles, each of which typically takes 60 minutes. However, the players' skill, their luck with the dice, and their pace of play can result in longer or shorter times.  The styling of each game matches the historical contexts of the stories that inspired them, and they are made to be of premium quality. Most importantly, the mechanics of both games are designed so that, with tenacity, skill, and good fortune, reversals can be achieved throughout, and victories can often be snatched from near defeats.  The designer of both our games is on the stand throughout the show, and he or a member of the team will be happy to show you how to play and explain the best strategies for winning. We have tables where you can sit down to play, or podiums where you can stand.

title: Infinity demos
subtitle: Experience Infinity, the sci-fi tabletop skirmish game with sleek anime aesthetics and tactical depth.
description_full: Infinity is a 28mm metal miniatures game that simulates special operations and skirmishes in a hard-sci-fi, cyberpunk world. Known for its stunning anime-inspired aesthetics and unmatched tactical depth, it features the revolutionary ARO (Automatic Reaction Order) system, meaning you are always engaged—even during your opponent's turn. Whether you want to hack the enemy network, deploy stealth camouflaged snipers, or drop heavy infantry from orbit, our quick intro demos will teach you the core mechanics in minutes.

title: Warcrow demos
subtitle: Try Warcrow, our brand-new fantasy miniatures game.
description_full: Welcome to Warcrow , Corvus Belli’s newest fantasy miniatures game. Set in the rich and mysterious world of Lindwurm, Warcrow combines classic fantasy tropes with unique, refreshing twists. Join our demo and learn how to manage your actions, trigger powerful combos, and outmaneuver your opponent in a fast-paced fantasy clash.

title: REM Racers demos
subtitle: Discover the REM Racers universe with demos of both the chaotic board game and the fast-paced card game.
description_full: Welcome to the world of REM Racers, the family-friendly racing franchise set in the Infinity universe. At our stand, you can experience the fun in two different ways: • The Board Game: Control agile remote drones (REMs), drift around corners, and unleash hilarious cybernetic weapons to wreck your rivals. • The Card Game: A pocket-sized, fast-playing card adaptation where pushing your luck, managing your hand, and messing with other racers is the key to crossing the finish line first. Both games are easy to learn, chaotic, and packed with player interaction. Drop by for a quick demo and find your favorite way to race!

title: Aridnyk - Demo
subtitle: Learn how to play Aridnyk and check out all expansions!
description_full: 1-4 players | 60+ m. | 10+ y.o. Aridnyk is a family board game based on the stories and legends of the Carpathian highlanders of Ukraine, the Hutsuls. In this game, you play as shepherds: you will explore the Carpathians, trade with powerful spirits, fulfill intricate plots, and use magical trinkets. The player with the largest flock at the end of the game will be the winner! Since the dawn of time, the Carpathian land has been known for its magic and wonders. The shepherds who tend their flocks in the vast polonyna meadows are ancestrally familiar with the local spirits, enchanted treasures, and powerful spells; hence, they always profit greatly from their craft. Their paths lead to the land where Drizd is herding his magical sheep, the giant Vovk is roaming around the cliffs, and, chained amongst the cloudy peaks, the four-eyed Aley is sleeping… And when the shepherds return from the polonynas, they shall see whose flock is the biggest, the most cared for, and the victor will be showered with the highest praise and honor. Base game included four game modes: Competitive, Solo, Cooperative, Family game 👉 Look at the: - Official game page - Trailer   - How to Play review & Rulebook…

title: 1984: UNPERSON - Demo
subtitle: Learn how to play 1984: UNPERSON and check out the prototype
description_full: 1-5 players | 30-75 m. | 14+ y.o. Based on George Orwell's cult novel 1984 , this game is about the pressure of totalitarian reign and the cost of resisting it. Where freedom and individuality are considered crimes, and the directives of the party, no matter how absurd they seem, must be fulfilled. In the world shaped by machine, there is no place for personal ambition or independent choice — only collective need and collective responsibility. The player’s decisions will determine not only their character’s path but also their ultimate fate, whatever it may be. The game lasts for five rounds. At the beginning of each round, the Responsible Executor (the first player) reveals a Directive Card, which sets a common goal for all players that round. Then, players take their turns one by one. On their turn, a player must perform three actions: 1. Draw an Event into their personal space (hand). 2. Play a card from their hand into the City (public space). 3. Move your Character into a City Event. Base game included Competitive and Solo game modes + Learn to Play booklet 👉 Look at the: - Official game page - BGG page

title: Escape The Rat Race Demo
subtitle: Demo the fast and furious game Escape The Rat Race, 2-5 players
description_full: Your destiny is in your hands as you compete to Escape The Rat Race. You can either collect a steady salary from a traditional professional career, pleasing your parents and covering your bills - very sensible. Or, you could take a risk as an entrepreneur, facing fluctuating income but hoping for the big payout. Use your earnings to accumulate life experiences from your 20s, 30s, 40s, and 50s, and deploy action cards to sabotage your opponents and advance your goals. The first player to collect three experiences from each decade will successfully retire and Escape The Rat Race!

title: War of the Toads
subtitle: Feign attacks and hope your opponent doesn't counter your hidden tactics!
description_full: Capture samurai-toads as hostages in this yomi-style lane-battler.  Tense Play. Hidden Tactics. Bluffing. Each turn play 1 Toad face-up, 1 face-down. Then reveal and resolve the hidden Toad's ability.

title: Tea Tasting
subtitle: Try some Fantasy Tea
description_full: Come and see, taste, smell and generally sample our range of 18 Character class teas. Be one of the first to taste the Artificer and Warrior teas - NEW at UKGE 2026 We will have four available each day, so come back throughout the show to try something new!

subtitle: Come and try a short game of Halo: Flashpoint
