subtitle: Come and try a short game of Epic Warpath

title: Kings of War: Champions - demo game
subtitle: Come and try a short game of Kings of War: Champions

title: Worms the Board game - demo game
subtitle: Come and try a short game of Worms the Board game

title: "Can't Go" Demo's!
subtitle: Demo's of Can't Go - by UK indie designer Trywin Games
description_full: Fun-filled and hilarious game demo's of “Can't Go: The game of poop, points and pandemonium!”. Available to try and buy!

title: "Bake!" Demo's!
subtitle: "Bake!" demo's with UK indie designer, Trywin Games
description_full: Come and play the tastiest prototype from Trywin Games!

title: Malus Hortus Demos
subtitle: Short 20 minute demos of Malus Hortus
description_full: Come and check out Malus Hortus, the 1-4 player co-operative adventure that takes place in an alluring evil garden.

title: Aster
subtitle: An ancient space strategy game of stellar influence
description_full: 2 or 3 players, 20 minutes, Ages 9+, Abstract Strategy, Area Control, Space, Tactical Movement An ancient game of cosmic skysails and stellar influence, gifted to our ancestors by ancient travellers who sailed the stars on streams of sunlight. Played on a circular seed of life board, Aster is an ancient space strategy game where players take turns building castras (bases), moving ships along circular light streams, planning attacks, and securing places to lay aster petal pieces. Inspired by sacred geometry and ancient cosmic civilizations, Aster blends abstract strategy with beautiful illustrated art and unusual but familiar mechanics. Aster pre-launch page available here (you might see a draft, full pre-launch page will be coming soon!).

title: Kickstarter Preview
subtitle: Take a look at our upcoming games for our latest Kickstarter Campagin
description_full: We are absolutely thrilled to announce that we are bringing beautiful new editions of Mexica, Bridges of Shangri-La, Gheos, and Reel Rivals to Kickstarter this year. Breathing new life into these acclaimed, long-lost board game gems has been an absolute pleasure, and we are so excited to tell you more about what we’ve been working on.   MEXICA Build the legendary city of Tenochtitlan, complete with districts, canals, bridges, and temples. From legendary design duo Michael Kiesling ( Azul ) and Wolfgang Kramer ( El Grande ).   BRIDGES OF SHANGRI-LA Compete for dominance in seven mystical disciplines across the mountain-villages of Shangri-La in this ingenious area control game from Leo Colovini.   GHEOS Play as spiteful gods ruling over an archipelago. Gain followers from the strongest tribes, and reshape the land to hasten their rise and hinder your rivals.   REEL RIVALS Build a marshy landscape and take the best fishing spots in this tight, tense, tile-laying game from Wolfgang Kramer.

title: ISLA
subtitle: Explore a mysterious island in this strategic adventure game of discovery, danger and dice management (30 - 45 mins game play)
description_full: Embark on an epic adventure in ISLA, a strategy board game for 1–5 players, playing 30 - 45 minutes. Navigate unexplored terrain, collect flora, fauna and fossils, and master the game’s unique dice exhaustion mechanic as every decision shapes your survival. Demo the game at our stand all weekend, with an exclusive promo card included with every purchase of ISLA at UK Games Expo.

title: Towers of Ra!
subtitle: A tense co-operative dexterity game where players work together to save the sun from eternal darkness. (15 mins game play)
description_full: In Towers of Ra, players must carefully balance and place pieces together to help Ra defeat the chaos serpent Apophis before the tower collapses. Combining teamwork, precision and mounting tension, this fast-paced co-operative dexterity game challenges 1–8 players to keep the towers standing and restore balance to Ancient Egypt. Game demos up to 15 mins. Visit the Ocean City Games stand throughout the weekend to try the game for yourself, with an exclusive promo card available for everyone who demos Towers of Ra at the show.

title: Terraria: The Board Game Demo's
subtitle: Get a chance to play through a short Demo of Terraria: The Board Game, available to buy at UKGE
description_full: Terraria: The Board Game is a co-operative adventure game for 1-4 players. Whether you’re a novice Terrarian or a long-time fan, you can now experience Re-Logic’s magnum opus on your tabletop, solo or with friends. With simple deckbuilding at its heart and a flexible action point system, choose your own playstyle and create memorable moments as you dig, fight, explore and build in a thrilling sandbox world!   Explore ever-changing biomes, creating a unique world every time you play Dig to mine ores and gems as you spelunk below the surface Fight enemies to collect loot and obtain new cards Complete objective chains and trigger epic boss showdowns Build a base to unlock new crafting opportunities and NPC bonuses Craft powerful new accessories, tools and weapons Upgrade your character with tougher armor sets and useful buffs Be vigilant; time marches on and the world is dangerous. To win, complete your chosen objectives before the threat level gets too high. Terraria: The Board Game feels like Terraria , distilling the fun of the digital gameplay loop while adding the satisfying tactility and in-person excitement of modern tabletop games. So, whether you’ve played the videogame or…

title: Cult of the Lamb: The Board Game Demo's
subtitle: Come by stand 2-522 for a Demo & first look at our next Video Game Adaption - Cult of the Lamb: The Board Game
description_full: In Cult of the Lamb, the BAFTA-nominated video game from Massive Monster and Devolver, players take charge of a cult as the Lamb, a prophet promised to an ominous saviour,  and battle the bishops of the Old Faith on their quest to godhood. In the board game, up to four players assume the roles of prophets - the Lamb, the Goat, the Owl, or the Snake - each competing to build the most devoted cult of woodland worshippers. Cult of the Lamb: The Board Game combines action-packed dungeon-crawling crusades with strategic cult-building worker placement.

title: Space Junkers Hands-On Play
subtitle: Raid a crashed starship and claim the most valuable resources before the other Junkers, traps and aliens can get you!
description_full: Join the crew and experience life in the most dangerous job in the galaxy!  For 2-6 players, raid a crashed starship for all the valuable resources inside.  Dodge traps, race other Junkers, watch out for aliens and try not to trigger the ship defence mechanisms!   Can you grab the most salvage and make it out with your reputation as the galaxy's most fearsome Junker intact, or will you end up crawling away battered and bruised with just the remaining scraps?   Only one way to find out! Games last approx. 30-45 mins, depending on the number of players

title: Wild Aces - Ariel Combat in WW1
subtitle: Try your hand at being a World War 1 Ace Pilot!
description_full: Take to the Skies over the battlefields of WW1, and duel for Glory! Oh, and did we mention you're also animals? Yes, that's Camels flying Sopwiths vs Quokkas in Fokkers. They're Wild, and they're Aces!   Wild Aces is our upcoming card game for 2-4 players, with an expansion taking it up to 8 players!  We'll have both the core and the expansion on show and playable at the stand. From 2 player head to head, to 4-a-side 8-player mega battles, Wild Aces brings World War 1 arial combat to life in this action-selection card game.  Grab your squad mates and try out a sortie - only one team can win, and only one pilot can be crowned the true Ace! A sortie lasts approx. 20-30 mins, allow longer for a full 8-player game

title: Movie Mogul Demo Play
subtitle: Come and demo Movie Mogul - Become the biggest movie studio across 3 eras of cinema
description_full: From the dawn of cinema in the 1900s, through the Golden age and into the age of Blockbusters, grow your studio from humble beginnings into a movie empire in this euro-style game.   Recruit actors, directors and option scripts to make films, build sound stages and sets to grow your abilities and invest in departments including costumes, recording studios and even creature shops to make your films the the real showstoppers.   Time your releases carefully - the dynamic audience preferences are influenced by every studios' film releases.  Release at the right time and ride the wave of popularity, but launch into an oversaturated market and your ticket sales are going down faster than you can shout ‘Cut!’ For 2-4 players, come and experience the magic of the movies!   As this is a euro-game and can be long, demo sessions will be of one of 3 cinematic ages in the game, approx. 30-45 mins.

title: Pactopolis: Grow. Negotiate. Sustain (@4-264)
subtitle: A high-interaction, negotiation-heavy, competitive AND co-op game unlike any other. Make clever deals, sustain the system, and the environment.
description_full: Be one of the first to get a hands-on-preview where you can experience the world of PACTOPOLIS at booth 4-264! Grow. Negotiate. Sustain. (For guaranteed seats - read the last paragraph and click the link there.) Test your negotiation skills to craft good win-win deals. Come and immerse yourself into the city of deals - Pactopolis. There are 3 primary things you do in the game: Grow your sector and prosper. Negotiate your growth and way to victory by crafting smart deals. Sustain the system and the land on which you grow.  Compete to win, but collaborate to be able to be competitive! Edge-of-the-seat tension. Organised chaos where ¾th of the gameplay is pure tabletalk and negotiation. This game will feel realistic, meaningful and hopeful! If you don't win the first time - you would likely have learnt what to prioritise the next time! But so will your opponent! :) With beautiful artwork, realistic scenarios, and real-world information packed into the game - win-or-lose, everyone walks away a winner in this game (in some way) ;) PRACTICAL DETAILS: We will be running ad hoc - walk-in demos on one table and a more planned schedule on another. So, if you absolutely want to experience…

title: Asher's Ridge
subtitle: Drop in and play Asher's Ridge, a roleplaying game of paranormal drama television for 1-4 players.
description_full: Direct – and star in – your own paranormal drama television show set in the remote fictional town of Asher's Ridge. Experience the unexplainable in the breathtaking heart of the Lake District. Gather your cast of characters, scout your filming locations, and make a show that will keep them guessing for years to come.

title: Bridge Taster
subtitle: Come and try a hand of bridge! You will learn the basics in a few minutes. You have a lifetime to enjoy the game!
description_full: We will teach you how to play a simplified version of bridge so that you can get playing immediately with friends and family - or visit a local bridge club.

title: Flee the Horde! live play
subtitle: Come an play a game of Flee the Horde!
description_full: We are offering bookable slots to Play a game of Flee the Horde! See how the game plays and feel free to ask any questions of the designer Craig Norris

title: Mycelia
subtitle: Mycelia & North American Expansion
description_full: Try our strategic board game all about mushrooms!

title: Learn to Play First Blood!
subtitle: We hope to see you in person and have a great time teaching you our game and tactics! Bring a friend and dive in this amazing Skirmish game of Conques
description_full: Attending this Demo at the booth for 15 GBP teaches you the basic Rules of our Skirmish Game First Blood and gets you also an exclusive fishgnome miniature you can't find anywhere else!

title: ArcWorlde Demo
subtitle: ArcWorlde 10-minute demos introduce players to a fast, story-driven skirmish game where heroes, warbands, and monsters clash.
description_full: Join us at the Warp Miniatures stand for a 10-minute ArcWorlde demo , designed to get you playing quickly and confidently. ArcWorlde is a narrative skirmish game set in a whimsical fantasy world, where every scenario tells a story and no two battles play out the same way. In this quick demo, you will learn the core mechanics through play rather than rules-reading. You’ll see how ArcWorlde rewards tactical positioning, imaginative problem-solving, and cinematic moments, whether that’s a daring charge, a clever retreat, or an unexpected monster entering the fray. The demo is beginner-friendly, fast-paced, and perfect for anyone curious about skirmish games, narrative play, or beautifully crafted miniatures. Experienced players will also get a feel for ArcWorlde’s depth, flexibility, and emphasis on memorable tabletop moments. No prior experience needed, just bring your curiosity.

title: NEW* Flora Funga with the Designer
subtitle: Play new nature game duo 'Flora Funga' with it's designer Kedric Winks
description_full: Flora Funga features two nature-inspired games in one elegant box with magnetic wrap-around board. In Flora, dandelions sprout, bloom and scatter as shifting winds reshape the landscape while you race to complete mission cards. In Funga, mushrooms form intricate patterns as you place, connect and disrupt using clever moves and unique powers to score the most points. Two distinct challenges, one striking package - grow, adapt and outplay your rivals. A fun game created by Kedric Winks.

title: Where The Feck Is That? Live Buzzer Showdowns
subtitle: A fast-paced trivia game built around real UK and global place names, with live demos and buzzer face-offs throughout day.
description_full: Where The Feck Is That? – Live Demo & Buzzer Showdowns Loud horns. Fast answers. Questionable place names. Step onto our stand for fast, face-to-face rounds of Where The Feck Is That? — the outrageous and funny card trivia game built around real UK and global place names. • 5–10 minute games • 3–4 players per round • Over 16s Taster Edition available at the stand – £9.99 or 2 for £18. 🔔 Live Showdowns (Ad-Hoc All Day) Demos run continuously from 09:00–18:00 , with headline crowd moments around: 11:00 – Buzzer Mayhem 14:00 – Supreme Overlord Showdown 16:00 – Giant Map Face-Off Times are flexible and driven by crowd energy. If you hear the horn, something’s happening. Top scorers are entered into the end-of-day prize draw. Mailing list sign-ups are automatically entered into our Expo winners draw. This isn’t a quiet demo table. It’s competitive, loud and unapologetically chaotic. Step up. Claim the crown.

title: Which Witch?
subtitle: Come and demo our prototype game Which Witch? - A party game of enchantment and cunning from Nathaniel James coming to a crowdfunder near you soon!
description_full: Solstice is here and your cabal gathers to celebrate. Over the next few nights you and your friends will compete to brew the finest magical potions in the land, calling on the blessings (and curses) of the greatest enchantresses of yore. Do you have the cunning to concoct victory before the Witching Hour chimes? Which Witch? is a simple-to-learn game where your strategy and ability to predict what your opponents are doing will lead to your success! Be the first to brew 5 potions of a single type to win.

title: Netrunner
subtitle: Learn to play netrunner

title: Turrets - Tower Defense Game
subtitle: Come play our Tower-Defense inspired board game!
description_full: Turrets is a fantasy tower defense board game. Players attempt to destroy other's Castles while at the same time defending their own using mythological and real animals and plants drafted from a deck. The last player remaining wins! Game currently only available to play, with a planned release to the general public in 2027.

title: Climate Apocalypse - Live Demo
subtitle: A satirical (and educational) board game about climate change
description_full: Climate Apocalypse is a board game that explores the climate crisis through satire...  you get to play the villain in the climate change narrative. Each player is the CEO of a multi-national fossil fuel company. It is your job to make the most money for your company by building a massive fossil fuel network across the planet in order to extract the earth's precious natural resources before the world tips into climate apocalypse! You can use your money and power to control the media, as well as influence policy, people, and government. Weaponise sustainable energy sources and green initiatives to thwart your enemies.  But beware: as the global carbon footprint rises, you risk damaging your power network as more more climate disasters are unleashed across the globe. You have a corporate duty to supply the world with energy and deliver unimaginable profits to your shareholders. Will you take a balanced approach, or will your greed  risk tipping the world into a Climate Apocalypse?!? 🎮 Game Details • Players: 2 to 5 • Playtime: ~90 minutes • Age: 12+ Join us at the Planet B Games stand (Hall 4-143) and jump straight into a live demo. Our team will guide you through the game, teach you…

title: Cubyria: Architects of a Lost City demo games
subtitle: Come try Cubyria, the beautiful 3D tile-laying game for 2-5 players. Like 3D, competitive Tetris. Coming soon to Kickstarter!
description_full: Come try Cubyria , the decade's most original new board game, coming soon to Kickstarter! Imagine the mental challenge of Tetris combined with the tactile pleasure of Lego, all set to a drumbeat of fierce competition. You play as an Architect, working against your rivals to please the Mad Vizier by building the most spectacular additions to his palace. Collect cards to place Rooms, Roofs and other building components onto a complex, beautiful and ever-growing structure. The rules are easy to learn, but the challenge ramps up every round. Skilful players can cleverly take advantage of the many point multipliers, but beware the Vizier’s Whimsy Cards, which can throw every plan into disarray. Board gamers experience Cubyria as a new dimension of play. Fans of RPGs and miniatures relive the pleasure of laying out a map and handling beautiful components. And Cubyria is a great family game – kids love it. By the end of the game, you've built a gorgeous, unique 3D palace , which you won't want to put away!

title: Orbs Vs Drones
subtitle: Come and try our NEW 2 player strategic board game Orbs vs Drones! Games will be running all day every day.
description_full: Orbs vs Drones is a strategic 2 player board game where a non-human intelligence battles world governments to control the future of a gaslit, sarcastic humanity. This game features; Layers of interacting mechanics. Asymmetrical gameplay extends replayability. Engaging narrative embracing UFO lore, political shenanigans & cultural satire.  Exploits, techniques & strategies to uncover - for both sides!  play.orbsvdrones.com

title: Dungeon Shopkeeper
subtitle: Dungeon Shopkeeper - Wheeling and Dealing in the Darkest Depths!
description_full: Running all day everyday, come and play our hilarious and fun family game. A cunning new board game where you're the trader, not the hero! Outwit adventurers, acquire legendary items, and build your merchant empire.  In this pun-filled twist on dungeon crawling, you'll pit your wits as a crafty trader trying to sell the best—and most magical—gear to needy adventurers.   Watch our for the monsters though, they will affect gameplay and can cut into your profits!

title: The Rocketeers Guide to Rocketships
subtitle: Game demo of Rocketship Warfare and all the models will be on display
description_full: The simple game rules will be explained via a 1-on-1 battle with Rocketships. Also the entire range will be on display. There will also be details on where the Free STL models can be downloaded. Registration at the UKGE to get a show exclusive Dread Rocketship.

title: Sculpting Unique Details
subtitle: An hour session on sculpting custom details for miniatures, including purity seals, armour embellishments, icons, and other unique finishing touches.
description_full: Join Siege Studios for an in-depth, one-hour masterclass focused on adding characterful sculpted details to your miniatures to help make your army truly unique. This session will begin with a brief introduction to the tools, putties, and mixing techniques used for miniature sculpting, along with guidance on preparing putty for detailed work. The team will then demonstrate how to add a variety of finishing details to a miniature, including purity seals, belts, and armour embellishments such as an Aquila on a Space Marine chest plate. Throughout the session, you’ll learn techniques for creating clean, readable details that integrate naturally with existing miniature designs while enhancing their individuality and narrative. If time allows, the class will also cover sculpting custom chapter symbols or similar insignia, showcasing how small additions can dramatically personalise and elevate your models.

title: Miniature Painting with Markers
subtitle: Miniature Painting Workshop with Refillable Markers
description_full: In this workshop, you’ll paint miniatures from various board games and wargames (fantasy, sci-fi, heroes, monsters, and more), learning how to work on both large surfaces and small details using refillable markers. Our expert painters will guide you step by step so you understand how to control your strokes, mix colors, and achieve striking effects—even if it’s your first time. The goal is for you to leave with a well-painted mini and, above all, with the feeling that “I can do this!” Plus, we’ll teach you easy and super fun tricks: clean outlines, quick highlights, simple gradients, textures, and small effects that bring the figure to life without complicating things with difficult techniques. There will be practical tips to save time, avoid common mistakes, and enjoy the process while experimenting with different styles. This workshop is designed for everyone —to learn, try things out, and have fun painting. Find out more about us https://www.greenstuffworld.com/

title: Carnival Tenebris 1-hour demos
subtitle: Your travelling circus are all that is stopping the demon Belphagor from rising. The show must go on!
description_full: The glittering lights of the circus hide a deep shadow. Your performances are the only thing stopping the demon, Belphagor, from rising and devouring the world. But his agents hunt for you everywhere. Can you stay two steps ahead? The show must go on! Simple 2d10-based system. In one hour, you'll dig up clues, solve a mystery and confront occult evil. Two-hour sessions also available on request. Pre-bookings available here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13B4ksaPEX3tREZWqbw-Aox_m0aXqaP21mkegcgUwGns/edit?usp=sharing

description_full: Covert Ninja cats try to outwit the Shogun’s Samurai Guard Dogs in an attempt to devour his precious koi carp. Players either take on the roles of Stealthy Ninjas trying to infiltrate the mansion, or they can choose to be the Loyal Guards protecting the fishy treasure. Nerves of steal and a good poker face are needed to outsmart and outmanoeuvre your opponents. Don’t take your eyes off the board as it all could change in an instant in this cunning game of catch and concealment!

subtitle: Don’t miss this large-scale participation event for the WW1 Wings of Glory airplane miniature game.
description_full: Don’t miss the 5th Battle of Birmingham , a large-scale participation event for the WW1 Wings of Glory , our WW1 airplane miniature game using beautiful pre-painted models! Wings of Glory is a fast-playing and easy to learn game system that uses cards and miniatures to represent airplanes and their manoeuvres, allowing the players to fly with the main airplanes of WW1 and the most famous aces of the aviation, like Manfred von Richthofen, Frank Luke Jr., Max Immelmann, and William Barker. Control one or more airplanes, engage your opponents in aerial duels, or try to accomplish a specific mission, such as recon, escort, or bombing. New players will be welcome to the 5th Battle of Birmingham at our stand, on Sunday at 11:00. Our demo crew will help everyone enter the battle within minutes, and an airplane miniature will be provided to the participants to play with.

title: Painting cloth and leather
subtitle: An hour session on how to paint realistic cloth / capes and leather
description_full: Join Siege Studios for a one-hour session dedicated to painting convincing cloth, capes, and leather on your miniatures. This workshop focuses on capturing the texture, movement, and material differences that bring these elements to life on the tabletop. You’ll witness how to approach fabric with smooth blending and controlled highlights to create natural folds and depth, as well as how to paint leather with rich tones, subtle wear, and realistic finishes. Whether it’s soft, flowing cloth or rugged, battle-worn leather—so each surface reads clearly and adds to the overall story of your model. Perfect for hobbyists looking to refine their skills, this session offers practical guidance and professional insights you can apply immediately, helping you add another layer of realism and character to your miniatures.

title: Doomtown Weird West Edition Greenhorn
subtitle: Experience the latest edition of Doomtown, the rechambered expandable card game!
description_full: Experience the latest edition of Doomtown, the rechambered expandable card game! Players control one of six unique factions: they fight for dominance, sling lead, and cast spells in the Weird West world of Deadlands. Typically played with two players, variants allow more players to get into the game and Weird West Edition offers new co-operative, 2v1 boss battle, solo modes, and a new multiplayer variant for 2026. During the game, each player builds locations in the town and fights for overall control. Doomtown sets itself apart from other card games in that each card doubles as a playing card, which impacts both deck building and gameplay. Players resolve certain in-game situations (such as combat) with a hand of poker, accentuating the Old West atmosphere of the game. The game's movement rules are also noteworthy, often being compared to chess.

The details of the mystery emerge from the players' contributions, inspired by 100s of creative prompts on cards, and building up to a compelling reveal that surprises everyone.  We'll give you a one-hour introduction to the game and you'll tell a complete horror mystery tale in that time. You can choose from seven scenarios, from the journey into a black hole through to horror in medieval Sherwood. Pre-bookings available here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13B4ksaPEX3tREZWqbw-Aox_m0aXqaP21mkegcgUwGns/edit?usp=sharing

Gather resources to research powerful technologies, build fortifications and upgrade units. Control districts through military strength and dominate your opponents. Gain massive power through syndicate support and mission objectives. title: The Secrets of Board Game Manufacturing
subtitle: From concept to table: learn the secrets of board game manufacturing. Tips on quality, cost, and exclusive production videos.
description_full: Ever wondered how a board game goes from concept to your table? Join us to uncover the complete manufacturing story! We’ll reveal each major production step, share pro tips for maximizing quality and managing costs, and show exclusive live-commentary videos of key components being produced. Whether you're a publisher, designer, or simply passionate about games, this talk will equip you with the insights needed to turn your vision into reality. Don't miss out on the secrets behind crafting great games!

title: Tenby Signing Session 𓅰
subtitle: Get your Tenby copy signed by designer Benjie Talbott
description_full: Tenby is one of the most beautiful towns in Wales. Wander our colourful streets, walk along our piers with some scrumptious fish and chips, and relax on our stunning beaches with a nice cold ice cream and a warm feeling in your heart. The aim of Tenby is to create the best town you can using the available cards. On your turn, you will draft and place cards to add terraces, piers, and Tenby town’s landmarks into your streets. If you can persuade a hard working local resident to help, you might just pick up some extra points! Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner!

title: Jade Littlen Q & A

description_full: The award-winning Jade Littlen will answer your questions and demonstrate techniques. Come along and learn from one of the best miniature artists to emerge in recent years.

title: Mech Command RTS - Learn to Play
subtitle: Let us teach you this real-time wargame! Experience simultaneous play, 3D terrain, and LED targeting. Beginners welcome!
description_full: Learn to Play: Mech Command RTS Tutorial Session Sign up here: https://bit.ly/4uS7FlG Want to try something totally new? Sit down and let our team teach you how to play Mech Command RTS ! In this guided, beginner-friendly tutorial, we will walk you through the core mechanics step-by-step so you can experience the frantic energy of a real-time strategy game on the tabletop. We provide all the miniatures and terrain—you just need to bring yourself! What you'll learn and experience: Guided Gameplay: We teach you the intuitive rules and have you playing your first match in minutes. No prior experience required! Real-Time Combat: Learn how to use energy gems to maneuver and shoot simultaneously. No waiting for your turn! LED Targeting: See how our LED-equipped miniatures work: if your mech's light visibly hits an enemy, you have a clean shot. 3D Battlefields: Learn to use multi-level cityscapes to gain the high ground or take cover. Come grab a seat, learn the game, and blow up some mechs!

title: BattleTech: Getting a foot in the hanger door
subtitle: BattleTech: Getting a foot in the Mech-bay door
description_full: BattleTech has been around for over 40 years, and has seen many talented people working on the game line over that time - game designers, writers, artists, editors, layout, fact-checkers, and proofreaders. Many Catalyst employees and freelancers began their careers as fans, and other fans continue to provide valuable services to making the game line what it is.But how did they get their ‘Mechs foot in the hanger door, and how can other fans get involved with the game line?  This event at booth 3-150 will showcase some of the luminaries of the community and provide opportunities to ask questions … and maybe  get your foot in the ‘Mech-bay door Writing: Getting hired as a writer or artist in the game industry is a long-standing challenge as few companies accept unsolicited submissions. Nowadays, however, there is Shrapnel, The BattleTech Magazine that is constantly seeking new talent  and writers will be on hand to talk about their stories CDT: The Catalyst Demo Team (CDT) promotes BatlleTech and other Catalyst games at conventions and events world wide. Members of the team will be on hand to answer questions about how you can join and the challenges and benefits of joining the CDT…

title: Meet Tomáš Holek

description_full: Come to say hi to Tomáš Holek, the designer of Tea Garden and the upcoming game Night in the Zoo ! Stop by for an autograph or just to have a chat.

title: Signing by Authors/Artist
subtitle: Signing and Meet the Designers and Artists of some of the Looping Games 1900 and Jules Verne Series
description_full: We are delighted to have Looping Games Designer and Artist Eloi Pujadas & Àlex M. Sanguino on our stand. Come along and meet them, discuss their games, and get your copies signed!

title: Preview of our Next Game 'Loyalty'
subtitle: Sneak preview and demo of 'Loyalty', the next game from Minor Disaster Games.
description_full: ‘Loyalty’ is a frantic social deduction game set in the wake of the death of your mandatorily beloved leader wherein players have 5 minutes to elect a new leader and execute someone for the murder of the old leader (whether they did it or not is largely irrelevant). Everyone has a hidden agenda connected to the success or failure of another player so the game is figuring out the most beneficial outcome for the largest number of players, or tricking the others into fitting your agenda.

title: Author Signing
subtitle: Comic, Gamebook Author and Game Designer Signing
description_full: Simon Birks will be on stand all day to sign games, gamebooks and comics.

title: Come and Learn About Our New Game
subtitle: Come and Learn About Our New Game
description_full: Join us at the Red Cannon Games stand to learn more about our upcoming new game after its reveal on Friday. This is a great chance to hear more about what we have been working on and chat with us about what’s coming next.

title: Buy Fight For Inheritance
subtitle: Buy Fight For Inheritance
description_full: After funding in under 38 hours at UKGE last year and being fulfilled earlier this year through Kickstarter, Fight For Inheritance is now available to buy in person at the Red Cannon Games stand this weekend. Save on delivery costs and pick up your copy in person. If you are looking for a fun, fast-paced card game full of laughter, light strategy, and playful chaos, come and get yours this weekend.

title: SAVAGE SLA Launch
subtitle: SAVAGE SLA Launch
description_full: Nightfall Games are coming to UK Games Expo with a very limited stock of the new SAVAGE SLA Quickstart. Come meet Dave, Jared, Mark and Benn (the creators) and bag yourself a copy of this exciting new version of SLA Industries. And yes they have sharpies.

title: Dice & Discounts Instant WINS
subtitle: Grab a GMS flyer and visit us in Hall 3, Location 844 for our free Dice & Discounts game. Roll the dice to win discounts, free products, or vouchers
description_full: Visit GMS Tabletop Games in Hall 3, Location 844 and take part in our free Dice & Discounts game. Pick up a flyer from the GMS team at the entrance halls or around the arena, bring it to the stand, and roll the dice for your chance to win instant discounts, free products, or GMS vouchers worth up to £250. There is no age restriction, and visitors may also have the chance to earn extra rolls on the stand. Full details are available from the GMS team.

title: Kate Davies Signing Games
subtitle: Get Your Games Signed by the Artist Kate Davies
description_full: Kate Davies, the artist who brought to life:-  Forest Folk Pete's Plaice Twisted Muse, Hope & Fear  will be available for signing copies of these games during the UK Games Expo.

title: Gaby Spencer Signing Games
subtitle: Get Your Games Signed by the Artist Gaby Spencer
description_full: Gaby Spencer, the artist who has brought to life Kindred Spirits , will be available for signing copies of these games during the UK Games Expo.

title: Designers Kirsty Buley&Phil Fox Signing Games
subtitle: Get Your Games Signed by the Designers themselves
description_full: Kirsty Buley and Phil Fox, the designers who created:-  Overgrowth Forest Folk Pete's Plaice Disappearing Act Twisted Muse, Hope & Fear  Ducks in a Row Reflections Kindred Spirits will be available for signing copies of these games during the UK Games Expo.

title: Papyria Mini Expansion "Papyria Assur"
subtitle: Papyria Assur Mini Expansion
description_full: The “Papyria Assur” Mini Expansion will be available as a free giveaway for all customers that are purchasing Papyria at the fair.

title: Kryptothera – Meet the Team & Signed Copies
subtitle: Step Into the Hunt. Capture Cryptids Before Your Rivals Do.
description_full: Meet the Minds Behind the World Every world begins with a vision. At this special event, meet the Team behind Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit and take home a signed copy of the game. What to Expect   ✍️ Get your copy of Kryptothera signed by the Team 🎨 Discover the artistic vision and inspirations behind the world 💬 Chat about the design, style, and creation of the game 📸 A perfect moment for collectors and fans Each signature is a mark of the world you are about to enter. How It Works   🚶 Drop-in event 📍 Taking place at the NoctiLux Games stand (3A-644) 🎟️ Available for anyone who owns or purchases a copy Limited time. Limited opportunity. A Collector’s Mark A signed copy is more than a game. It is a piece of the world, carried with you.

title: It's Not Cricket Tournament
subtitle: UKGE 2026 inaurgural tournament for It's Not Cricket - pit yourself against others and top our leader board and win prizes!!.
description_full: Sign Up, Play, and Win at the UKGE 2026! Think you have what it takes to top the charts?  Join us at our stand at any time during the UK Games Expo 2026 for the official "It’s Not Cricket" Tournament! We’re looking for ultimate competitors to TOP our live digital leaderboard. Just stop by, register with one of our crew, and jump straight into the action.   Help will be on hand !! The competition is fierce, fair and only five minutes long, and the rewards are worth it. If someone knocks you off the top spot, don't worry—you can return as many times as you like to improve your score and reclaim your place! The Rewards • Daily Champion: £50 of official merchandise for the highest score each day. • Weekend Grand Prize: A massive £250 prize bundle, including your very own copy of the game, for the overall tournament winner! Tournament Features • Easy Registration: Quick sign-up via our dedicated crew and their iPad • Live Rankings: Watch your name climb the digital display at our stand. • Global Access: Our leaderboard is synced to our website in real-time, so you can track your position from anywhere. • Unlimited Re-entry: Keep coming back to beat your personal best and defend your…

title: Roll For Potion
subtitle: Roll For Potion - Roll the dice, and watch your fantasy colour-changing potion be made!
description_full: Roll For Potion is a stand where you can roll for each individual ingredient of a decorative colour-changing potion. These are purely for display / fidgeting, and not for consumption.  You can roll for the base colour, the colour change, any special “ingredients”, the twine colour, wax seal colour, the label colour and more!  Base price is £15, and you get to keep your potion at the end. For £3 you get a special ingredient to go inside the potion (such as faux ferns or flowers), and for £2 you can get a dangling metal charm around the neck.

title: Raffle pack drawing
subtitle: Raffle drawing for gift pack
description_full: Enter the free raffle throughout the show by scanning the QR code at the booth. Do not need to present to win. Winner will be contacted by email after the drawing. Gift pack includes one copy of Crows versus Cats, one copy of Mermaid's Song, stickers, art, and whatever else we feel like put in it.

title: Come check out the trailers for our games!
subtitle: Video trailers for the games!
description_full: Hello all!  Come to our stand and you can check out the video trailers for each of our exciting murder mystery detective games!

title: Airborne Commander 2nd Edition Demo
subtitle: The creative team are here to demo the 2nd Edition of the game and sign the demo set for those that want to buy it.
description_full: Max Michael and Mark Rapson to talk everything Airborne Commander including the new 2nd edition AND the new to UK game 8th Air Force Commander. We will have limited stock for sale, which the boys will happily sign.

title: Build a free Panzer II
subtitle: Build your own Panzer II
description_full: Your chance to come and build your own Panzer II free of charge. Just pop your email address into our application screen and you will get exclusive access to our panzer lounge! Here you will be given one of our Panzer II kits To build and take away with you! Open to all…while stock lasts!

title: Spin the Wheel of Climate Disaster
subtitle: Can you survive the climate apocalypse? Spin the wheel of disaster for a chance to win.
description_full: Can you survive the Climate Apocalypse?   In our new board game, Climate Apocalypse , you have a chance to hold back the impending climate doom. See if you have what it takes to survive the climate crisis by spinning the Wheel of Disaster . Avoid  Horrendous Hurricanes, Winter Bomb Cyclones, Torrential Monsoons, and other disasters for your chance to win prizes.  Join us at the Planet B Games stand (Hall 4-143) to spin the wheel for your chance to win and demo the game. No booking needed.

title: Jade Littlen Painting Demonstration
subtitle: Award -winning artist, Jade Littlen will be demonstrating Turbo Dork paints and painting terrain
description_full: The award-winning Jade Littlen will answer your questions and demonstrate techniques. Come along and learn from one of the best miniature artists to emerge in recent years.

title: D&D Shorts Signing Ryoko's Guide
subtitle: Join us for a signing with Will from D&D Shorts signing the recently released Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms
description_full: Join us on the Loot Tavern stand for a signing with Will from D&D Shorts signing the recently released Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms

title: Asian Board Games Festival pins released
subtitle: Limited edition pins release
description_full: Celebrate modern Asian board games with the Pin Your Wins on Us set! This set of 4 pins is an ode to Peranakan culture (unique to Singapore and Malaysia) and designed to proudly display your love for board gaming.  1. All Signs Point to Origame 2. Make my Heart Go Thumb-Thumb-Thumb 3. Meeple in a Dimple 4. Pawn Cocktail   The Pin Your Wins on Us set is not part of the Pin Collective.

title: Florian Sirieix Meet & Greet and game signing
subtitle: Florian Sirieix Meet & Greet and game signing
description_full: Designer Florian Sirieix will be at our stand (2-416) every day between 11:00-12:00 signing games! Get your copies of Mooki Island, Stomp the Plank, After Us, ART Project, Treetopia signed!

title: Meet BattleTech Podcasters!
subtitle: Meet BattleTech Podcasters!
description_full: BattleTech has a wide range of community based podcasts and YouTube channels and the creators of several will be at UKGE and available to talk about their podcasts and their processes .. and maybe even record a session! This will include: Hexperts It’s been one year since three Battletech fans began torturing their friend via the medium of podcasting. Come and see his suffering in person!  That's right after 30 odd episodes the hexperts are making their debut at an official Battletech event.  Come down to UKGE to see Dom, Nathan and the other Hexperts talk about all things Battletech. Tales from the Periphery: Presented by Mike Whitaker (FleetfootMike), Tales From The Periphery brings together authors, game designers, tournament organisers, and hobbyists for a relaxed, entertaining look at the game beyond the lore. It brings together stories from the tabletop frontlines and conversations with the creators and community builders helping BattleTech grow across the UK and beyond. Come say hello, and maybe come away with some swag! Sponsored by Catalyst Game Labs

title: Mythic Bastionland Signing with Chris McDowal
subtitle: Mythic Bastionland Signing with Chris McDowall
description_full: Chris McDowall will be on the Mythic Bastionland stand to talk about his game of knights and myths and sign copies of the book.

title: GamEmploy® Talk
subtitle: Introducing GamEmploy®; Upskilling through gaming / design
description_full: Ask us about our GamEmploy® workshops and success stories, up-skilling unemployed adults in board game design and they build it too!

title: Greeblie Hunting
subtitle: Finding greeblies with Q&A
description_full: Detailing is all important for scratch bashing terrain. This demonstration shows what you might be able to scavenge for free for your budget friendly terrain making - Come along, ask questions and see what is being built on the table!

title: Meet Stoo Goff, the creator of the Aegean RPG
subtitle: Meet Stoo Goff, the creator behind the Aegean tabletop RPG of Greek Myth and Heroic Adventure!
description_full: Stoo Goff, the creator of the Aegean tabletop RPG and the Gaslight Club zine RPG, will be at the GMS stand to sign copies of books, to speak to anyone about Greek mythology, and to show off the upcoming Wolfshead RPG (which uses an evolved version of the Aegean system).   The Isle of Pelops — the latest supplement to Aegean — is now available and anyone buying Aegean products from the author will receive a free copy of the Wolfshead quickstart (while stocks last).
